bayesDREAM.plotting.xy_plots

Raw x-y data plotting for bayesDREAM.

Plot relationships between cis gene expression (x_true) and modality values with k-NN smoothing, technical group coloring, and optional technical correction.

  33def _align_cells_to_modality(
  34    model,
  35    modality,
  36    x_true: np.ndarray,
  37    y_data: np.ndarray,
  38    subset_mask: Optional[np.ndarray] = None
  39) -> Tuple[np.ndarray, np.ndarray, pd.DataFrame]:
  40    """
  41    Align model.meta cells with modality cells, handling the case where
  42    the modality has fewer cells than model.meta.
  43
  44    Parameters
  45    ----------
  46    model : bayesDREAM
  47        The model instance
  48    modality : Modality
  49        The modality instance
  50    x_true : np.ndarray
  51        x_true values for ALL cells in model.meta
  52    y_data : np.ndarray
  53        y values for cells in the modality (may be fewer than model.meta)
  54    subset_mask : Optional[np.ndarray]
  55        Optional boolean mask for subsetting (length = len(model.meta))
  56
  57    Returns
  58    -------
  59    x_true_aligned : np.ndarray
  60        x_true values aligned to final cell set
  61    y_data_aligned : np.ndarray
  62        y values aligned to final cell set
  63    meta_aligned : pd.DataFrame
  64        Metadata aligned to final cell set
  65    """
  66    # Get cell identifiers
  67    if 'cell' in model.meta.columns:
  68        model_cells = model.meta['cell'].values
  69    else:
  70        model_cells = model.meta.index.values
  71
  72    modality_cells = modality.cell_names
  73    if modality_cells is None:
  74        raise ValueError(f"Modality '{modality.name}' does not have cell_names set. Cannot align cells.")
  75
  76    # Create mask for cells in model.meta that are also in modality
  77    modality_mask = np.isin(model_cells, modality_cells)
  78
  79    # Combine with subset_mask if provided
  80    if subset_mask is not None:
  81        final_mask = modality_mask & subset_mask
  82    else:
  83        final_mask = modality_mask
  84
  85    # Get final set of cells
  86    final_cells = model_cells[final_mask]
  87
  88    # Subset x_true and metadata using final_mask
  89    x_true_aligned = x_true[final_mask]
  90    meta_aligned = model.meta[final_mask].copy()
  91
  92    # Map final_cells to indices in modality
  93    # Create a lookup dictionary for efficiency
  94    modality_cell_to_idx = {cell: idx for idx, cell in enumerate(modality_cells)}
  95    y_indices = np.array([modality_cell_to_idx[cell] for cell in final_cells])
  96
  97    # Subset y_data using these indices.
  98    # Scipy sparse matrix slices are always 2D, so indexing must match the cell axis:
  99    #   - shape (1, n_cells): row slice from a features×cells matrix → select columns
 100    #   - shape (n_cells, 1): col slice from a cells×features matrix → select rows, flatten
 101    if _sp.issparse(y_data):
 102        # np.asarray() on a sparse matrix gives a 0-d object array, not dense —
 103        # must use .toarray() to get a proper 2D ndarray before flattening.
 104        if y_data.ndim == 2 and y_data.shape[0] == 1:
 105            # features×cells orientation: cells are along axis 1
 106            y_data_aligned = y_data[:, y_indices].toarray().flatten()
 107        else:
 108            # cells×features orientation: cells are along axis 0
 109            y_data_aligned = y_data[y_indices].toarray().flatten()
 110    else:
 111        y_data_aligned = y_data[y_indices]
 112
 113    return x_true_aligned, y_data_aligned, meta_aligned

 120def _knn_k(n: int, window: Union[int, float]) -> int:
 121    """
 122    Compute k for k-NN smoothing.
 123
 124    Parameters
 125    ----------
 126    n : int
 127        Number of data points
 128    window : int or float
 129        Window size (if int: exact k, if float: proportion of n)
 130
 131    Returns
 132    -------
 133    int
 134        k value for k-NN (at least 1, at most n)
 135    """
 136    if n <= 0:
 137        return 1
 138    k = int(window) if isinstance(window, (int, np.integer)) else int(np.ceil(float(window) * n))
 139    return max(1, min(k, n))

 142def _smooth_knn(
 143    x: np.ndarray,
 144    y: np.ndarray,
 145    k: int,
 146    is_ntc: Optional[np.ndarray] = None
 147) -> Union[Tuple[np.ndarray, np.ndarray], Tuple[np.ndarray, np.ndarray, np.ndarray]]:
 148    """
 149    Centered sliding-window smoothing along x-axis.
 150
 151    Uses a symmetric window of k cells (±k//2 around each point in sorted order).
 152    Points near the edges where a full symmetric window is not available are trimmed.
 153
 154    Parameters
 155    ----------
 156    x : np.ndarray
 157        X values (1D)
 158    y : np.ndarray
 159        Y values (1D)
 160    k : int
 161        Total window size (k//2 cells on each side)
 162    is_ntc : np.ndarray, optional
 163        Boolean array indicating NTC cells (1D, same length as x)
 164        If provided, returns NTC proportions in windows
 165
 166    Returns
 167    -------
 168    x_trimmed : np.ndarray
 169        Sorted x values (edges trimmed)
 170    y_hat : np.ndarray
 171        Smoothed y values
 172    ntc_prop : np.ndarray, optional
 173        If is_ntc provided: proportion of NTC cells in each window
 174    """
 175    if len(x) == 0:
 176        if is_ntc is not None:
 177            return np.array([]), np.array([]), np.array([])
 178        return np.array([]), np.array([])
 179
 180    n = len(x)
 181    order = np.argsort(x)
 182    x_sorted = np.asarray(x)[order]
 183    y_sorted = np.asarray(y)[order]
 184
 185    k = max(1, min(k, n))
 186    half = k // 2
 187
 188    # Trim edges where symmetric window is not possible
 189    lo = half
 190    hi = n - half  # exclusive
 191    if lo >= hi:
 192        # Not enough data for even one full window — fall back to full average
 193        if is_ntc is not None:
 194            return x_sorted, np.full(n, np.nanmean(y_sorted)), np.full(n, np.mean(np.asarray(is_ntc)[order]))
 195        return x_sorted, np.full(n, np.nanmean(y_sorted))
 196
 197    n_out = hi - lo
 198    y_hat = np.empty(n_out, dtype=float)
 199
 200    if is_ntc is not None:
 201        is_ntc_sorted = np.asarray(is_ntc)[order]
 202        ntc_prop = np.empty(n_out, dtype=float)
 203
 204        for j, i in enumerate(range(lo, hi)):
 205            win = slice(i - half, i + half + 1)
 206            y_hat[j] = np.nanmean(y_sorted[win])
 207            ntc_prop[j] = np.mean(is_ntc_sorted[win])
 208
 209        return x_sorted[lo:hi], y_hat, ntc_prop
 210    else:
 211        for j, i in enumerate(range(lo, hi)):
 212            win = slice(i - half, i + half + 1)
 213            y_hat[j] = np.nanmean(y_sorted[win])
 214
 215        return x_sorted[lo:hi], y_hat
 216

 218def _smooth_knn_counts(
 219    x: np.ndarray,
 220    numerators: np.ndarray,
 221    denominators: np.ndarray,
 222    k: int
 223) -> Tuple[np.ndarray, np.ndarray, np.ndarray]:
 224    """
 225    Centered sliding-window smoothing for count data by binning.
 226
 227    Aggregates numerators and denominators within symmetric ±k//2 windows.
 228    Points near the edges where a full symmetric window is not available are trimmed.
 229
 230    Parameters
 231    ----------
 232    x : np.ndarray
 233        X values (1D, length n)
 234    numerators : np.ndarray
 235        Numerator counts (1D for binomial: length n, or 2D for multinomial: n × K)
 236    denominators : np.ndarray
 237        Denominator totals (1D, length n)
 238    k : int
 239        Total window size (k//2 cells on each side)
 240
 241    Returns
 242    -------
 243    x_trimmed : np.ndarray
 244        Sorted x values (edges trimmed)
 245    aggregated_num : np.ndarray
 246        Aggregated numerators (1D or 2D matching input shape)
 247    aggregated_denom : np.ndarray
 248        Aggregated denominators (1D)
 249    """
 250    if len(x) == 0:
 251        return np.array([]), np.array([]), np.array([])
 252
 253    n = len(x)
 254    order = np.argsort(x)
 255    x_sorted = np.asarray(x)[order]
 256
 257    k = max(1, min(k, n))
 258    half = k // 2
 259
 260    # Trim edges where symmetric window is not possible
 261    lo = half
 262    hi = n - half  # exclusive
 263    if lo >= hi:
 264        # Not enough data — return full sums
 265        is_2d = numerators.ndim == 2
 266        if is_2d:
 267            return x_sorted, np.sum(np.asarray(numerators)[order, :], axis=0, keepdims=True).repeat(n, axis=0), np.full(n, np.sum(denominators))
 268        return x_sorted, np.full(n, np.sum(np.asarray(numerators)[order])), np.full(n, np.sum(denominators))
 269
 270    n_out = hi - lo
 271
 272    # Handle 1D (binomial) vs 2D (multinomial) numerators
 273    is_2d = numerators.ndim == 2
 274    if is_2d:
 275        num_sorted = np.asarray(numerators)[order, :]  # (n, K)
 276        K_dim = num_sorted.shape[1]
 277        aggregated_num = np.zeros((n_out, K_dim), dtype=float)
 278    else:
 279        num_sorted = np.asarray(numerators)[order]  # (n,)
 280        aggregated_num = np.zeros(n_out, dtype=float)
 281
 282    denom_sorted = np.asarray(denominators)[order]
 283    aggregated_denom = np.zeros(n_out, dtype=float)
 284
 285    for j, i in enumerate(range(lo, hi)):
 286        win = slice(i - half, i + half + 1)
 287
 288        if is_2d:
 289            aggregated_num[j, :] = np.sum(num_sorted[win, :], axis=0)
 290        else:
 291            aggregated_num[j] = np.sum(num_sorted[win])
 292
 293        aggregated_denom[j] = np.sum(denom_sorted[win])
 294
 295    return x_sorted[lo:hi], aggregated_num, aggregated_denom
 296

 298def _to_2d(a):
 299    """
 300    Convert input to 2D numpy array.
 301
 302    Handles torch tensors and reshapes 1D arrays.
 303    """
 304    try:
 305        import torch
 306        if isinstance(a, torch.Tensor):
 307            return a.detach().cpu().numpy().astype(float)
 308    except Exception:
 309        pass
 310    a = np.asarray(a)
 311    return a.reshape(1, -1).astype(float) if a.ndim == 1 else a.astype(float)

 314def reorder_xtrue_by_barcode(
 315    x_true: Union[np.ndarray, torch.Tensor],
 316    src_barcodes: np.ndarray,
 317    dst_barcodes: np.ndarray
 318) -> Union[np.ndarray, torch.Tensor]:
 319    """
 320    Reorder x_true from source barcode order to destination barcode order.
 321
 322    Parameters
 323    ----------
 324    x_true : array or tensor
 325        Values to reorder
 326    src_barcodes : np.ndarray
 327        Source barcode order
 328    dst_barcodes : np.ndarray
 329        Destination barcode order
 330
 331    Returns
 332    -------
 333    array or tensor
 334        Reordered x_true
 335    """
 336    is_torch = False
 337    try:
 338        import torch
 339        if isinstance(x_true, torch.Tensor):
 340            is_torch = True
 341            x_np = x_true.detach().cpu().numpy()
 342            torch_dtype, torch_device = x_true.dtype, x_true.device
 343        else:
 344            x_np = np.asarray(x_true)
 345    except Exception:
 346        x_np = np.asarray(x_true)
 347
 348    src = np.asarray(src_barcodes).astype(str)
 349    dst = np.asarray(dst_barcodes).astype(str)
 350
 351    pos = {b: i for i, b in enumerate(src)}
 352    perm = np.fromiter((pos[b] for b in dst), dtype=int, count=len(dst))
 353
 354    x_np = x_np if x_np.ndim == 1 else x_np[:, :]
 355    x_np = x_np[perm] if x_np.ndim == 1 else x_np[:, perm]
 356
 357    if is_torch:
 358        import torch
 359        return torch.as_tensor(x_np, dtype=torch_dtype, device=torch_device)
 360    return x_np

 367def _resolve_features(feature_or_gene: str, modality) -> Tuple[List[int], List[str], bool]:
 368    """
 369    Resolve input to feature index(es) and name(s).
 370
 371    Returns
 372    -------
 373    feature_indices : List[int]
 374        Integer positions of features
 375    feature_names : List[str]
 376        Feature names
 377    is_gene : bool
 378        True if input was a gene name (multiple features), False if single feature
 379
 380    Raises
 381    ------
 382    ValueError
 383        If feature/gene not found or modality doesn't have gene information
 384    """
 385    # First, try as a direct feature match
 386    feature_idx = _get_feature_index(feature_or_gene, modality)
 387    if feature_idx is not None:
 388        # Found as a feature - get the actual feature name
 389        if hasattr(modality, 'feature_names') and modality.feature_names is not None:
 390            feature_name = modality.feature_names[feature_idx]
 391        else:
 392            feature_name = feature_or_gene
 393        return [feature_idx], [feature_name], False
 394
 395    # Not found as feature - try as gene
 396    # Check if modality has gene information
 397    gene_cols = ['gene', 'gene_name', 'gene_id']
 398    available_gene_cols = [col for col in gene_cols if col in modality.feature_meta.columns]
 399
 400    if not available_gene_cols:
 401        raise ValueError(
 402            f"'{feature_or_gene}' not found as a feature, and modality '{modality.name}' "
 403            f"has no gene information (no 'gene', 'gene_name', or 'gene_id' columns in feature_meta). "
 404            f"Cannot search by gene name."
 405        )
 406
 407    # Search for gene across all gene columns
 408    matching_features = []
 409    for gene_col in available_gene_cols:
 410        mask = modality.feature_meta[gene_col] == feature_or_gene
 411        if mask.sum() > 0:
 412            # Found matches
 413            indices = mask.values.nonzero()[0].tolist()
 414
 415            # Get feature names for matched indices.
 416            # modality.feature_names is the single source of truth (resolved +
 417            # deduped in Modality.__init__), no need to re-derive it here.
 418            if modality.feature_names is not None:
 419                names = [modality.feature_names[i] for i in indices]
 420            else:
 421                names = [str(i) for i in indices]
 422
 423            return indices, names, True
 424
 425    # Not found as feature or gene
 426    raise ValueError(
 427        f"'{feature_or_gene}' not found as a feature or gene in modality '{modality.name}'. "
 428        f"Checked: feature names/index and gene columns {available_gene_cols}"
 429    )

 432def _get_feature_index(feature: str, modality) -> Optional[int]:
 433    """
 434    Robustly find feature index, checking multiple locations.
 435
 436    Checks feature_meta.index, feature_meta columns, and feature_names attribute.
 437
 438    IMPORTANT: Does NOT check 'gene', 'gene_name', or 'gene_id' columns -
 439    those are reserved for gene-level searches in _resolve_features().
 440
 441    Parameters
 442    ----------
 443    feature : str
 444        Feature name to find
 445    modality : Modality
 446        Modality object to search in
 447
 448    Returns
 449    -------
 450    int or None
 451        Feature index if found, None otherwise
 452    """
 453    # Check index first
 454    if feature in modality.feature_meta.index:
 455        return modality.feature_meta.index.get_loc(feature)
 456
 457    # Check common column names (EXCLUDING gene columns)
 458    for col in ['junction', 'feature', 'name', 'coord.intron', 'SJ']:
 459        if col in modality.feature_meta.columns:
 460            mask = modality.feature_meta[col] == feature
 461            if mask.sum() > 0:
 462                # Use argmax to get integer position, not index label
 463                return mask.values.argmax()
 464
 465    # Check feature_names attribute
 466    if hasattr(modality, 'feature_names'):
 467        feature_names = modality.feature_names
 468        if isinstance(feature_names, (list, np.ndarray)):
 469            feature_names_list = list(feature_names)
 470            if feature in feature_names_list:
 471                return feature_names_list.index(feature)
 472
 473    return None

 501def _multinomial_correct_binned_probs(
 502    props_binned: np.ndarray,         # (n_bins, K) proportions from aggregated counts
 503    alpha_y_add,                      # [S, C, T, K] or [C, T, K]
 504    group_code: int,
 505    feature_idx: int,
 506    zero_cat_mask: np.ndarray         # (K,) True where category is globally zero
 507) -> np.ndarray:
 508    """
 509    Apply multinomial technical correction to binned proportions.
 510
 511    For each bin: softmax(log(P) - alpha_s) for each posterior sample s,
 512    then average across s.
 513
 514    Parameters
 515    ----------
 516    props_binned : np.ndarray
 517        Proportions computed from aggregated counts in k-NN bins (n_bins, K)
 518    alpha_y_add : torch.Tensor or np.ndarray
 519        Technical correction parameters [S, C, T, K] or [C, T, K]
 520    group_code : int
 521        Technical group code for this data
 522    feature_idx : int
 523        Feature index in alpha array
 524    zero_cat_mask : np.ndarray
 525        Boolean mask (K,) indicating globally absent categories
 526
 527    Returns
 528    -------
 529    np.ndarray
 530        Corrected proportions (n_bins, K)
 531    """
 532    epsilon = 1e-6
 533    # Clip and log
 534    P = np.clip(props_binned, epsilon, 1 - epsilon)   # (n_bins, K)
 535    logP = np.log(P)                                  # (n_bins, K)
 536
 537    # Pull alpha with explicit samples dim
 538    if alpha_y_add.ndim == 4:        # [S, C, T, K]
 539        A = alpha_y_add[:, group_code, feature_idx, :]          # (S, K)
 540    elif alpha_y_add.ndim == 3:      # [C, T, K] -> add S=1
 541        A = alpha_y_add[None, group_code, feature_idx, :]       # (1, K)
 542    else:
 543        raise ValueError(f"Unexpected alpha_y_add shape: {alpha_y_add.shape}")
 544
 545    if hasattr(A, "detach"):
 546        A = A.detach().cpu().numpy()
 547
 548    # Broadcast to (S, n_bins, K)
 549    logP_S = logP[None, :, :]
 550    A_S    = A[:, None, :]
 551
 552    logits = logP_S - A_S                                 # (S, n_bins, K)
 553
 554    # Hard-mask zero categories
 555    logits[:, :, zero_cat_mask] = -np.inf
 556
 557    # Stable softmax with mask
 558    m = np.nanmax(logits, axis=-1, keepdims=True)
 559    exps = np.exp(logits - m)
 560    exps[:, :, zero_cat_mask] = 0.0
 561    Z = exps.sum(axis=-1, keepdims=True)
 562    Z[Z == 0] = 1.0
 563    P_corr_S = exps / Z                                    # (S, n_bins, K)
 564
 565    # Posterior mean in probability space
 566    return P_corr_S.mean(axis=0)                           # (n_bins, K)
 567

 574def _extract_param_mean(param_samples, feature_idx: int):
 575    """Extract the posterior-mean value for one feature from a parameter tensor."""
 576    if hasattr(param_samples, 'mean'):
 577        param_mean = param_samples.mean(dim=0)
 578    else:
 579        param_mean = param_samples.mean(axis=0)
 580    if param_mean.ndim > 1:
 581        param_mean = param_mean.squeeze(0)
 582    val = param_mean[feature_idx]
 583    return val.item() if hasattr(val, 'item') else val
 584
 585
 586def _extract_param_samples(posterior, param_name: str, feature_idx: int) -> np.ndarray:
 587    """Extract all posterior samples for one feature from a named parameter."""
 588    samples = posterior[param_name]
 589    if hasattr(samples, 'cpu'):
 590        samples = samples.cpu().numpy()
 591    else:
 592        samples = np.array(samples)
 593    if samples.ndim > 2:
 594        samples = samples.squeeze(1)
 595    return samples[:, feature_idx]

 602def get_technical_group_labels(model) -> List[str]:
 603    """
 604    Get informative labels for technical groups.
 605
 606    Returns human-readable labels like ``"K562"`` or ``"K562:lane1"`` built
 607    from the covariates passed to ``set_technical_groups()``.
 608
 609    Parameters
 610    ----------
 611    model : bayesDREAM
 612        Fitted bayesDREAM model.
 613
 614    Returns
 615    -------
 616    List[str]
 617        One label per unique ``technical_group_code`` value (sorted).
 618    """
 619    if 'technical_group_code' not in model.meta.columns:
 620        return ['All']
 621
 622    group_codes = sorted(model.meta['technical_group_code'].unique())
 623
 624    # Use stored covariates if available (set by set_technical_groups)
 625    covariates = getattr(model, '_technical_group_covariates', None)
 626    if not covariates:
 627        return [f'Group_{i}' for i in group_codes]
 628
 629    labels = []
 630    for code in group_codes:
 631        mask = model.meta['technical_group_code'] == code
 632        row = model.meta.loc[mask, covariates].iloc[0]
 633        parts = [str(row[c]) for c in covariates]
 634        labels.append(':'.join(parts))
 635    return labels

 638def get_default_color_palette(labels: List[str]) -> Dict[str, str]:

 640    Get default color palette for technical groups.

 642    Parameters
 643    ----------
 644    labels : List[str]

 646
 647    Returns
 648    -------
 649    Dict[str, str]
 650        Mapping from label to color
 651    """
 652    return {label: f'C{i}' for i, label in enumerate(labels)}
 653
 654
 655def _labels_by_code_for_df(model, df) -> dict[int, str]:
 656    """
 657    Return {technical_group_code -> human-readable label} *for codes present in df*.
 658    Prefers 'cell_line' if available, else falls back to a stable generic label.
 659
 660    If technical_group_code doesn't exist, returns {0: 'All'} (single group).
 661    """
 662    # Handle case where technical groups don't exist
 663    if 'technical_group_code' not in df.columns:
 664        return {0: 'All'}
 665
 666    present = np.sort(df['technical_group_code'].unique())
 667    label_col = 'cell_line' if 'cell_line' in model.meta.columns else None
 668
 669    mapping = {}
 670    for code in present:
 671        if label_col is not None:
 672            vals = model.meta.loc[model.meta['technical_group_code'] == code, label_col]
 673            mapping[int(code)] = str(vals.iloc[0]) if len(vals) else f'Group_{int(code)}'
 674        else:
 675            mapping[int(code)] = f'Group_{int(code)}'
 676    return mapping
 677
 678
 679def _color_for_label(label: str, fallback_idx: int = 0, palette: dict | None = None) -> str:
 680    """
 681    Return colour for a technical group label, using user-supplied palette if provided.
 682    """
 683    palette = palette or {}
 684    if label in palette:
 685        return palette[label]
 686    return f'C{fallback_idx}'
 687
 688
 689def plot_colored_line(
 690    x: np.ndarray,
 691    y: np.ndarray,
 692    color_values: np.ndarray,
 693    cmap,
 694    ax: plt.Axes,
 695    linewidth: float = 2
 696):
 697    """
 698    Plot a line with color gradient based on values.
 699
 700    Parameters
 701    ----------
 702    x, y : np.ndarray
 703        Line coordinates
 704    color_values : np.ndarray
 705        Values for coloring (same length as x, y)
 706    cmap : colormap
 707        Matplotlib colormap
 708    ax : plt.Axes
 709        Axes to plot on
 710    linewidth : float
 711        Line width
 712
 713    Returns
 714    -------
 715    LineCollection
 716        The created line collection
 717    """
 718    points = np.array([x, y]).T.reshape(-1, 1, 2)
 719    segments = np.concatenate([points[:-1], points[1:]], axis=1)
 720
 721    norm = Normalize(vmin=0, vmax=1)
 722    lc = LineCollection(segments, cmap=cmap, norm=norm)
 723    lc.set_array(color_values)
 724    lc.set_linewidth(linewidth)
 725    ax.add_collection(lc)
 726
 727    return lc

 730# ============================================================================
 731# Trans Function Prediction Utilities (for overlaying fitted functions)
 732# ============================================================================
 733
 734def Hill_based_positive(x, Vmax, A, K, n, epsilon=1e-6):
 735    """
 736    Positive Hill function.
 737
 738    Parameters
 739    ----------
 740    x : array
 741        Input values
 742    Vmax, A, K, n : float or array
 743        Hill parameters
 744    epsilon : float
 745        Small constant for numerical stability
 746
 747    Returns
 748    -------
 749    array
 750        Hill function values
 751    """
 752    x_safe = x + epsilon
 753    K_safe = K + epsilon
 754    x_log = np.log(x_safe)
 755    K_log = np.log(K_safe)
 756    x_n = np.exp(n * x_log)
 757    K_n = np.exp(n * K_log)
 758    denominator = K_n + x_n
 759    return Vmax * (x_n / denominator) + A
 760
 761
 762def Hill_first_derivative(x, Vmax, K, n, epsilon=1e-6):
 763    """
 764    First derivative of Hill function: d/dx [V * x^n / (K^n + x^n)]
 765
 766    Formula: (K^n * V * n * x^(n-1)) / (K^n + x^n)^2
 767
 768    Parameters
 769    ----------
 770    x : array
 771        Input values
 772    Vmax : float or array
 773        Maximum effect
 774    K : float or array
 775        Half-maximal concentration
 776    n : float or array
 777        Hill coefficient
 778    epsilon : float
 779        Small constant for numerical stability
 780
 781    Returns
 782    -------
 783    array
 784        First derivative values
 785    """
 786    x_safe = np.maximum(x, epsilon)
 787    K_safe = np.maximum(K, epsilon)
 788
 789    x_n = np.power(x_safe, n)
 790    K_n = np.power(K_safe, n)
 791    x_nm1 = np.power(x_safe, n - 1)
 792
 793    denom = np.power(K_n + x_n, 2)
 794
 795    return (K_n * Vmax * n * x_nm1) / denom
 796
 797
 798def Hill_second_derivative(x, Vmax, K, n, epsilon=1e-6):
 799    """
 800    Second derivative of Hill function: d²/dx² [V * x^n / (K^n + x^n)]
 801
 802    Formula: -(K^n * V * n * x^(n-2) * ((n+1)*x^n - K^n*(n-1))) / (K^n + x^n)^3
 803
 804    Parameters
 805    ----------
 806    x : array
 807        Input values
 808    Vmax : float or array
 809        Maximum effect
 810    K : float or array
 811        Half-maximal concentration
 812    n : float or array
 813        Hill coefficient
 814    epsilon : float
 815        Small constant for numerical stability
 816
 817    Returns
 818    -------
 819    array
 820        Second derivative values
 821    """
 822    x_safe = np.maximum(x, epsilon)
 823    K_safe = np.maximum(K, epsilon)
 824
 825    x_n = np.power(x_safe, n)
 826    K_n = np.power(K_safe, n)
 827    x_nm2 = np.power(x_safe, n - 2)
 828
 829    denom = np.power(K_n + x_n, 3)
 830
 831    # Numerator: -K^n * V * n * x^(n-2) * ((n+1)*x^n - K^n*(n-1))
 832    inner_term = (n + 1) * x_n - K_n * (n - 1)
 833    numer = -K_n * Vmax * n * x_nm2 * inner_term
 834
 835    return numer / denom
 836
 837
 838def log2fc_first_derivative(x, S, dS_dx, epsilon=1e-10):
 839    """
 840    First derivative in log2FC space: dg/du where g(u) = log2(S(x(u))) - y_ntc.
 841
 842    With u = log2(x) - x_ntc, we have x = x_ntc * 2^u, so dx/du = x * ln(2).
 843
 844    Formula: dg/du = x * S'(x) / S(x)
 845
 846    Parameters
 847    ----------
 848    x : array
 849        Input x values (not log-transformed)
 850    S : array
 851        Function values S(x)
 852    dS_dx : array
 853        First derivative S'(x)
 854    epsilon : float
 855        Small constant for numerical stability
 856
 857    Returns
 858    -------
 859    array
 860        First derivative in log2FC space
 861    """
 862    S_safe = np.maximum(np.abs(S), epsilon)
 863    return x * dS_dx / S_safe
 864
 865
 866def log2fc_second_derivative(x, S, dS_dx, d2S_dx2, epsilon=1e-10):
 867    """
 868    Second derivative in log2FC space: d²g/du².
 869
 870    Formula: d²g/du² = ln(2) * (x * S'/S + x² * S''/S - x² * (S'/S)²)
 871
 872    Parameters
 873    ----------
 874    x : array
 875        Input x values (not log-transformed)
 876    S : array
 877        Function values S(x)
 878    dS_dx : array
 879        First derivative S'(x)
 880    d2S_dx2 : array
 881        Second derivative S''(x)
 882    epsilon : float
 883        Small constant for numerical stability
 884
 885    Returns
 886    -------
 887    array
 888        Second derivative in log2FC space
 889    """
 890    S_safe = np.maximum(np.abs(S), epsilon)
 891    ln2 = np.log(2)
 892
 893    term1 = x * dS_dx / S_safe
 894    term2 = x**2 * d2S_dx2 / S_safe
 895    term3 = x**2 * (dS_dx / S_safe)**2
 896
 897    return ln2 * (term1 + term2 - term3)
 898
 899
 900def Hill_third_derivative(x, Vmax, K, n, epsilon=1e-6):
 901    """
 902    Third derivative of Hill function: d³/dx³ [V * x^n / (K^n + x^n)]
 903
 904    Formula: (K^n * V * n * x^(n-3) * ((n²+3n+2)*x^(2n) + (4K^n - 4K^n*n²)*x^n
 905             + K^(2n)*n² - 3K^(2n)*n + 2K^(2n))) / (K^n + x^n)^4
 906
 907    Parameters
 908    ----------
 909    x : array
 910        Input values
 911    Vmax : float or array
 912        Maximum effect
 913    K : float or array
 914        Half-maximal concentration
 915    n : float or array
 916        Hill coefficient
 917    epsilon : float
 918        Small constant for numerical stability
 919
 920    Returns
 921    -------
 922    array
 923        Third derivative values
 924    """
 925    x_safe = np.maximum(x, epsilon)
 926    K_safe = np.maximum(K, epsilon)
 927
 928    x_n = np.power(x_safe, n)
 929    x_2n = np.power(x_safe, 2 * n)
 930    K_n = np.power(K_safe, n)
 931    K_2n = np.power(K_safe, 2 * n)
 932    x_nm3 = np.power(x_safe, n - 3)
 933
 934    denom = np.power(K_n + x_n, 4)
 935
 936    # Numerator terms
 937    # (n² + 3n + 2) * x^(2n)
 938    term1 = (n**2 + 3*n + 2) * x_2n
 939    # (4K^n - 4K^n*n²) * x^n = 4K^n * (1 - n²) * x^n
 940    term2 = 4 * K_n * (1 - n**2) * x_n
 941    # K^(2n) * n² - 3K^(2n) * n + 2K^(2n) = K^(2n) * (n² - 3n + 2)
 942    term3 = K_2n * (n**2 - 3*n + 2)
 943
 944    numer = K_n * Vmax * n * x_nm3 * (term1 + term2 + term3)
 945
 946    return numer / denom
 947
 948
 949def log2fc_third_derivative(x, S, dS_dx, d2S_dx2, d3S_dx3, epsilon=1e-10):
 950    """
 951    Third derivative in log2FC space: d³g/du³.
 952
 953    Derived by differentiating d²g/du² with respect to u:
 954    d³g/du³ = (ln(2))² * [x*S'/S + 3x²*S''/S - 3x²*(S'/S)²
 955                         + x³*S'''/S - 3x³*(S'/S)*(S''/S) + 2x³*(S'/S)³]
 956
 957    Parameters
 958    ----------
 959    x : array
 960        Input x values (not log-transformed)
 961    S : array
 962        Function values S(x)
 963    dS_dx : array
 964        First derivative S'(x)
 965    d2S_dx2 : array
 966        Second derivative S''(x)
 967    d3S_dx3 : array
 968        Third derivative S'''(x)
 969    epsilon : float
 970        Small constant for numerical stability
 971
 972    Returns
 973    -------
 974    array
 975        Third derivative in log2FC space
 976    """
 977    S_safe = np.maximum(np.abs(S), epsilon)
 978    ln2 = np.log(2)
 979    ln2_sq = ln2 ** 2
 980
 981    S_ratio = dS_dx / S_safe      # S'/S
 982    S2_ratio = d2S_dx2 / S_safe   # S''/S
 983    S3_ratio = d3S_dx3 / S_safe   # S'''/S
 984
 985    x2 = x ** 2
 986    x3 = x ** 3
 987
 988    # x*S'/S
 989    term1 = x * S_ratio
 990    # 3x²*S''/S
 991    term2 = 3 * x2 * S2_ratio
 992    # -3x²*(S'/S)²
 993    term3 = -3 * x2 * S_ratio**2
 994    # x³*S'''/S
 995    term4 = x3 * S3_ratio
 996    # -3x³*(S'/S)*(S''/S)
 997    term5 = -3 * x3 * S_ratio * S2_ratio
 998    # 2x³*(S'/S)³
 999    term6 = 2 * x3 * S_ratio**3
1000
1001    return ln2_sq * (term1 + term2 + term3 + term4 + term5 + term6)
1002
1003
1004def predict_trans_derivatives(
1005    model,
1006    feature: str,
1007    x_range: np.ndarray,
1008    modality_name: Optional[str] = None,
1009    fdr_threshold: float = 0.05,
1010    fdr_df: Optional["pd.DataFrame"] = None,
1011) -> Tuple[Optional[np.ndarray], Optional[np.ndarray], Optional[np.ndarray]]:
1012    """
1013    Compute first, second, and third derivatives of trans effect function.
1014
1015    Only supports single_hill and additive_hill function types.
1016
1017    Parameters
1018    ----------
1019    model : bayesDREAM
1020        Model with fit_trans() completed
1021    feature : str
1022        Feature name to predict
1023    x_range : np.ndarray
1024        X values to compute derivatives at
1025    modality_name : str, optional
1026        Modality name (default: primary modality)
1027    fdr_threshold : float, default 0.05
1028        For additive_hill: FDR-inactive components (q-value >= fdr_threshold) are
1029        gated to zero, matching predict_trans_function so the derivative is of the
1030        *same* curve that gets plotted.
1031    fdr_df : pd.DataFrame, optional
1032        Precomputed trans_summary DataFrame to source activity calls from.
1033
1034    Returns
1035    -------
1036    Tuple[np.ndarray or None, np.ndarray or None, np.ndarray or None]
1037        (first_derivative, second_derivative, third_derivative) at x_range values,
1038        or (None, None, None) if trans model not fitted or unsupported function type
1039
1040    Raises
1041    ------
1042    ValueError
1043        If function type is not single_hill or additive_hill
1044    """
1045    # Determine which modality to use
1046    if modality_name is None:
1047        modality_name = model.primary_modality
1048
1049    # Check if trans model fitted for this modality
1050    if modality_name == model.primary_modality:
1051        if not hasattr(model, 'posterior_samples_trans') or model.posterior_samples_trans is None:
1052            return None, None, None
1053        posterior = model.posterior_samples_trans
1054    else:
1055        modality = model.get_modality(modality_name)
1056        if not hasattr(modality, 'posterior_samples_trans') or modality.posterior_samples_trans is None:
1057            return None, None, None
1058        posterior = modality.posterior_samples_trans
1059
1060    # Get baseline A (present in all function types)
1061    if 'A' not in posterior:
1062        return None, None, None
1063
1064    A_samples = posterior['A']
1065
1066    # Get feature list — always from the modality, never from model.trans_genes.
1067    # modality.feature_names is the single source of truth (resolved + deduped
1068    # in Modality.__init__), no need to re-derive it here.
1069    modality = model.get_modality(modality_name)
1070    feature_list = modality.feature_names
1071    if feature_list is None:
1072        return None, None, None
1073
1074    # Get dimensions
1075    if hasattr(A_samples, 'mean'):
1076        A_mean = A_samples.mean(dim=0)
1077        if A_mean.ndim > 1:
1078            A_mean = A_mean.squeeze(0)
1079        n_genes_posterior = A_mean.shape[0]
1080    else:
1081        A_mean = A_samples.mean(axis=0)
1082        if A_mean.ndim > 1:
1083            A_mean = A_mean.squeeze(0)
1084        n_genes_posterior = A_mean.shape[0]
1085
1086    if n_genes_posterior != len(feature_list):
1087        return None, None, None
1088
1089    if feature not in feature_list:
1090        return None, None, None
1091
1092    feature_idx = feature_list.index(feature)
1093
1094    # Check function type and compute derivatives
1095    if 'Vmax_a' in posterior and 'Vmax_b' in posterior:
1096        # ===== ADDITIVE HILL =====
1097        try:
1098            alpha = _extract_param_mean(posterior['alpha'], feature_idx)
1099            beta = _extract_param_mean(posterior['beta'], feature_idx)
1100            Vmax_a = _extract_param_mean(posterior['Vmax_a'], feature_idx)
1101            Vmax_b = _extract_param_mean(posterior['Vmax_b'], feature_idx)
1102            K_a = _extract_param_mean(posterior['K_a'], feature_idx)
1103            K_b = _extract_param_mean(posterior['K_b'], feature_idx)
1104            n_a = _extract_param_mean(posterior['n_a'], feature_idx)
1105            n_b = _extract_param_mean(posterior['n_b'], feature_idx)
1106
1107            a_null, b_null = _resolve_hill_null_flags(
1108                feature, feature_idx, posterior, fdr_df=fdr_df, fdr_threshold=fdr_threshold
1109            )
1110            if a_null:
1111                alpha = 0.0
1112            if b_null:
1113                beta = 0.0
1114
1115            # First derivatives
1116            dHill_a = Hill_first_derivative(x_range, Vmax=Vmax_a, K=K_a, n=n_a)
1117            dHill_b = Hill_first_derivative(x_range, Vmax=Vmax_b, K=K_b, n=n_b)
1118            first_deriv = alpha * dHill_a + beta * dHill_b
1119
1120            # Second derivatives
1121            d2Hill_a = Hill_second_derivative(x_range, Vmax=Vmax_a, K=K_a, n=n_a)
1122            d2Hill_b = Hill_second_derivative(x_range, Vmax=Vmax_b, K=K_b, n=n_b)
1123            second_deriv = alpha * d2Hill_a + beta * d2Hill_b
1124
1125            # Third derivatives
1126            d3Hill_a = Hill_third_derivative(x_range, Vmax=Vmax_a, K=K_a, n=n_a)
1127            d3Hill_b = Hill_third_derivative(x_range, Vmax=Vmax_b, K=K_b, n=n_b)
1128            third_deriv = alpha * d3Hill_a + beta * d3Hill_b
1129
1130            return first_deriv, second_deriv, third_deriv
1131
1132        except (KeyError, IndexError, AttributeError):
1133            return None, None, None
1134
1135    elif 'upper_limit' in posterior and 'Vmax_a' in posterior and 'Vmax_b' in posterior:
1136        # ===== ADDITIVE HILL (binomial/multinomial) =====
1137        try:
1138            alpha = _extract_param_mean(posterior['alpha'], feature_idx)
1139            beta = _extract_param_mean(posterior['beta'], feature_idx)
1140            Vmax_a = _extract_param_mean(posterior['Vmax_a'], feature_idx)
1141            Vmax_b = _extract_param_mean(posterior['Vmax_b'], feature_idx)
1142            K_a = _extract_param_mean(posterior['K_a'], feature_idx)
1143            K_b = _extract_param_mean(posterior['K_b'], feature_idx)
1144            n_a = _extract_param_mean(posterior['n_a'], feature_idx)
1145            n_b = _extract_param_mean(posterior['n_b'], feature_idx)
1146
1147            a_null, b_null = _resolve_hill_null_flags(
1148                feature, feature_idx, posterior, fdr_df=fdr_df, fdr_threshold=fdr_threshold
1149            )
1150            if a_null:
1151                alpha = 0.0
1152            if b_null:
1153                beta = 0.0
1154
1155            # First derivatives
1156            dHill_a = Hill_first_derivative(x_range, Vmax=Vmax_a, K=K_a, n=n_a)
1157            dHill_b = Hill_first_derivative(x_range, Vmax=Vmax_b, K=K_b, n=n_b)
1158            first_deriv = alpha * dHill_a + beta * dHill_b
1159
1160            # Second derivatives
1161            d2Hill_a = Hill_second_derivative(x_range, Vmax=Vmax_a, K=K_a, n=n_a)
1162            d2Hill_b = Hill_second_derivative(x_range, Vmax=Vmax_b, K=K_b, n=n_b)
1163            second_deriv = alpha * d2Hill_a + beta * d2Hill_b
1164
1165            # Third derivatives
1166            d3Hill_a = Hill_third_derivative(x_range, Vmax=Vmax_a, K=K_a, n=n_a)
1167            d3Hill_b = Hill_third_derivative(x_range, Vmax=Vmax_b, K=K_b, n=n_b)
1168            third_deriv = alpha * d3Hill_a + beta * d3Hill_b
1169
1170            return first_deriv, second_deriv, third_deriv
1171
1172        except (KeyError, IndexError, AttributeError):
1173            return None, None, None
1174
1175    elif 'Vmax_a' in posterior:
1176        # ===== SINGLE HILL =====
1177        try:
1178            alpha = _extract_param_mean(posterior['alpha'], feature_idx)
1179            Vmax_a = _extract_param_mean(posterior['Vmax_a'], feature_idx)
1180            K_a = _extract_param_mean(posterior['K_a'], feature_idx)
1181            n_a = _extract_param_mean(posterior['n_a'], feature_idx)
1182
1183            # First derivative
1184            first_deriv = alpha * Hill_first_derivative(x_range, Vmax=Vmax_a, K=K_a, n=n_a)
1185
1186            # Second derivative
1187            second_deriv = alpha * Hill_second_derivative(x_range, Vmax=Vmax_a, K=K_a, n=n_a)
1188
1189            # Third derivative
1190            third_deriv = alpha * Hill_third_derivative(x_range, Vmax=Vmax_a, K=K_a, n=n_a)
1191
1192            return first_deriv, second_deriv, third_deriv
1193
1194        except (KeyError, IndexError, AttributeError):
1195            return None, None, None
1196
1197    elif 'theta' in posterior:
1198        # ===== POLYNOMIAL - NOT SUPPORTED =====
1199        raise ValueError(
1200            "Derivative plotting not supported for polynomial function type. "
1201            "Only single_hill and additive_hill are supported."
1202        )
1203
1204    else:
1205        # Unknown function type
1206        return None, None, None
1207
1208
1209def predict_trans_log2fc(
1210    model,
1211    feature: str,
1212    x_range: np.ndarray,
1213    modality_name: Optional[str] = None,
1214    return_derivatives: bool = True,
1215    fdr_threshold: float = 0.05,
1216    fdr_df: Optional["pd.DataFrame"] = None,
1217) -> Tuple[Optional[np.ndarray], Optional[np.ndarray], Optional[np.ndarray], Optional[np.ndarray], Optional[np.ndarray]]:
1218    """
1219    Compute trans effect function and derivatives in log2FC space.
1220
1221    Transforms:
1222    - x-axis: u = log2(x) - log2(x_ntc)  (cis gene log2FC)
1223    - y-axis: g(u) = log2(S(x(u))) - log2(y_ntc)  (trans gene log2FC)
1224
1225    Where x_ntc is the NTC mean for the cis gene, and y_ntc is the NTC mean for the trans gene.
1226
1227    Derivative formulas:
1228    - dg/du = x * S'(x) / S(x)
1229    - d²g/du² = ln(2) * (x * S'/S + x² * S''/S - x² * (S'/S)²)
1230    - d³g/du³ = ln(2) * (x²*S'''/S - 3x²*S'*S''/S² + 3x*S''/S + 2x²*S'³/S³ - 3x*S'²/S² + S'/S)
1231
1232    Parameters
1233    ----------
1234    model : bayesDREAM
1235        Model with fit_trans() completed and posterior_samples_ntc available
1236    feature : str
1237        Feature name (trans gene) to predict
1238    x_range : np.ndarray
1239        X values (cis expression, NOT log-transformed)
1240    modality_name : str, optional
1241        Modality name (default: primary modality)
1242    return_derivatives : bool
1243        Whether to compute and return derivatives (default: True)
1244
1245    Returns
1246    -------
1247    Tuple of (y_log2fc, u_range, first_deriv_log2fc, second_deriv_log2fc, third_deriv_log2fc)
1248        - y_log2fc: log2FC of trans gene relative to NTC
1249        - u_range: log2FC of cis gene relative to NTC
1250        - first_deriv_log2fc: dg/du (None if return_derivatives=False)
1251        - second_deriv_log2fc: d²g/du² (None if return_derivatives=False)
1252        - third_deriv_log2fc: d³g/du³ (None if return_derivatives=False)
1253        All are None if computation fails
1254    """
1255    # Get S(x) - the function values
1256    y_pred = predict_trans_function(model, feature, x_range, modality_name=modality_name,
1257                                     fdr_threshold=fdr_threshold, fdr_df=fdr_df)
1258    if y_pred is None:
1259        return None, None, None, None, None
1260
1261    # Get NTC means
1262    # Cis NTC (for x-axis transformation)
1263    cis_mod = model.get_modality('cis')
1264    if cis_mod is None or not hasattr(cis_mod, 'posterior_samples_ntc'):
1265        return None, None, None, None, None
1266
1267    cis_mu_ntc = cis_mod.posterior_samples_ntc.get('mu_ntc', None)
1268    if cis_mu_ntc is None:
1269        return None, None, None, None, None
1270
1271    if hasattr(cis_mu_ntc, 'mean'):
1272        x_ntc = cis_mu_ntc.mean(dim=0).squeeze().cpu().numpy()
1273    else:
1274        x_ntc = np.mean(cis_mu_ntc, axis=0).squeeze()
1275
1276    # Handle case where x_ntc is a scalar or 1-element array
1277    if np.ndim(x_ntc) == 0:
1278        x_ntc = float(x_ntc)
1279    elif len(x_ntc) == 1:
1280        x_ntc = float(x_ntc[0])
1281    else:
1282        x_ntc = float(x_ntc[0])  # Take first if multiple (shouldn't happen for cis)
1283
1284    # Trans NTC (for y-axis transformation)
1285    if modality_name is None:
1286        modality_name = model.primary_modality
1287    trans_mod = model.get_modality(modality_name)
1288
1289    if not hasattr(trans_mod, 'posterior_samples_ntc'):
1290        return None, None, None, None, None
1291
1292    trans_mu_ntc = trans_mod.posterior_samples_ntc.get('mu_ntc', None)
1293    if trans_mu_ntc is None:
1294        return None, None, None, None, None
1295
1296    if hasattr(trans_mu_ntc, 'mean'):
1297        y_ntc_all = trans_mu_ntc.mean(dim=0).squeeze().cpu().numpy()
1298    else:
1299        y_ntc_all = np.mean(trans_mu_ntc, axis=0).squeeze()
1300
1301    # Find the feature index to get the right NTC
1302    # trans_mod.feature_names is the single source of truth (resolved +
1303    # deduped in Modality.__init__), no need to re-derive it here.
1304    feature_list = trans_mod.feature_names
1305
1306    if feature_list is None or feature not in feature_list:
1307        return None, None, None, None, None
1308
1309    feature_idx = feature_list.index(feature)
1310    y_ntc = float(y_ntc_all[feature_idx]) if np.ndim(y_ntc_all) > 0 else float(y_ntc_all)
1311
1312    # Compute log2FC transformations
1313    epsilon = 1e-10
1314    u_range = np.log2(np.maximum(x_range, epsilon)) - np.log2(max(x_ntc, epsilon))
1315    y_log2fc = np.log2(np.maximum(y_pred, epsilon)) - np.log2(max(y_ntc, epsilon))
1316
1317    if not return_derivatives:
1318        return y_log2fc, u_range, None, None, None
1319
1320    # Get S'(x), S''(x), and S'''(x)
1321    first_deriv, second_deriv, third_deriv = predict_trans_derivatives(
1322        model, feature, x_range, modality_name=modality_name,
1323        fdr_threshold=fdr_threshold, fdr_df=fdr_df
1324    )
1325    if first_deriv is None:
1326        return y_log2fc, u_range, None, None, None
1327
1328    # Compute log2FC derivatives
1329    first_deriv_log2fc = log2fc_first_derivative(x_range, y_pred, first_deriv, epsilon)
1330    second_deriv_log2fc = log2fc_second_derivative(x_range, y_pred, first_deriv, second_deriv, epsilon)
1331    third_deriv_log2fc = log2fc_third_derivative(x_range, y_pred, first_deriv, second_deriv, third_deriv, epsilon)
1332
1333    return y_log2fc, u_range, first_deriv_log2fc, second_deriv_log2fc, third_deriv_log2fc
1334
1335
1336def predict_trans_log2fc_samples(
1337    model,
1338    feature: str,
1339    x_range: np.ndarray,
1340    modality_name: Optional[str] = None,
1341    max_samples: Optional[int] = None,
1342    fdr_threshold: float = 0.05,
1343    fdr_df: Optional["pd.DataFrame"] = None,
1344) -> Tuple[Optional[np.ndarray], Optional[np.ndarray]]:
1345    """
1346    Compute trans effect function in log2FC space for all posterior samples.
1347
1348    Parameters
1349    ----------
1350    model : bayesDREAM
1351        Model with fit_trans() completed
1352    feature : str
1353        Feature name (trans gene) to predict
1354    x_range : np.ndarray
1355        X values (cis expression, NOT log-transformed)
1356    modality_name : str, optional
1357        Modality name (default: primary modality)
1358    max_samples : int, optional
1359        Maximum number of samples to return
1360    fdr_threshold : float, default 0.05
1361        FDR-inactive components are gated to zero; see predict_trans_function.
1362    fdr_df : pd.DataFrame, optional
1363        Precomputed trans_summary DataFrame to source activity calls from.
1364
1365    Returns
1366    -------
1367    Tuple of (y_log2fc_samples, u_range)
1368        - y_log2fc_samples: [n_samples, n_points] log2FC predictions for each posterior sample
1369        - u_range: [n_points] log2FC of cis gene relative to NTC
1370        Both are None if computation fails
1371    """
1372    # Get all posterior samples for S(x)
1373    y_samples = predict_trans_function_samples(
1374        model, feature, x_range, modality_name=modality_name, max_samples=max_samples,
1375        fdr_threshold=fdr_threshold, fdr_df=fdr_df
1376    )
1377    if y_samples is None:
1378        return None, None
1379
1380    # Get NTC means (same logic as predict_trans_log2fc)
1381    cis_mod = model.get_modality('cis')
1382    if cis_mod is None or not hasattr(cis_mod, 'posterior_samples_ntc'):
1383        return None, None
1384
1385    cis_mu_ntc = cis_mod.posterior_samples_ntc.get('mu_ntc', None)
1386    if cis_mu_ntc is None:
1387        return None, None
1388
1389    if hasattr(cis_mu_ntc, 'mean'):
1390        x_ntc = cis_mu_ntc.mean(dim=0).squeeze().cpu().numpy()
1391    else:
1392        x_ntc = np.mean(cis_mu_ntc, axis=0).squeeze()
1393
1394    if np.ndim(x_ntc) == 0:
1395        x_ntc = float(x_ntc)
1396    elif len(x_ntc) == 1:
1397        x_ntc = float(x_ntc[0])
1398    else:
1399        x_ntc = float(x_ntc[0])
1400
1401    # Trans NTC
1402    if modality_name is None:
1403        modality_name = model.primary_modality
1404    trans_mod = model.get_modality(modality_name)
1405
1406    if not hasattr(trans_mod, 'posterior_samples_ntc'):
1407        return None, None
1408
1409    trans_mu_ntc = trans_mod.posterior_samples_ntc.get('mu_ntc', None)
1410    if trans_mu_ntc is None:
1411        return None, None
1412
1413    if hasattr(trans_mu_ntc, 'mean'):
1414        y_ntc_all = trans_mu_ntc.mean(dim=0).squeeze().cpu().numpy()
1415    else:
1416        y_ntc_all = np.mean(trans_mu_ntc, axis=0).squeeze()
1417
1418    # Find feature index
1419    # trans_mod.feature_names is the single source of truth (resolved +
1420    # deduped in Modality.__init__), no need to re-derive it here.
1421    feature_list = trans_mod.feature_names
1422
1423    if feature_list is None or feature not in feature_list:
1424        return None, None
1425
1426    feature_idx = feature_list.index(feature)
1427    y_ntc = float(y_ntc_all[feature_idx]) if np.ndim(y_ntc_all) > 0 else float(y_ntc_all)
1428
1429    # Compute log2FC transformations for all samples
1430    epsilon = 1e-10
1431    u_range = np.log2(np.maximum(x_range, epsilon)) - np.log2(max(x_ntc, epsilon))
1432
1433    # Transform each sample: log2(y_sample) - log2(y_ntc)
1434    y_log2fc_samples = np.log2(np.maximum(y_samples, epsilon)) - np.log2(max(y_ntc, epsilon))
1435
1436    return y_log2fc_samples, u_range
1437

1439def predict_trans_delta_p(
1440    model,
1441    feature: str,
1442    x_range: np.ndarray,
1443    modality_name: Optional[str] = None,
1444    return_derivatives: bool = True,
1445    fdr_threshold: float = 0.05,
1446    fdr_df: Optional["pd.DataFrame"] = None,
1447) -> Tuple[Optional[np.ndarray], Optional[np.ndarray], Optional[np.ndarray], Optional[np.ndarray], Optional[np.ndarray]]:
1448    """
1449    Compute trans effect function in delta_p (probability difference) space for binomial modalities.
1450
1451    Transforms:
1452    - x-axis: u = log2(x) - log2(x_ntc)  (cis gene log2FC)
1453    - y-axis: delta_p(u) = p(x(u)) - p_ntc  (probability difference from NTC)
1454
1455    Where x_ntc is the NTC mean for the cis gene, and p_ntc is the NTC probability for the trans feature.
1456
1457    Parameters
1458    ----------
1459    model : bayesDREAM
1460        Model with fit_trans() completed and posterior_samples_ntc available
1461    feature : str
1462        Feature name (trans gene/SJ) to predict
1463    x_range : np.ndarray
1464        X values (cis expression, NOT log-transformed)
1465    modality_name : str, optional
1466        Modality name (default: primary modality)
1467    return_derivatives : bool
1468        Whether to compute and return derivatives (default: True)
1469        Note: derivatives are dp/du, d²p/du², d³p/du³ (probability space)
1470
1471    Returns
1472    -------
1473    Tuple of (delta_p, u_range, first_deriv, second_deriv, third_deriv)
1474        - delta_p: probability difference from NTC (p - p_ntc)
1475        - u_range: log2FC of cis gene relative to NTC
1476        - first_deriv: dp/du (None if return_derivatives=False)
1477        - second_deriv: d²p/du² (None if return_derivatives=False)
1478        - third_deriv: d³p/du³ (None if return_derivatives=False)
1479        All are None if computation fails
1480    """
1481    # Get p(x) - the probability values from fitted function
1482    y_pred = predict_trans_function(model, feature, x_range, modality_name=modality_name,
1483                                     fdr_threshold=fdr_threshold, fdr_df=fdr_df)
1484    if y_pred is None:
1485        return None, None, None, None, None
1486
1487    # Get NTC means
1488    # Cis NTC (for x-axis transformation)
1489    cis_mod = model.get_modality('cis')
1490    if cis_mod is None or not hasattr(cis_mod, 'posterior_samples_ntc'):
1491        return None, None, None, None, None
1492
1493    cis_mu_ntc = cis_mod.posterior_samples_ntc.get('mu_ntc', None)
1494    if cis_mu_ntc is None:
1495        return None, None, None, None, None
1496
1497    if hasattr(cis_mu_ntc, 'mean'):
1498        x_ntc = cis_mu_ntc.mean(dim=0).squeeze().cpu().numpy()
1499    else:
1500        x_ntc = np.mean(cis_mu_ntc, axis=0).squeeze()
1501
1502    # Handle case where x_ntc is a scalar or 1-element array
1503    if np.ndim(x_ntc) == 0:
1504        x_ntc = float(x_ntc)
1505    elif len(x_ntc) == 1:
1506        x_ntc = float(x_ntc[0])
1507    else:
1508        x_ntc = float(x_ntc[0])  # Take first if multiple
1509
1510    # Trans NTC (for y-axis transformation)
1511    if modality_name is None:
1512        modality_name = model.primary_modality
1513    trans_mod = model.get_modality(modality_name)
1514
1515    if not hasattr(trans_mod, 'posterior_samples_ntc'):
1516        return None, None, None, None, None
1517
1518    trans_mu_ntc = trans_mod.posterior_samples_ntc.get('mu_ntc', None)
1519    if trans_mu_ntc is None:
1520        return None, None, None, None, None
1521
1522    if hasattr(trans_mu_ntc, 'mean'):
1523        y_ntc_all = trans_mu_ntc.mean(dim=0).squeeze().cpu().numpy()
1524    else:
1525        y_ntc_all = np.mean(trans_mu_ntc, axis=0).squeeze()
1526
1527    # Find the feature index to get the right NTC
1528    # trans_mod.feature_names is the single source of truth (resolved +
1529    # deduped in Modality.__init__), no need to re-derive it here.
1530    feature_list = trans_mod.feature_names
1531
1532    if feature_list is None or feature not in feature_list:
1533        return None, None, None, None, None
1534
1535    feature_idx = feature_list.index(feature)
1536    p_ntc = float(y_ntc_all[feature_idx]) if np.ndim(y_ntc_all) > 0 else float(y_ntc_all)
1537
1538    # Compute delta_p transformation
1539    epsilon = 1e-10
1540    u_range = np.log2(np.maximum(x_range, epsilon)) - np.log2(max(x_ntc, epsilon))
1541    delta_p = y_pred - p_ntc  # Simple difference for probability space
1542
1543    if not return_derivatives:
1544        return delta_p, u_range, None, None, None
1545
1546    # Get dp/dx derivatives
1547    first_deriv_dx, second_deriv_dx, third_deriv_dx = predict_trans_derivatives(
1548        model, feature, x_range, modality_name=modality_name,
1549        fdr_threshold=fdr_threshold, fdr_df=fdr_df
1550    )
1551    if first_deriv_dx is None:
1552        return delta_p, u_range, None, None, None
1553
1554    # Convert dp/dx to dp/du using chain rule:
1555    # u = log2(x) - log2(x_ntc)
1556    # du/dx = 1/(x * ln(2))
1557    # dx/du = x * ln(2)
1558    # dp/du = dp/dx * dx/du = dp/dx * x * ln(2)
1559    ln2 = np.log(2.0)
1560    x_safe = np.maximum(x_range, epsilon)
1561
1562    # First derivative: dp/du = ln(2) * x * dp/dx
1563    first_deriv = ln2 * x_safe * first_deriv_dx
1564
1565    # Second derivative: d²p/du² = (ln2)² * x * (dp/dx + x * d²p/dx²)
1566    second_deriv = ln2**2 * x_safe * (first_deriv_dx + x_safe * second_deriv_dx)
1567
1568    # Third derivative: d³p/du³ = (ln2)³ * x * (dp/dx + 3x * d²p/dx² + x² * d³p/dx³)
1569    third_deriv = ln2**3 * x_safe * (first_deriv_dx + 3 * x_safe * second_deriv_dx
1570                                      + x_safe**2 * third_deriv_dx)
1571
1572    return delta_p, u_range, first_deriv, second_deriv, third_deriv
1573
1574
1575def predict_trans_delta_p_samples(
1576    model,
1577    feature: str,
1578    x_range: np.ndarray,
1579    modality_name: Optional[str] = None,
1580    max_samples: Optional[int] = None,
1581    fdr_threshold: float = 0.05,
1582    fdr_df: Optional["pd.DataFrame"] = None,
1583) -> Tuple[Optional[np.ndarray], Optional[np.ndarray]]:
1584    """
1585    Compute trans effect function in delta_p space for all posterior samples.
1586
1587    Parameters
1588    ----------
1589    model : bayesDREAM
1590        Model with fit_trans() completed
1591    feature : str
1592        Feature name (trans gene/SJ) to predict
1593    x_range : np.ndarray
1594        X values (cis expression, NOT log-transformed)
1595    modality_name : str, optional
1596        Modality name (default: primary modality)
1597    max_samples : int, optional
1598        Maximum number of samples to return
1599    fdr_threshold : float, default 0.05
1600        FDR-inactive components are gated to zero; see predict_trans_function.
1601    fdr_df : pd.DataFrame, optional
1602        Precomputed trans_summary DataFrame to source activity calls from.
1603
1604    Returns
1605    -------
1606    Tuple of (delta_p_samples, u_range)
1607        - delta_p_samples: [n_samples, n_points] delta_p predictions for each posterior sample
1608        - u_range: [n_points] log2FC of cis gene relative to NTC
1609        Both are None if computation fails
1610    """
1611    # Get all posterior samples for p(x)
1612    y_samples = predict_trans_function_samples(
1613        model, feature, x_range, modality_name=modality_name, max_samples=max_samples,
1614        fdr_threshold=fdr_threshold, fdr_df=fdr_df
1615    )
1616    if y_samples is None:
1617        return None, None
1618
1619    # Get NTC means (same logic as predict_trans_delta_p)
1620    cis_mod = model.get_modality('cis')
1621    if cis_mod is None or not hasattr(cis_mod, 'posterior_samples_ntc'):
1622        return None, None
1623
1624    cis_mu_ntc = cis_mod.posterior_samples_ntc.get('mu_ntc', None)
1625    if cis_mu_ntc is None:
1626        return None, None
1627
1628    if hasattr(cis_mu_ntc, 'mean'):
1629        x_ntc = cis_mu_ntc.mean(dim=0).squeeze().cpu().numpy()
1630    else:
1631        x_ntc = np.mean(cis_mu_ntc, axis=0).squeeze()
1632
1633    if np.ndim(x_ntc) == 0:
1634        x_ntc = float(x_ntc)
1635    elif len(x_ntc) == 1:
1636        x_ntc = float(x_ntc[0])
1637    else:
1638        x_ntc = float(x_ntc[0])
1639
1640    # Trans NTC
1641    if modality_name is None:
1642        modality_name = model.primary_modality
1643    trans_mod = model.get_modality(modality_name)
1644
1645    if not hasattr(trans_mod, 'posterior_samples_ntc'):
1646        return None, None
1647
1648    trans_mu_ntc = trans_mod.posterior_samples_ntc.get('mu_ntc', None)
1649    if trans_mu_ntc is None:
1650        return None, None
1651
1652    if hasattr(trans_mu_ntc, 'mean'):
1653        y_ntc_all = trans_mu_ntc.mean(dim=0).squeeze().cpu().numpy()
1654    else:
1655        y_ntc_all = np.mean(trans_mu_ntc, axis=0).squeeze()
1656
1657    # Find feature index
1658    # trans_mod.feature_names is the single source of truth (resolved +
1659    # deduped in Modality.__init__), no need to re-derive it here.
1660    feature_list = trans_mod.feature_names
1661
1662    if feature_list is None or feature not in feature_list:
1663        return None, None
1664
1665    feature_idx = feature_list.index(feature)
1666    p_ntc = float(y_ntc_all[feature_idx]) if np.ndim(y_ntc_all) > 0 else float(y_ntc_all)
1667
1668    # Compute delta_p transformations for all samples
1669    epsilon = 1e-10
1670    u_range = np.log2(np.maximum(x_range, epsilon)) - np.log2(max(x_ntc, epsilon))
1671
1672    # Transform each sample: p_sample - p_ntc
1673    delta_p_samples = y_samples - p_ntc
1674
1675    return delta_p_samples, u_range
