1678def plot_trans_functions(
1679    model,
1680    features: Union[str, List[str]],
1681    modality_name: Optional[str] = None,
1682    show_function: bool = True,
1683    show_first_derivative: bool = False,
1684    show_second_derivative: bool = False,
1685    show_third_derivative: bool = False,
1686    x_range: Optional[np.ndarray] = None,
1687    n_points: int = 2000,
1688    use_log2_x: bool = True,
1689    use_log2fc: bool = False,
1690    use_delta_p: bool = False,
1691    show_posterior_samples: bool = False,
1692    show_ci: bool = False,
1693    posterior_alpha: float = 0.1,
1694    ci_alpha: float = 0.3,
1695    max_posterior_samples: int = 1000,
1696    colors: Optional[Union[str, List[str], Dict[str, str]]] = None,
1697    alpha: float = 0.8,
1698    linewidth: float = 1.5,
1699    figsize: Optional[Tuple[float, float]] = None,
1700    title: Optional[str] = None,
1701    legend: bool = True,
1702    ax: Optional[plt.Axes] = None,
1703    overlay_roots=None,
1704    overlay_roots_lw: float = 1.0,
1705    overlay_roots_alpha: float = 0.8,
1706    overlay_roots_also_on_function: bool = True,
1707    fdr_threshold: float = 0.05,
1708    fdr_df: Optional["pd.DataFrame"] = None,
1709) -> plt.Figure:
1710    """
1711    Plot fitted trans functions and/or their derivatives.
1712
1713    Simple plot showing just the fitted Hill functions (no smoothed data).
1714    Useful for comparing multiple genes or viewing function shape with derivatives.
1715
1716    Parameters
1717    ----------
1718    model : bayesDREAM
1719        Model with fit_trans() completed
1720    features : str or list of str
1721        Single feature name or list of feature names to plot
1722    modality_name : str, optional
1723        Modality name (default: primary modality)
1724    show_function : bool
1725        Show the fitted function y(x) (default: True)
1726    show_first_derivative : bool
1727        Show first derivative dy/dx (default: False)
1728    show_second_derivative : bool
1729        Show second derivative d²y/dx² (default: False)
1730    show_third_derivative : bool
1731        Show second derivative d3y/dx3 (default: False)
1732    x_range : np.ndarray, optional
1733        X values to plot at. If None, generates evenly spaced points in log2 space
1734        from model's x_true range.
1735    n_points : int
1736        Number of points for x_range if auto-generated (default: 2000).
1737        Points are evenly spaced in log2 space for smooth curves on log-log plots.
1738    use_log2_x : bool
1739        Use log2(x) for x-axis (default: True). Ignored if use_log2fc=True.
1740    use_log2fc : bool
1741        If True, plot in log2 fold-change space relative to NTC (default: False).
1742        - x-axis: log2FC = log2(x) - log2(x_ntc) where x_ntc is cis gene NTC mean
1743        - y-axis: log2FC = log2(y) - log2(y_ntc) where y_ntc is trans gene NTC mean
1744        - Derivatives: dg/du and d²g/du² (chain rule transformed)
1745        Requires posterior_samples_ntc to be available for both cis and trans modalities.
1746        Not recommended for binomial modalities (use use_delta_p instead).
1747    use_delta_p : bool
1748        If True, plot in probability difference space relative to NTC (default: False).
1749        Designed for binomial modalities (e.g., splicing_sj).
1750        - x-axis: log2FC = log2(x) - log2(x_ntc) where x_ntc is cis gene NTC mean
1751        - y-axis: Δp = p - p_ntc where p is probability and p_ntc is NTC probability
1752        - Derivatives: dp/du and d²p/du² (chain rule transformed)
1753        Requires posterior_samples_ntc to be available for both cis and trans modalities.
1754        Mutually exclusive with use_log2fc.
1755    show_posterior_samples : bool
1756        If True, plot individual posterior fits behind the mean line (default: False).
1757        Each posterior sample is plotted with transparency set by `posterior_alpha`.
1758    show_ci : bool
1759        If True, show 95% credible interval band around the mean line (default: False).
1760        The CI is computed at each x point and shown as a shaded region.
1761    posterior_alpha : float
1762        Transparency for individual posterior sample lines (default: 0.1).
1763        Only used when show_posterior_samples=True.
1764    ci_alpha : float
1765        Transparency for the 95% CI shaded region (default: 0.3).
1766        Only used when show_ci=True.
1767    max_posterior_samples : int
1768        Maximum number of posterior samples to plot (default: 1000).
1769        Only used when show_posterior_samples=True.
1770    colors : str, list, or dict, optional
1771        Colors for each feature. Can be:
1772        - Single color string (all features same color)
1773        - List of colors (one per feature)
1774        - Dict mapping feature names to colors
1775        If None, uses default color cycle.
1776    alpha : float
1777        Line transparency (default: 0.8)
1778    linewidth : float
1779        Line width (default: 1.5)
1780    figsize : tuple, optional
1781        Figure size (width, height). Auto-sized if None.
1782    title : str, optional
1783        Plot title. If None, auto-generated.
1784    legend : bool
1785        Show legend (default: True)
1786    ax : plt.Axes, optional
1787        Existing axes to plot on. If None, creates new figure.
1788    overlay_roots : pd.DataFrame, pd.Series, dict, or None
1789        If provided, draws dashed vertical lines at derivative roots on each
1790        subplot.  Accepted forms:
1791
1792        - **pd.DataFrame** (full summary from ``save_trans_summary``): for each
1793          feature being plotted, the matching row is looked up by the ``feature``
1794          column.
1795        - **pd.Series / dict** (a single row): used as-is for every feature.
1796        - **None** (default): no overlay.
1797
1798        Root columns are selected automatically to match the plot's x-axis space:
1799        ``*_log2fc_mean`` when ``use_log2fc=True``, ``*_delta_p_mean`` when
1800        ``use_delta_p=True``, and ``*_mean`` (x-space, converted to log2 if
1801        ``use_log2_x=True``) otherwise.
1802    overlay_roots_lw : float
1803        Line width for root vlines (default 1.0).
1804    overlay_roots_alpha : float
1805        Transparency for root vlines (default 0.8).
1806    overlay_roots_also_on_function : bool
1807        If True (default), draw all root sets also on the function subplot.
1808    fdr_threshold : float, default 0.05
1809        For additive_hill: FDR-inactive components (q-value >= fdr_threshold) are
1810        gated to zero in the plotted curve/derivatives, consistent with
1811        _compute_hill_markers, predict_hill_from_summary_row, and
1812        save_trans_summary's point estimates.
1813    fdr_df : pd.DataFrame, optional
1814        Precomputed trans_summary DataFrame to source activity calls from, instead
1815        of recomputing Bayesian FDR live from the posterior for each feature.
1816
1817    Returns
1818    -------
1819    plt.Figure
1820        Matplotlib figure
1821
1822    Raises
1823    ------
1824    ValueError
1825        If function type is polynomial (derivatives not supported)
1826        If no features could be plotted
1827        If use_log2fc=True but NTC means not available
1828        If use_delta_p=True but NTC means not available
1829        If both use_log2fc and use_delta_p are True (mutually exclusive)
1830
1831    Examples
1832    --------
1833    >>> # Plot function and derivatives for one gene
1834    >>> model.plot_trans_functions('TET2', show_first_derivative=True,
1835    ...                            show_second_derivative=True)
1836
1837    >>> # Plot with derivative roots overlaid from summary df
1838    >>> df = model.save_trans_summary(compute_derivative_roots=True)
1839    >>> model.plot_trans_functions('TET2', use_log2fc=True,
1840    ...                            show_function=True,
1841    ...                            show_first_derivative=True,
1842    ...                            show_second_derivative=True,
1843    ...                            show_third_derivative=True,
1844    ...                            overlay_roots=df)
1845
1846    >>> # Plot first derivative of multiple genes
1847    >>> model.plot_trans_functions(['TET2', 'MYB', 'GFI1B'],
1848    ...                            show_function=False,
1849    ...                            show_first_derivative=True)
1850
1851    >>> # Plot all non-monotonic genes (genes where derivative changes sign)
1852    >>> feature_names = model.get_modality(model.primary_modality).feature_names
1853    >>> non_monotonic = [g for g in feature_names if is_non_monotonic(model, g)]
1854    >>> model.plot_trans_functions(non_monotonic, show_first_derivative=True)
1855    """
1856    import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
1857
1858    # Ensure at least one thing to plot
1859    if not (show_function or show_first_derivative or show_second_derivative or show_third_derivative):
1860        raise ValueError("At least one of show_function, show_first_derivative, "
1861                        "show_second_derivative, or show_third_derivative must be True")
1862
1863    # Validate mutually exclusive options
1864    if use_log2fc and use_delta_p:
1865        raise ValueError("use_log2fc and use_delta_p are mutually exclusive. "
1866                        "Use use_log2fc for negbinom modalities, use_delta_p for binomial modalities.")
1867
1868    # Convert single feature to list
1869    if isinstance(features, str):
1870        features = [features]
1871
1872    # Determine modality
1873    if modality_name is None:
1874        modality_name = model.primary_modality
1875
1876    # Get x_range from model if not provided
1877    if x_range is None:
1878        if hasattr(model, 'x_true') and model.x_true is not None:
1879            x_true_np = model.x_true.cpu().numpy() if hasattr(model.x_true, 'cpu') else np.array(model.x_true)
1880            if x_true_np.ndim > 1:
1881                x_true_np = x_true_np.mean(axis=0)  # Average over posterior samples
1882            x_min = max(x_true_np.min(), 1e-6)  # Avoid log(0)
1883            x_max = x_true_np.max()
1884            # Evenly spaced points in log2 space for smooth curve on log-log plot
1885            log2_min = np.log2(x_min)
1886            log2_max = np.log2(x_max)
1887            x_range = 2 ** np.linspace(log2_min, log2_max, n_points)
1888        else:
1889            raise ValueError("x_range must be provided if model.x_true is not set")
1890
1891    # Check if NTC data is available for log2FC/delta_p; fall back to log2 if not
1892    if use_log2fc or use_delta_p:
1893        cis_mod = model.get_modality('cis')
1894        ntc_available = (
1895            cis_mod is not None
1896            and hasattr(cis_mod, 'posterior_samples_ntc')
1897            and cis_mod.posterior_samples_ntc is not None
1898            and 'mu_ntc' in cis_mod.posterior_samples_ntc
1899        )
1900        if not ntc_available:
1901            import warnings
1902            flag = 'use_log2fc' if use_log2fc else 'use_delta_p'
1903            warnings.warn(
1904                f"{flag}=True requested but NTC technical fit (posterior_samples_ntc) "
1905                f"is not available. Falling back to log2(x) x-axis.",
1906                UserWarning
1907            )
1908            use_log2fc = False
1909            use_delta_p = False
1910            use_log2_x = True
1911
1912    # Setup colors
1913    if colors is None:
1914        color_cycle = plt.rcParams['axes.prop_cycle'].by_key()['color']
1915        colors_list = [color_cycle[i % len(color_cycle)] for i in range(len(features))]
1916    elif isinstance(colors, str):
1917        colors_list = [colors] * len(features)
1918    elif isinstance(colors, dict):
1919        colors_list = [colors.get(f, 'gray') for f in features]
1920    else:
1921        colors_list = list(colors)
1922
1923    # Count how many subplots we need
1924    n_plots = sum([show_function, show_first_derivative, show_second_derivative, show_third_derivative])
1925
1926    # Create figure if no axes provided
1927    if ax is None:
1928        if figsize is None:
1929            figsize = (5 * n_plots, 4)
1930        fig, axes = plt.subplots(1, n_plots, figsize=figsize, squeeze=False)
1931        axes = axes[0]  # Flatten to 1D
1932    else:
1933        if n_plots > 1:
1934            raise ValueError("Cannot use single ax with multiple subplots. "
1935                           "Pass ax=None to create new figure.")
1936        fig = ax.figure
1937        axes = [ax]
1938
1939    # Track which plot index we're on
1940    plot_idx = 0
1941    plot_types = []
1942
1943    # Set up plot types with appropriate labels
1944    if use_log2fc:
1945        if show_function:
1946            plot_types.append(('function', 'log₂FC (y)'))
1947        if show_first_derivative:
1948            plot_types.append(('first_deriv', "dg/du"))
1949        if show_second_derivative:
1950            plot_types.append(('second_deriv', "d²g/du²"))
1951        if show_third_derivative:
1952            plot_types.append(('third_deriv', "d³g/du³"))
1953    elif use_delta_p:
1954        if show_function:
1955            plot_types.append(('function', 'Δp'))
1956        if show_first_derivative:
1957            plot_types.append(('first_deriv', "dp/du"))
1958        if show_second_derivative:
1959            plot_types.append(('second_deriv', "d²p/du²"))
1960        if show_third_derivative:
1961            plot_types.append(('third_deriv', "d³p/du³"))
1962    else:
1963        if show_function:
1964            plot_types.append(('function', 'y'))
1965        if show_first_derivative:
1966            plot_types.append(('first_deriv', "dy/dx"))
1967        if show_second_derivative:
1968            plot_types.append(('second_deriv', "d²y/dx²"))
1969        if show_third_derivative:
1970            plot_types.append(('third_deriv', "d³y/dx³"))
1971
1972    # Track successful plots
1973    successful_features = []
1974
1975    for feat_idx, feature in enumerate(features):
1976        color = colors_list[feat_idx % len(colors_list)]
1977
1978        # Get function and derivatives (mean values)
1979        try:
1980            if use_log2fc:
1981                # Get log2FC transformed values
1982                y_log2fc, u_range, first_deriv, second_deriv, third_deriv = predict_trans_log2fc(
1983                    model, feature, x_range, modality_name=modality_name, return_derivatives=True,
1984                    fdr_threshold=fdr_threshold, fdr_df=fdr_df
1985                )
1986                if y_log2fc is None:
1987                    continue
1988                y_pred = y_log2fc
1989                x_plot_feat = u_range  # Use u (log2FC of x) for this feature
1990            elif use_delta_p:
1991                # Get delta_p transformed values (probability difference from NTC)
1992                delta_p, u_range, first_deriv, second_deriv, third_deriv = predict_trans_delta_p(
1993                    model, feature, x_range, modality_name=modality_name, return_derivatives=True,
1994                    fdr_threshold=fdr_threshold, fdr_df=fdr_df
1995                )
1996                if delta_p is None:
1997                    continue
1998                y_pred = delta_p
1999                x_plot_feat = u_range  # Use u (log2FC of x) for this feature
2000            else:
2001                y_pred = predict_trans_function(model, feature, x_range, modality_name=modality_name,
2002                                                 fdr_threshold=fdr_threshold, fdr_df=fdr_df)
2003                first_deriv, second_deriv, third_deriv = predict_trans_derivatives(
2004                    model, feature, x_range, modality_name=modality_name,
2005                    fdr_threshold=fdr_threshold, fdr_df=fdr_df
2006                )
2007                # X values for plotting (same for all features when not using log2fc/delta_p)
2008                x_plot_feat = np.log2(x_range) if use_log2_x else x_range
2009        except ValueError as e:
2010            # Polynomial not supported
2011            raise e
2012
2013        if y_pred is None and first_deriv is None:
2014            continue  # Skip features that couldn't be computed
2015
2016        successful_features.append(feature)
2017
2018        # Get posterior samples if needed for uncertainty visualization
2019        y_samples = None
2020        first_deriv_samples = None
2021        second_deriv_samples = None
2022        third_deriv_samples = None
2023
2024        if show_posterior_samples or show_ci:
2025            # Get derivative samples if we need them
2026            need_derivs = show_first_derivative or show_second_derivative or show_third_derivative
2027
2028            if use_delta_p:
2029                # Get function samples in delta_p space
2030                if show_function:
2031                    delta_p_samples, _ = predict_trans_delta_p_samples(
2032                        model, feature, x_range,
2033                        modality_name=modality_name,
2034                        max_samples=max_posterior_samples,
2035                        fdr_threshold=fdr_threshold, fdr_df=fdr_df
2036                    )
2037                    y_samples = delta_p_samples
2038
2039                # For derivatives in delta_p mode, we need p(x), dp/dx samples
2040                # then transform using chain rule: dp/du = x * ln(2) * dp/dx
2041                if need_derivs:
2042                    S_samples, dS_samples, d2S_samples, d3S_samples = predict_trans_derivatives_samples(
2043                        model, feature, x_range,
2044                        modality_name=modality_name,
2045                        max_samples=max_posterior_samples,
2046                        fdr_threshold=fdr_threshold, fdr_df=fdr_df
2047                    )
2048                    if S_samples is not None and dS_samples is not None:
2049                        # Transform derivatives to delta_p u-space using chain rule
2050                        # dp/du = x * ln(2) * dp/dx
2051                        # d²p/du² = ln(2) * (x * dp/dx + x² * ln(2) * d²p/dx²)
2052                        epsilon = 1e-10
2053                        ln2 = np.log(2)
2054
2055                        # First derivative: dp/du = ln(2) * x * dp/dx
2056                        first_deriv_samples = ln2 * x_range[np.newaxis, :] * dS_samples
2057
2058                        # Second derivative: d²p/du² = (ln2)² * x * (dp/dx + x * d²p/dx²)
2059                        if d2S_samples is not None:
2060                            x_arr = x_range[np.newaxis, :]
2061                            second_deriv_samples = (ln2**2) * x_arr * (dS_samples + x_arr * d2S_samples)
2062
2063                        # Third derivative: d³p/du³ = (ln2)³ * x * (dp/dx + 3x*d²p/dx² + x²*d³p/dx³)
2064                        if d3S_samples is not None and d2S_samples is not None:
2065                            x_arr = x_range[np.newaxis, :]
2066                            third_deriv_samples = (ln2**3) * x_arr * (dS_samples + 3 * x_arr * d2S_samples
2067                                                                       + x_arr**2 * d3S_samples)
2068
2069            elif use_log2fc:
2070                # Get function samples in log2FC space
2071                if show_function:
2072                    y_log2fc_samples, _ = predict_trans_log2fc_samples(
2073                        model, feature, x_range,
2074                        modality_name=modality_name,
2075                        max_samples=max_posterior_samples,
2076                        fdr_threshold=fdr_threshold, fdr_df=fdr_df
2077                    )
2078                    y_samples = y_log2fc_samples
2079
2080                # For derivatives in log2FC mode, we need S(x), S'(x), S''(x), S'''(x) samples
2081                # then transform using chain rule
2082                if need_derivs:
2083                    S_samples, dS_samples, d2S_samples, d3S_samples = predict_trans_derivatives_samples(
2084                        model, feature, x_range,
2085                        modality_name=modality_name,
2086                        max_samples=max_posterior_samples,
2087                        fdr_threshold=fdr_threshold, fdr_df=fdr_df
2088                    )
2089                    if S_samples is not None and dS_samples is not None:
2090                        # Transform derivatives to log2FC space using chain rule
2091                        # dg/du = x * S'(x) / S(x)
2092                        # d²g/du² = ln(2) * (x * S'/S + x² * S''/S - x² * (S'/S)²)
2093                        epsilon = 1e-10
2094                        S_safe = np.maximum(np.abs(S_samples), epsilon)
2095                        ln2 = np.log(2)
2096
2097                        # First derivative: dg/du = x * S'(x) / S(x)
2098                        first_deriv_samples = x_range[np.newaxis, :] * dS_samples / S_safe
2099
2100                        # Second derivative: d²g/du² = ln(2) * (x*S'/S + x²*S''/S - x²*(S'/S)²)
2101                        if d2S_samples is not None:
2102                            term1 = x_range[np.newaxis, :] * dS_samples / S_safe
2103                            term2 = (x_range[np.newaxis, :] ** 2) * d2S_samples / S_safe
2104                            term3 = (x_range[np.newaxis, :] ** 2) * (dS_samples / S_safe) ** 2
2105                            second_deriv_samples = ln2 * (term1 + term2 - term3)
2106
2107                        # Third derivative: d³g/du³ = (ln(2))² * [x*S'/S + 3x²*S''/S - 3x²*(S'/S)²
2108                        #                                         + x³*S'''/S - 3x³*(S'/S)*(S''/S) + 2x³*(S'/S)³]
2109                        if d3S_samples is not None and d2S_samples is not None:
2110                            term1 = x_range[np.newaxis, :] * (dS_samples / S_safe)
2111                            term2 = 3 * (x_range[np.newaxis, :] ** 2) * d2S_samples / S_safe
2112                            term3 = -3 * (x_range[np.newaxis, :] ** 2) * (dS_samples / S_safe) ** 2
2113                            term4 = (x_range[np.newaxis, :] ** 3) * (d3S_samples / S_safe)
2114                            term5 = -3 * (x_range[np.newaxis, :] ** 3) * (dS_samples / S_safe) * d2S_samples / S_safe
2115                            term6 = 2 * (x_range[np.newaxis, :] ** 3) * (dS_samples / S_safe) ** 3
2116                            third_deriv_samples = (ln2**2) * (term1 + term2 + term3 + term4 + term5 + term6)
2117            else:
2118                # Non-log2FC mode
2119                if show_function:
2120                    y_samples = predict_trans_function_samples(
2121                        model, feature, x_range,
2122                        modality_name=modality_name,
2123                        max_samples=max_posterior_samples,
2124                        fdr_threshold=fdr_threshold, fdr_df=fdr_df
2125                    )
2126
2127                if need_derivs:
2128                    _, first_deriv_samples, second_deriv_samples, third_deriv_samples = predict_trans_derivatives_samples(
2129                        model, feature, x_range,
2130                        modality_name=modality_name,
2131                        max_samples=max_posterior_samples,
2132                        fdr_threshold=fdr_threshold, fdr_df=fdr_df
2133                    )
2134
2135        # Plot each requested type
2136        for plot_i, (plot_type, ylabel) in enumerate(plot_types):
2137            ax_curr = axes[plot_i]
2138
2139            if plot_type == 'function' and y_pred is not None:
2140                # Plot uncertainty visualization first (so mean line is on top)
2141                if y_samples is not None:
2142                    if show_posterior_samples:
2143                        for s in range(y_samples.shape[0]):
2144                            ax_curr.plot(x_plot_feat, y_samples[s, :], color=color,
2145                                       alpha=posterior_alpha, linewidth=0.5)
2146                    if show_ci:
2147                        y_lower = np.percentile(y_samples, 2.5, axis=0)
2148                        y_upper = np.percentile(y_samples, 97.5, axis=0)
2149                        ax_curr.fill_between(x_plot_feat, y_lower, y_upper,
2150                                           color=color, alpha=ci_alpha, linewidth=0)
2151
2152                # Plot mean line on top
2153                ax_curr.plot(x_plot_feat, y_pred, color=color, alpha=alpha,
2154                           linewidth=linewidth, label=feature if feat_idx < 20 else None)
2155
2156            elif plot_type == 'first_deriv' and first_deriv is not None:
2157                # Plot uncertainty for first derivative
2158                if first_deriv_samples is not None:
2159                    if show_posterior_samples:
2160                        for s in range(first_deriv_samples.shape[0]):
2161                            ax_curr.plot(x_plot_feat, first_deriv_samples[s, :], color=color,
2162                                       alpha=posterior_alpha, linewidth=0.5)
2163                    if show_ci:
2164                        d1_lower = np.percentile(first_deriv_samples, 2.5, axis=0)
2165                        d1_upper = np.percentile(first_deriv_samples, 97.5, axis=0)
2166                        ax_curr.fill_between(x_plot_feat, d1_lower, d1_upper,
2167                                           color=color, alpha=ci_alpha, linewidth=0)
2168
2169                ax_curr.plot(x_plot_feat, first_deriv, color=color, alpha=alpha,
2170                           linewidth=linewidth, label=feature if feat_idx < 20 else None)
2171
2172            elif plot_type == 'second_deriv' and second_deriv is not None:
2173                # Plot uncertainty for second derivative
2174                if second_deriv_samples is not None:
2175                    if show_posterior_samples:
2176                        for s in range(second_deriv_samples.shape[0]):
2177                            ax_curr.plot(x_plot_feat, second_deriv_samples[s, :], color=color,
2178                                       alpha=posterior_alpha, linewidth=0.5)
2179                    if show_ci:
2180                        d2_lower = np.percentile(second_deriv_samples, 2.5, axis=0)
2181                        d2_upper = np.percentile(second_deriv_samples, 97.5, axis=0)
2182                        ax_curr.fill_between(x_plot_feat, d2_lower, d2_upper,
2183                                           color=color, alpha=ci_alpha, linewidth=0)
2184
2185                ax_curr.plot(x_plot_feat, second_deriv, color=color, alpha=alpha,
2186                           linewidth=linewidth, label=feature if feat_idx < 20 else None)
2187
2188            elif plot_type == 'third_deriv' and third_deriv is not None:
2189                # Plot uncertainty for third derivative
2190                if third_deriv_samples is not None:
2191                    if show_posterior_samples:
2192                        for s in range(third_deriv_samples.shape[0]):
2193                            ax_curr.plot(x_plot_feat, third_deriv_samples[s, :], color=color,
2194                                       alpha=posterior_alpha, linewidth=0.5)
2195                    if show_ci:
2196                        d3_lower = np.percentile(third_deriv_samples, 2.5, axis=0)
2197                        d3_upper = np.percentile(third_deriv_samples, 97.5, axis=0)
2198                        ax_curr.fill_between(x_plot_feat, d3_lower, d3_upper,
2199                                           color=color, alpha=ci_alpha, linewidth=0)
2200
2201                ax_curr.plot(x_plot_feat, third_deriv, color=color, alpha=alpha,
2202                           linewidth=linewidth, label=feature if feat_idx < 20 else None)
2203
2204        # ---- Root overlay ------------------------------------------------
2205        if overlay_roots is not None:
2206            import pandas as _pd
2207            from bayesDREAM.io.summary import ModelSummarizer as _MS
2208
2209            # Resolve the row for this feature
2210            if isinstance(overlay_roots, _pd.DataFrame):
2211                if 'feature' in overlay_roots.columns:
2212                    _matches = overlay_roots[overlay_roots['feature'] == feature]
2213                    _row = _matches.iloc[0] if len(_matches) > 0 else None
2214                else:
2215                    _row = None
2216            else:
2217                # Series or dict — use directly for every feature
2218                _row = overlay_roots
2219
2220            if _row is not None:
2221                _parse = _MS._parse_semicolon_roots
2222
2223                if use_log2fc:
2224                    _r1 = _parse(_row.get('first_deriv_roots_log2fc_median',  None))
2225                    _r2 = _parse(_row.get('second_deriv_roots_log2fc_median', None))
2226                    _r3 = _parse(_row.get('third_deriv_roots_log2fc_median',  None))
2227                    _to_plot_x = lambda v: v  # already u-space
2228                elif use_delta_p:
2229                    _r1 = _parse(_row.get('first_deriv_roots_delta_p_median',  None))
2230                    _r2 = _parse(_row.get('second_deriv_roots_delta_p_median', None))
2231                    _r3 = _parse(_row.get('third_deriv_roots_delta_p_median',  None))
2232                    _to_plot_x = lambda v: v  # already u-space
2233                else:
2234                    _r1 = _parse(_row.get('first_deriv_roots_median',  None))
2235                    _r2 = _parse(_row.get('second_deriv_roots_median', None))
2236                    _r3 = _parse(_row.get('third_deriv_roots_median',  None))
2237                    _to_plot_x = (lambda v: np.log2(max(v, 1e-300))) if use_log2_x else (lambda v: v)
2238
2239                # Build a map: plot_type → (ax, roots, label)
2240                _ax_for = {pt: axes[i] for i, (pt, _) in enumerate(plot_types)}
2241                _root_sets = [
2242                    ('first_deriv',  _r1, 'roots: 1st deriv'),
2243                    ('second_deriv', _r2, 'roots: 2nd deriv'),
2244                    ('third_deriv',  _r3, 'roots: 3rd deriv'),
2245                ]
2246
2247                def _draw_vlines(ax, roots, label):
2248                    first = True
2249                    for v in roots:
2250                        xv = _to_plot_x(v)
2251                        if np.isfinite(xv):
2252                            ax.axvline(xv, linestyle='--',
2253                                       linewidth=overlay_roots_lw,
2254                                       alpha=overlay_roots_alpha,
2255                                       label=(label if first else None))
2256                            first = False
2257
2258                for _pt, _roots, _lbl in _root_sets:
2259                    if _pt in _ax_for:
2260                        _draw_vlines(_ax_for[_pt], _roots, _lbl)
2261
2262                if overlay_roots_also_on_function and 'function' in _ax_for:
2263                    for _pt, _roots, _lbl in _root_sets:
2264                        _draw_vlines(_ax_for['function'], _roots, _lbl)
2265        # ------------------------------------------------------------------
2266
2267    if not successful_features:
2268        raise ValueError(f"Could not plot any of the requested features: {features}")
2269
2270    # Set labels and formatting
2271    if use_log2fc or use_delta_p:
2272        xlabel = "log₂FC (x)"
2273    else:
2274        xlabel = "log₂(x)" if use_log2_x else "x"
2275
2276    for plot_i, (plot_type, ylabel) in enumerate(plot_types):
2277        ax_curr = axes[plot_i]
2278        ax_curr.set_xlabel(xlabel)
2279        ax_curr.set_ylabel(ylabel)
2280        ax_curr.axhline(y=0, color='gray', linestyle='--', linewidth=0.5, alpha=0.5)
2281
2282        # Add vertical line at u=0 (x = x_ntc) in log2FC or delta_p mode
2283        if use_log2fc or use_delta_p:
2284            ax_curr.axvline(x=0, color='gray', linestyle='--', linewidth=0.5, alpha=0.5)
2285
2286        if legend and len(successful_features) <= 20:
2287            ax_curr.legend(frameon=False, fontsize=8)
2288
2289    # Title
2290    if title is None:
2291        if use_log2fc:
2292            suffix = " (log₂FC)"
2293        elif use_delta_p:
2294            suffix = " (Δp)"
2295        else:
2296            suffix = ""
2297        if len(successful_features) == 1:
2298            title = f"Trans function: {successful_features[0]}{suffix}"
2299        else:
2300            title = f"Trans functions ({len(successful_features)} features){suffix}"
2301    fig.suptitle(title)
2302
2303    plt.tight_layout()
2304    return fig
2305
2306
2307def predict_trans_function(
2308    model,
2309    feature: str,
2310    x_range: np.ndarray,
2311    modality_name: Optional[str] = None,
2312    fdr_threshold: float = 0.05,
2313    fdr_df: Optional["pd.DataFrame"] = None,
2314    debug: bool = False
2315) -> Optional[np.ndarray]:
2316    """
2317    Predict trans effect function for a feature given x_true values.
2318
2319    Automatically detects function type (additive_hill, single_hill, polynomial)
2320    from posterior_samples_trans and computes predictions.
2321
2322    Parameters
2323    ----------
2324    model : bayesDREAM
2325        Model with fit_trans() completed
2326    feature : str
2327        Feature name to predict
2328    x_range : np.ndarray
2329        X values to predict at (cis expression levels)
2330    modality_name : str, optional
2331        Modality name (default: primary modality)
2332    fdr_threshold : float, default 0.05
2333        For additive_hill: components with Bayesian q-value >= fdr_threshold are
2334        FDR-inactive and gated to zero, so the curve reflects only statistically
2335        significant components — consistent with _compute_hill_markers,
2336        predict_hill_from_summary_row, and save_trans_summary's
2337        full_log2fc/observed_log2fc point estimates. Without gating, alpha/beta
2338        for null components are ~0.4-0.5 (RelaxedBernoulli prior) rather than 0,
2339        producing a spurious partial Hill contribution.
2340    fdr_df : pd.DataFrame, optional
2341        Precomputed trans_summary DataFrame (with fdr_alpha/fdr_beta columns) to
2342        source activity calls from, instead of recomputing Bayesian FDR live from
2343        the posterior on every call.
2344
2345    Returns
2346    -------
2347    np.ndarray or None
2348        Predicted y values at x_range, or None if:
2349        - Trans model not fitted
2350        - Feature not in trans_genes
2351        - Cannot determine function type
2352
2353    Notes
2354    -----
2355    Works with all function types:
2356    - additive_hill: A + alpha*Hill_a + beta*Hill_b
2357    - single_hill: A + Vmax*Hill(x, K, n)
2358    - polynomial: sum(coeffs[i] * x^i)
2359    """
2360    # Determine which modality to use
2361    if modality_name is None:
2362        modality_name = model.primary_modality
2363
2364    # Check if trans model fitted for this modality
2365    if modality_name == model.primary_modality:
2366        # Primary modality: check model-level posterior
2367        if not hasattr(model, 'posterior_samples_trans') or model.posterior_samples_trans is None:
2368            if debug: print(f"[predict_trans_function] returning None: no posterior_samples_trans on model")
2369            return None
2370        posterior = model.posterior_samples_trans
2371    else:
2372        # Non-primary modality: check modality-level posterior
2373        modality = model.get_modality(modality_name)
2374        if not hasattr(modality, 'posterior_samples_trans') or modality.posterior_samples_trans is None:
2375            if debug: print(f"[predict_trans_function] returning None: no posterior_samples_trans on modality '{modality_name}'")
2376            return None
2377        posterior = modality.posterior_samples_trans
2378
2379    if debug:
2380        print(f"[predict_trans_function] posterior keys: {list(posterior.keys())}")
2381
2382    # Get baseline A (present in all function types)
2383    if 'A' not in posterior:
2384        if debug: print(f"[predict_trans_function] returning None: 'A' not in posterior keys {list(posterior.keys())}")
2385        return None
2386
2387    A_samples = posterior['A']
2388
2389    # Get posterior dimensions
2390    # For primary modality: A_samples is (S, T) where S=samples, T=trans_genes
2391    #   After mean(dim=0): (T,)
2392    # For non-primary modality: A_samples is (S, C, T) where C=cis_genes, T=trans_features
2393    #   After mean(dim=0): (C, T)
2394    # We want the LAST dimension (T) in both cases
2395    if hasattr(A_samples, 'mean'):
2396        A_mean = A_samples.mean(dim=0)
2397        # Squeeze out cis gene dimension if present (should be size 1 for non-primary modalities)
2398        if A_mean.ndim > 1:
2399            A_mean = A_mean.squeeze(0)
2400        n_genes_posterior = A_mean.shape[0]
2401    else:
2402        A_mean = A_samples.mean(axis=0)
2403        # Squeeze out cis gene dimension if present
2404        if A_mean.ndim > 1:
2405            A_mean = A_mean.squeeze(0)
2406        n_genes_posterior = A_mean.shape[0]
2407
2408    # Get feature list from modality — always the ground truth.
2409    # modality.feature_names is the single source of truth (resolved + deduped
2410    # in Modality.__init__), no need to re-derive it here.
2411    modality = model.get_modality(modality_name)
2412    feature_list = modality.feature_names if modality.feature_names is not None else []
2413    if not feature_list and modality_name != model.primary_modality:
2414        if debug: print(f"[predict_trans_function] returning None: non-primary modality has no feature_names or feature_meta")
2415        return None
2416
2417    n_features_list = len(feature_list)
2418
2419    if debug:
2420        print(f"[predict_trans_function] n_genes_posterior={n_genes_posterior}, n_features_list={n_features_list}")
2421        print(f"[predict_trans_function] feature_list[:5]={feature_list[:5]}, ..., feature_list[-5:]={feature_list[-5:]}")
2422
2423    # Check dimension consistency BEFORE using feature_list for indexing
2424    if n_genes_posterior != n_features_list:
2425        # Mismatch - cannot use feature_list for indexing
2426        # This happens when posterior was fitted on a subset of features
2427        if debug: print(f"[predict_trans_function] returning None: dimension mismatch n_genes_posterior={n_genes_posterior} != n_features_list={n_features_list}")
2428        return None
2429
2430    # Now safe to check if feature is in feature_list and get its index
2431    if feature not in feature_list:
2432        if debug: print(f"[predict_trans_function] returning None: '{feature}' not in feature_list (len={n_features_list})")
2433        return None
2434
2435    feature_idx = feature_list.index(feature)
2436    A = A_mean[feature_idx].item() if hasattr(A_mean, 'item') else A_mean[feature_idx]
2437
2438    # Determine function type from available parameters
2439    if debug:
2440        print(f"[predict_trans_function] A={A_mean[feature_idx]:.4g}, feature_idx={feature_idx}")
2441        print(f"[predict_trans_function] branch check: Vmax_a={'Vmax_a' in posterior}, Vmax_b={'Vmax_b' in posterior}, upper_limit={'upper_limit' in posterior}, theta={'theta' in posterior}")
2442
2443    if 'Vmax_a' in posterior and 'Vmax_b' in posterior:
2444        # ===== ADDITIVE HILL (negbinom/normal/studentt) =====
2445        try:
2446            # Extract parameters using helper function
2447            alpha = _extract_param_mean(posterior['alpha'], feature_idx)
2448            beta = _extract_param_mean(posterior['beta'], feature_idx)
2449            Vmax_a = _extract_param_mean(posterior['Vmax_a'], feature_idx)
2450            Vmax_b = _extract_param_mean(posterior['Vmax_b'], feature_idx)
2451            K_a = _extract_param_mean(posterior['K_a'], feature_idx)
2452            K_b = _extract_param_mean(posterior['K_b'], feature_idx)
2453            n_a = _extract_param_mean(posterior['n_a'], feature_idx)
2454            n_b = _extract_param_mean(posterior['n_b'], feature_idx)
2455
2456            a_null, b_null = _resolve_hill_null_flags(
2457                feature, feature_idx, posterior, fdr_df=fdr_df, fdr_threshold=fdr_threshold
2458            )
2459            if a_null:
2460                alpha = 0.0
2461            if b_null:
2462                beta = 0.0
2463
2464            if debug:
2465                print(f"[predict_trans_function] additive_hill: A={A:.4g}, alpha={alpha:.4g}, beta={beta:.4g}, Vmax_a={Vmax_a:.4g}, Vmax_b={Vmax_b:.4g}, K_a={K_a:.4g}, K_b={K_b:.4g}, n_a={n_a:.4g}, n_b={n_b:.4g}")
2466
2467            # Compute Hill functions
2468            Hill_a = Hill_based_positive(x_range, Vmax=Vmax_a, A=0, K=K_a, n=n_a)
2469            Hill_b = Hill_based_positive(x_range, Vmax=Vmax_b, A=0, K=K_b, n=n_b)
2470
2471            # Combined prediction
2472            y_pred = A + alpha * Hill_a + beta * Hill_b
2473            if debug:
2474                print(f"[predict_trans_function] y_pred range: [{y_pred.min():.4g}, {y_pred.max():.4g}], any>0: {(y_pred > 0).any()}")
2475            return y_pred
2476
2477        except (KeyError, IndexError, AttributeError) as e:
2478            if debug: print(f"[predict_trans_function] returning None: additive_hill extraction failed: {e}")
2479            return None
2480
2481    elif 'upper_limit' in posterior and 'Vmax_a' in posterior and 'Vmax_b' in posterior:
2482        # ===== ADDITIVE HILL (binomial/multinomial with upper_limit and Vmax_a/b) =====
2483        try:
2484            # Extract parameters using helper function
2485            alpha = _extract_param_mean(posterior['alpha'], feature_idx)
2486            beta = _extract_param_mean(posterior['beta'], feature_idx)
2487            Vmax_a = _extract_param_mean(posterior['Vmax_a'], feature_idx)
2488            Vmax_b = _extract_param_mean(posterior['Vmax_b'], feature_idx)
2489            K_a = _extract_param_mean(posterior['K_a'], feature_idx)
2490            K_b = _extract_param_mean(posterior['K_b'], feature_idx)
2491            n_a = _extract_param_mean(posterior['n_a'], feature_idx)
2492            n_b = _extract_param_mean(posterior['n_b'], feature_idx)
2493
2494            a_null, b_null = _resolve_hill_null_flags(
2495                feature, feature_idx, posterior, fdr_df=fdr_df, fdr_threshold=fdr_threshold
2496            )
2497            if a_null:
2498                alpha = 0.0
2499            if b_null:
2500                beta = 0.0
2501
2502            # IMPORTANT: Match the actual model computation in fit_trans!
2503            # Model uses: y = A + (alpha * Hill_a(Vmax=Vmax_a)) + (beta * Hill_b(Vmax=Vmax_b))
2504            # where Hill functions return values in [0, Vmax]
2505            Hill_a = Hill_based_positive(x_range, Vmax=Vmax_a, A=0, K=K_a, n=n_a)
2506            Hill_b = Hill_based_positive(x_range, Vmax=Vmax_b, A=0, K=K_b, n=n_b)
2507
2508            # Combined prediction
2509            y_pred = A + alpha * Hill_a + beta * Hill_b
2510            return y_pred
2511
2512        except (KeyError, IndexError, AttributeError) as e:
2513            if debug: print(f"[predict_trans_function] returning None: upper_limit additive_hill extraction failed: {e}")
2514            return None
2515
2516    elif 'Vmax_a' in posterior:
2517        # ===== SINGLE HILL =====
2518        try:
2519            alpha = _extract_param_mean(posterior['alpha'], feature_idx)
2520            Vmax_a = _extract_param_mean(posterior['Vmax_a'], feature_idx)
2521            K_a = _extract_param_mean(posterior['K_a'], feature_idx)
2522            n_a = _extract_param_mean(posterior['n_a'], feature_idx)
2523
2524            # Compute Hill function: y = A + alpha * Hill(x, Vmax=Vmax_a, K=K_a, n=n_a)
2525            Hill_a = Hill_based_positive(x_range, Vmax=Vmax_a, A=0, K=K_a, n=n_a)
2526            y_pred = A + alpha * Hill_a
2527            return y_pred
2528
2529        except (KeyError, IndexError, AttributeError) as e:
2530            if debug: print(f"[predict_trans_function] returning None: single_hill extraction failed: {e}")
2531            return None
2532
2533    elif 'theta' in posterior:
2534        # ===== POLYNOMIAL OR THETA-BASED =====
2535        try:
2536            theta_samples = posterior['theta']
2537            # theta shape for primary: (samples, features, n_params)
2538            # theta shape for non-primary: (samples, cis_genes, features, n_params)
2539
2540            # Average over samples and squeeze cis gene dimension if present
2541            if hasattr(theta_samples, 'mean'):
2542                theta_mean = theta_samples.mean(dim=0)
2543                # Squeeze out cis gene dimension if present
2544                if theta_mean.ndim > 2:  # (cis_genes, features, n_params)
2545                    theta_mean = theta_mean.squeeze(0)  # (features, n_params)
2546                theta_mean = theta_mean[feature_idx, :]  # (n_params,)
2547                theta_np = theta_mean.cpu().numpy() if hasattr(theta_mean, 'cpu') else np.array(theta_mean)
2548            else:
2549                theta_mean = theta_samples.mean(axis=0)
2550                if theta_mean.ndim > 2:
2551                    theta_mean = theta_mean.squeeze(0)
2552                theta_mean = theta_mean[feature_idx, :]
2553                theta_np = np.array(theta_mean)
2554
2555            # Polynomial: y = coeffs[0] + coeffs[1]*x + coeffs[2]*x^2 + ...
2556            # First coefficient is baseline (like A)
2557            baseline = theta_np[0]
2558            poly_coeffs = theta_np[1:]  # Remaining coefficients
2559
2560            # Compute polynomial
2561            y_pred = np.full_like(x_range, baseline)
2562            for i, coeff in enumerate(poly_coeffs, start=1):
2563                y_pred += coeff * (x_range ** i)
2564
2565            return y_pred
2566
2567        except (KeyError, IndexError, AttributeError) as e:
2568            if debug: print(f"[predict_trans_function] returning None: polynomial extraction failed: {e}")
2569            return None
2570
2571    else:
2572        # Unknown function type
2573        if debug: print(f"[predict_trans_function] returning None: unrecognized function type (posterior keys: {list(posterior.keys())})")
2574        return None
2575
2576
2577def _row_component_active(row, fdr_col, n_lower_col, n_upper_col, fdr_threshold=0.05):
2578    """
2579    Whether a Hill component is active per a trans_summary row: Bayesian q-value
2580    < fdr_threshold AND the Hill exponent's 95% CI excludes 0 (permissive True
2581    fallback if the CI columns are missing/NaN). This is the row-based half of
2582    the single active-component definition shared with io/summary.py's
2583    active_a/active_b and xy_plots.py's _resolve_hill_null_flags — used by
2584    predict_hill_from_summary_row and (via _resolve_hill_null_flags) by
2585    _compute_hill_markers's fdr_df path.
2586    """
2587    fdr_val = row.get(fdr_col, 1.0)
2588    try:
2589        fdr_val = float(fdr_val)
2590    except (TypeError, ValueError):
2591        fdr_val = 1.0
2592    if not np.isfinite(fdr_val):
2593        fdr_val = 1.0
2594
2595    lo, hi = row.get(n_lower_col), row.get(n_upper_col)
2596    if lo is None or hi is None or pd.isna(lo) or pd.isna(hi):
2597        n_excludes_zero = True
2598    else:
2599        n_excludes_zero = not (float(lo) <= 0 <= float(hi))
2600
2601    return (fdr_val < fdr_threshold) and n_excludes_zero
2602
2603
2604def predict_hill_from_summary_row(row, x_range: np.ndarray, fdr_threshold: float = 0.05) -> Optional[np.ndarray]:
2605    """
2606    Compute a Hill curve from a trans_summary DataFrame row.
2607
2608    Supports both additive_hill (has Vmax_b_median) and single_hill rows.
2609    Parameters are read from columns named A_median, alpha_median, Vmax_a_median,
2610    K_a_median, n_a_median, beta_median, Vmax_b_median, K_b_median, n_b_median.
2611
2612    Gating: a component is zeroed out unless it's active — Bayesian q-value
2613    (fdr_alpha/fdr_beta) < fdr_threshold AND its Hill exponent's 95% CI
2614    (n_a_lower/n_a_upper, n_b_lower/n_b_upper) excludes 0 — so the curve reflects
2615    only components with an identified, statistically significant dose-response.
2616    Without gating, alpha/beta for null components are ~0.4-0.5 (RelaxedBernoulli
2617    prior) rather than 0, producing a spurious partial Hill contribution; the q-value
2618    alone would also let through alpha absorbing a constant offset while n ≈ 0
2619    (flat Hill, unidentified K). Matches active_a/active_b in io/summary.py and
2620    _resolve_hill_null_flags/_compute_hill_markers.
2621
2622    Returns y values at x_range, or None if required columns are missing.
2623    """
2624    def _g(col, default=None):
2625        v = row.get(col, default)
2626        try:
2627            v = float(v)
2628        except (TypeError, ValueError):
2629            return default
2630        return v if np.isfinite(v) else default
2631
2632    A       = _g('A_median', 0.0)
2633    alpha   = _g('alpha_median', 1.0)
2634    Vmax_a  = _g('Vmax_a_median')
2635    K_a     = _g('K_a_median')
2636    n_a     = _g('n_a_median')
2637    if Vmax_a is None or K_a is None or n_a is None:
2638        return None
2639
2640    if not _row_component_active(row, 'fdr_alpha', 'n_a_lower', 'n_a_upper', fdr_threshold):
2641        alpha = 0.0
2642
2643    Hill_a = Hill_based_positive(x_range, Vmax=Vmax_a, A=0, K=K_a, n=n_a)
2644    y_pred = A + alpha * Hill_a
2645
2646    beta   = _g('beta_median', 0.0)
2647    Vmax_b = _g('Vmax_b_median')
2648    K_b    = _g('K_b_median')
2649    n_b    = _g('n_b_median')
2650
2651    if not _row_component_active(row, 'fdr_beta', 'n_b_lower', 'n_b_upper', fdr_threshold):
2652        beta = 0.0
2653
2654    if Vmax_b is not None and K_b is not None and n_b is not None and beta != 0.0:
2655        Hill_b = Hill_based_positive(x_range, Vmax=Vmax_b, A=0, K=K_b, n=n_b)
2656        y_pred = y_pred + beta * Hill_b
2657
2658    return y_pred
2659
2660
2661def predict_trans_function_samples(
2662    model,
2663    feature: str,
2664    x_range: np.ndarray,
2665    modality_name: Optional[str] = None,
2666    max_samples: Optional[int] = None,
2667    fdr_threshold: float = 0.05,
2668    fdr_df: Optional["pd.DataFrame"] = None,
2669) -> Optional[np.ndarray]:
2670    """
2671    Predict trans effect function for all posterior samples.
2672
2673    Like predict_trans_function but returns predictions for each posterior sample
2674    instead of just the mean.
2675
2676    Parameters
2677    ----------
2678    model : bayesDREAM
2679        Model with fit_trans() completed
2680    feature : str
2681        Feature name to predict
2682    x_range : np.ndarray
2683        X values to predict at (cis expression levels)
2684    modality_name : str, optional
2685        Modality name (default: primary modality)
2686    max_samples : int, optional
2687        Maximum number of samples to return. If None, returns all samples.
2688    fdr_threshold : float, default 0.05
2689        For additive_hill: FDR-inactive components (q-value >= fdr_threshold) are
2690        gated to zero for every sample, matching predict_trans_function so
2691        posterior-sample overlays and CI bands reflect the same gated curve as
2692        the mean line.
2693    fdr_df : pd.DataFrame, optional
2694        Precomputed trans_summary DataFrame to source activity calls from.
2695
2696    Returns
2697    -------
2698    np.ndarray or None
2699        Predicted y values with shape [n_samples, n_points], or None if prediction fails.
2700    """
2701    # Determine which modality to use
2702    if modality_name is None:
2703        modality_name = model.primary_modality
2704
2705    # Check if trans model fitted for this modality
2706    if modality_name == model.primary_modality:
2707        if not hasattr(model, 'posterior_samples_trans') or model.posterior_samples_trans is None:
2708            return None
2709        posterior = model.posterior_samples_trans
2710    else:
2711        modality = model.get_modality(modality_name)
2712        if not hasattr(modality, 'posterior_samples_trans') or modality.posterior_samples_trans is None:
2713            return None
2714        posterior = modality.posterior_samples_trans
2715
2716    # Get baseline A
2717    if 'A' not in posterior:
2718        return None
2719
2720    A_samples = posterior['A']
2721    if hasattr(A_samples, 'cpu'):
2722        A_samples = A_samples.cpu().numpy()
2723    else:
2724        A_samples = np.array(A_samples)
2725
2726    # Get feature list — always from the modality, never from model.trans_genes.
2727    # modality.feature_names is the single source of truth (resolved + deduped
2728    # in Modality.__init__), no need to re-derive it here.
2729    modality = model.get_modality(modality_name)
2730    feature_list = modality.feature_names
2731    if feature_list is None:
2732        return None
2733
2734    # Handle dimension squeezing for non-primary modalities
2735    # A_samples shape: (S, T) for primary, (S, C, T) for non-primary
2736    if A_samples.ndim > 2:
2737        A_samples = A_samples.squeeze(1)  # Remove cis gene dimension
2738
2739    # Get number of features in posterior
2740    n_features_posterior = A_samples.shape[1]
2741    n_features_list = len(feature_list)
2742
2743    # Check dimension consistency
2744    if n_features_posterior != n_features_list:
2745        # Mismatch - likely cis gene excluded from posterior
2746        # Try to find correct index by checking if cis gene is in list
2747        if hasattr(model, 'cis_gene') and model.cis_gene in feature_list:
2748            # Remove cis gene from feature list for indexing
2749            feature_list_adjusted = [f for f in feature_list if f != model.cis_gene]
2750            if feature not in feature_list_adjusted:
2751                return None
2752            if len(feature_list_adjusted) != n_features_posterior:
2753                return None  # Still mismatched
2754            feature_idx = feature_list_adjusted.index(feature)
2755        else:
2756            return None
2757    else:
2758        if feature not in feature_list:
2759            return None
2760        feature_idx = feature_list.index(feature)
2761
2762    # Determine function type and compute predictions
2763    if 'Vmax_a' in posterior and 'Vmax_b' in posterior:
2764        # ===== ADDITIVE HILL =====
2765        try:
2766            A = A_samples[:, feature_idx]  # [n_samples]
2767            alpha = _extract_param_samples(posterior, 'alpha', feature_idx)
2768            beta = _extract_param_samples(posterior, 'beta', feature_idx)
2769            Vmax_a = _extract_param_samples(posterior, 'Vmax_a', feature_idx)
2770            Vmax_b = _extract_param_samples(posterior, 'Vmax_b', feature_idx)
2771            K_a = _extract_param_samples(posterior, 'K_a', feature_idx)
2772            K_b = _extract_param_samples(posterior, 'K_b', feature_idx)
2773            n_a = _extract_param_samples(posterior, 'n_a', feature_idx)
2774            n_b = _extract_param_samples(posterior, 'n_b', feature_idx)
2775
2776            a_null, b_null = _resolve_hill_null_flags(
2777                feature, feature_idx, posterior, fdr_df=fdr_df, fdr_threshold=fdr_threshold
2778            )
2779            if a_null:
2780                alpha = np.zeros_like(alpha)
2781            if b_null:
2782                beta = np.zeros_like(beta)
2783
2784            n_samples = A.shape[0]
2785            if max_samples is not None and max_samples < n_samples:
2786                # Subsample
2787                indices = np.random.choice(n_samples, max_samples, replace=False)
2788                A = A[indices]
2789                alpha = alpha[indices]
2790                beta = beta[indices]
2791                Vmax_a = Vmax_a[indices]
2792                Vmax_b = Vmax_b[indices]
2793                K_a = K_a[indices]
2794                K_b = K_b[indices]
2795                n_a = n_a[indices]
2796                n_b = n_b[indices]
2797                n_samples = max_samples
2798
2799            # Compute predictions for each sample
2800            # x_range is [n_points], we need to broadcast to [n_samples, n_points]
2801            n_points = len(x_range)
2802            y_pred = np.zeros((n_samples, n_points))
2803
2804            for s in range(n_samples):
2805                Hill_a = Hill_based_positive(x_range, Vmax=Vmax_a[s], A=0, K=K_a[s], n=n_a[s])
2806                Hill_b = Hill_based_positive(x_range, Vmax=Vmax_b[s], A=0, K=K_b[s], n=n_b[s])
2807                y_pred[s, :] = A[s] + alpha[s] * Hill_a + beta[s] * Hill_b
2808
2809            return y_pred
2810
2811        except (KeyError, IndexError, AttributeError):
2812            return None
2813
2814    elif 'Vmax_a' in posterior:
2815        # ===== SINGLE HILL =====
2816        try:
2817            A = A_samples[:, feature_idx]
2818            alpha = _extract_param_samples(posterior, 'alpha', feature_idx)
2819            Vmax_a = _extract_param_samples(posterior, 'Vmax_a', feature_idx)
2820            K_a = _extract_param_samples(posterior, 'K_a', feature_idx)
2821            n_a = _extract_param_samples(posterior, 'n_a', feature_idx)
2822
2823            n_samples = A.shape[0]
2824            if max_samples is not None and max_samples < n_samples:
2825                indices = np.random.choice(n_samples, max_samples, replace=False)
2826                A = A[indices]
2827                alpha = alpha[indices]
2828                Vmax_a = Vmax_a[indices]
2829                K_a = K_a[indices]
2830                n_a = n_a[indices]
2831                n_samples = max_samples
2832
2833            n_points = len(x_range)
2834            y_pred = np.zeros((n_samples, n_points))
2835
2836            for s in range(n_samples):
2837                Hill_a = Hill_based_positive(x_range, Vmax=Vmax_a[s], A=0, K=K_a[s], n=n_a[s])
2838                y_pred[s, :] = A[s] + alpha[s] * Hill_a
2839
2840            return y_pred
2841
2842        except (KeyError, IndexError, AttributeError):
2843            return None
2844
2845    else:
2846        # Polynomial or unknown - not supported for samples
2847        return None
2848

2850def predict_trans_derivatives_samples(
2851    model,
2852    feature: str,
2853    x_range: np.ndarray,
2854    modality_name: Optional[str] = None,
2855    max_samples: Optional[int] = None,
2856    fdr_threshold: float = 0.05,
2857    fdr_df: Optional["pd.DataFrame"] = None,
2858) -> Tuple[Optional[np.ndarray], Optional[np.ndarray], Optional[np.ndarray], Optional[np.ndarray]]:
2859    """
2860    Compute trans function and derivatives for all posterior samples.
2861
2862    Parameters
2863    ----------
2864    model : bayesDREAM
2865        Model with fit_trans() completed
2866    feature : str
2867        Feature name to predict
2868    x_range : np.ndarray
2869        X values to compute at
2870    modality_name : str, optional
2871        Modality name (default: primary modality)
2872    max_samples : int, optional
2873        Maximum number of samples to return
2874    fdr_threshold : float, default 0.05
2875        For additive_hill: FDR-inactive components (q-value >= fdr_threshold) are
2876        gated to zero for every sample, matching predict_trans_derivatives.
2877    fdr_df : pd.DataFrame, optional
2878        Precomputed trans_summary DataFrame to source activity calls from.
2879
2880    Returns
2881    -------
2882    Tuple of (y_samples, first_deriv_samples, second_deriv_samples, third_deriv_samples)
2883        Each has shape [n_samples, n_points], or None if computation fails
2884    """
2885    # Determine which modality to use
2886    if modality_name is None:
2887        modality_name = model.primary_modality
2888
2889    # Check if trans model fitted
2890    if modality_name == model.primary_modality:
2891        if not hasattr(model, 'posterior_samples_trans') or model.posterior_samples_trans is None:
2892            return None, None, None, None
2893        posterior = model.posterior_samples_trans
2894    else:
2895        modality = model.get_modality(modality_name)
2896        if not hasattr(modality, 'posterior_samples_trans') or modality.posterior_samples_trans is None:
2897            return None, None, None, None
2898        posterior = modality.posterior_samples_trans
2899
2900    # Get baseline A
2901    if 'A' not in posterior:
2902        return None, None, None, None
2903
2904    A_samples = posterior['A']
2905    if hasattr(A_samples, 'cpu'):
2906        A_samples = A_samples.cpu().numpy()
2907    else:
2908        A_samples = np.array(A_samples)
2909
2910    # Get feature list — always from the modality, never from model.trans_genes.
2911    # modality.feature_names is the single source of truth (resolved + deduped
2912    # in Modality.__init__), no need to re-derive it here.
2913    modality = model.get_modality(modality_name)
2914    feature_list = modality.feature_names
2915    if feature_list is None:
2916        return None, None, None, None
2917
2918    # Handle dimension squeezing
2919    if A_samples.ndim > 2:
2920        A_samples = A_samples.squeeze(1)
2921
2922    # Check dimension consistency
2923    n_features_posterior = A_samples.shape[1]
2924    n_features_list = len(feature_list)
2925
2926    if n_features_posterior != n_features_list:
2927        if hasattr(model, 'cis_gene') and model.cis_gene in feature_list:
2928            feature_list_adjusted = [f for f in feature_list if f != model.cis_gene]
2929            if feature not in feature_list_adjusted:
2930                return None, None, None, None
2931            if len(feature_list_adjusted) != n_features_posterior:
2932                return None, None, None, None
2933            feature_idx = feature_list_adjusted.index(feature)
2934        else:
2935            return None, None, None, None
2936    else:
2937        if feature not in feature_list:
2938            return None, None, None, None
2939        feature_idx = feature_list.index(feature)
2940
2941    # Helper to extract all samples for a parameter
2942    # Compute based on function type
2943    if 'Vmax_a' in posterior and 'Vmax_b' in posterior:
2944        # ===== ADDITIVE HILL =====
2945        try:
2946            A = A_samples[:, feature_idx]
2947            alpha = _extract_param_samples(posterior, 'alpha', feature_idx)
2948            beta = _extract_param_samples(posterior, 'beta', feature_idx)
2949            Vmax_a = _extract_param_samples(posterior, 'Vmax_a', feature_idx)
2950            Vmax_b = _extract_param_samples(posterior, 'Vmax_b', feature_idx)
2951            K_a = _extract_param_samples(posterior, 'K_a', feature_idx)
2952            K_b = _extract_param_samples(posterior, 'K_b', feature_idx)
2953            n_a = _extract_param_samples(posterior, 'n_a', feature_idx)
2954            n_b = _extract_param_samples(posterior, 'n_b', feature_idx)
2955
2956            a_null, b_null = _resolve_hill_null_flags(
2957                feature, feature_idx, posterior, fdr_df=fdr_df, fdr_threshold=fdr_threshold
2958            )
2959            if a_null:
2960                alpha = np.zeros_like(alpha)
2961            if b_null:
2962                beta = np.zeros_like(beta)
2963
2964            n_samples = A.shape[0]
2965            if max_samples is not None and max_samples < n_samples:
2966                indices = np.random.choice(n_samples, max_samples, replace=False)
2967                A = A[indices]
2968                alpha = alpha[indices]
2969                beta = beta[indices]
2970                Vmax_a = Vmax_a[indices]
2971                Vmax_b = Vmax_b[indices]
2972                K_a = K_a[indices]
2973                K_b = K_b[indices]
2974                n_a = n_a[indices]
2975                n_b = n_b[indices]
2976                n_samples = max_samples
2977
2978            n_points = len(x_range)
2979            y_samples = np.zeros((n_samples, n_points))
2980            first_deriv_samples = np.zeros((n_samples, n_points))
2981            second_deriv_samples = np.zeros((n_samples, n_points))
2982            third_deriv_samples = np.zeros((n_samples, n_points))
2983
2984            for s in range(n_samples):
2985                # Function values
2986                Hill_a = Hill_based_positive(x_range, Vmax=Vmax_a[s], A=0, K=K_a[s], n=n_a[s])
2987                Hill_b = Hill_based_positive(x_range, Vmax=Vmax_b[s], A=0, K=K_b[s], n=n_b[s])
2988                y_samples[s, :] = A[s] + alpha[s] * Hill_a + beta[s] * Hill_b
2989
2990                # First derivatives
2991                dHill_a = Hill_first_derivative(x_range, Vmax=Vmax_a[s], K=K_a[s], n=n_a[s])
2992                dHill_b = Hill_first_derivative(x_range, Vmax=Vmax_b[s], K=K_b[s], n=n_b[s])
2993                first_deriv_samples[s, :] = alpha[s] * dHill_a + beta[s] * dHill_b
2994
2995                # Second derivatives
2996                d2Hill_a = Hill_second_derivative(x_range, Vmax=Vmax_a[s], K=K_a[s], n=n_a[s])
2997                d2Hill_b = Hill_second_derivative(x_range, Vmax=Vmax_b[s], K=K_b[s], n=n_b[s])
2998                second_deriv_samples[s, :] = alpha[s] * d2Hill_a + beta[s] * d2Hill_b
2999
3000                # Third derivatives
3001                d3Hill_a = Hill_third_derivative(x_range, Vmax=Vmax_a[s], K=K_a[s], n=n_a[s])
3002                d3Hill_b = Hill_third_derivative(x_range, Vmax=Vmax_b[s], K=K_b[s], n=n_b[s])
3003                third_deriv_samples[s, :] = alpha[s] * d3Hill_a + beta[s] * d3Hill_b
3004
3005            return y_samples, first_deriv_samples, second_deriv_samples, third_deriv_samples
3006
3007        except (KeyError, IndexError, AttributeError):
3008            return None, None, None, None
3009
3010    elif 'Vmax_a' in posterior:
3011        # ===== SINGLE HILL =====
3012        try:
3013            A = A_samples[:, feature_idx]
3014            alpha = _extract_param_samples(posterior, 'alpha', feature_idx)
3015            Vmax_a = _extract_param_samples(posterior, 'Vmax_a', feature_idx)
3016            K_a = _extract_param_samples(posterior, 'K_a', feature_idx)
3017            n_a = _extract_param_samples(posterior, 'n_a', feature_idx)
3018
3019            n_samples = A.shape[0]
3020            if max_samples is not None and max_samples < n_samples:
3021                indices = np.random.choice(n_samples, max_samples, replace=False)
3022                A = A[indices]
3023                alpha = alpha[indices]
3024                Vmax_a = Vmax_a[indices]
3025                K_a = K_a[indices]
3026                n_a = n_a[indices]
3027                n_samples = max_samples
3028
3029            n_points = len(x_range)
3030            y_samples = np.zeros((n_samples, n_points))
3031            first_deriv_samples = np.zeros((n_samples, n_points))
3032            second_deriv_samples = np.zeros((n_samples, n_points))
3033            third_deriv_samples = np.zeros((n_samples, n_points))
3034
3035            for s in range(n_samples):
3036                Hill_a = Hill_based_positive(x_range, Vmax=Vmax_a[s], A=0, K=K_a[s], n=n_a[s])
3037                y_samples[s, :] = A[s] + alpha[s] * Hill_a
3038                first_deriv_samples[s, :] = alpha[s] * Hill_first_derivative(x_range, Vmax=Vmax_a[s], K=K_a[s], n=n_a[s])
3039                second_deriv_samples[s, :] = alpha[s] * Hill_second_derivative(x_range, Vmax=Vmax_a[s], K=K_a[s], n=n_a[s])
3040                third_deriv_samples[s, :] = alpha[s] * Hill_third_derivative(x_range, Vmax=Vmax_a[s], K=K_a[s], n=n_a[s])
3041
3042            return y_samples, first_deriv_samples, second_deriv_samples, third_deriv_samples
3043
3044        except (KeyError, IndexError, AttributeError):
3045            return None, None, None, None
3046
3047    else:
3048        # Polynomial or unknown - not supported
3049        return None, None, None, None
