3052# ============================================================================
3053# Bayesian FDR for plotting (mirrors ModelSaver._compute_bayesian_fdr)
3054# ============================================================================
3055
3056def _compute_posterior_fdr(posterior, activity_epsilon: float = 0.01):
3057    """
3058    Compute per-component Bayesian q-values from posterior samples.
3059
3060    Mirrors ModelSaver._compute_bayesian_fdr in io/summary.py:
3061      lfdr_i = 1 - P(alpha_i * Vmax_i / A_i > epsilon)
3062      q-values = running-min of cumulative-mean(lfdr sorted ascending)
3063    For additive_hill, alpha and beta form a single pooled family of 2T tests.
3064
3065    Returns (fdr_alpha, fdr_beta) each of shape (n_features,).
3066    fdr_beta is all-NaN for single_hill / when Vmax_b is absent.
3067    Returns (None, None) if the posterior lacks the required keys.
3068    """
3069    def _to_np(key):
3070        if key not in posterior:
3071            return None
3072        v = posterior[key]
3073        if hasattr(v, 'cpu'):
3074            v = v.detach().cpu().numpy()
3075        v = np.asarray(v, dtype=float)
3076        if v.ndim >= 3 and v.shape[1] == 1:
3077            v = v.squeeze(1)
3078        return v
3079
3080    def _p_active(alpha_key, vmax_key):
3081        alpha_s = _to_np(alpha_key)
3082        vmax_s  = _to_np(vmax_key)
3083        A_s     = _to_np('A')
3084        if (alpha_s is not None and alpha_s.ndim >= 2
3085                and vmax_s is not None and vmax_s.ndim >= 2
3086                and A_s    is not None and A_s.ndim    >= 2):
3087            ratio = alpha_s * vmax_s / np.maximum(A_s, 1e-12)
3088            return (ratio > activity_epsilon).mean(axis=0)
3089        if alpha_s is not None:
3090            m = alpha_s.mean(axis=0) if alpha_s.ndim >= 2 else alpha_s
3091            return np.clip(np.asarray(m, dtype=float), 0.0, 1.0)
3092        return None
3093
3094    def _qvalues(lfdr):
3095        n = len(lfdr)
3096        if n == 0:
3097            return np.array([], dtype=float)
3098        order = np.argsort(lfdr)
3099        cumfdr = np.cumsum(lfdr[order]) / (np.arange(n, dtype=float) + 1.0)
3100        qvals_sorted = np.minimum.accumulate(cumfdr[::-1])[::-1]
3101        qvals = np.empty(n, dtype=float)
3102        qvals[order] = qvals_sorted
3103        return qvals
3104
3105    p_a = _p_active('alpha', 'Vmax_a')
3106    if p_a is None:
3107        return None, None
3108    p_a = np.asarray(p_a, dtype=float).ravel()
3109    n = len(p_a)
3110    nan_col = np.full(n, np.nan)
3111
3112    p_b = _p_active('beta', 'Vmax_b') if 'Vmax_b' in posterior else None
3113
3114    if p_b is not None:
3115        p_b = np.asarray(p_b, dtype=float).ravel()
3116        # Pool alpha and beta into a single family (matches summary.py)
3117        lfdr_all = 1.0 - np.concatenate([p_a, p_b])
3118        qvals_all = _qvalues(lfdr_all)
3119        fdr_alpha = np.where(p_a < 1e-9, 1.0, qvals_all[:n])
3120        fdr_beta  = np.where(p_b < 1e-9, 1.0, qvals_all[n:])
3121    else:
3122        lfdr_a = 1.0 - p_a
3123        fdr_alpha = np.where(p_a < 1e-9, 1.0, _qvalues(lfdr_a))
3124        fdr_beta  = nan_col
3125
3126    return fdr_alpha, fdr_beta
3127
3128
3129def _posterior_n_excludes_zero(posterior, feature_idx):
3130    """
3131    Return (n_a_excludes_zero, n_b_excludes_zero): whether each Hill exponent's
3132    95% posterior CI (2.5%/97.5% quantiles, matching io/summary.py's extract_param)
3133    excludes 0 for this feature. True (excludes zero) is the permissive fallback
3134    when there aren't enough samples to assess a CI, so a missing/degenerate
3135    posterior doesn't spuriously gate a component off.
3136    """
3137    def _excludes_zero(key):
3138        if key not in posterior:
3139            return True
3140        v = posterior[key]
3141        if hasattr(v, 'cpu'):
3142            v = v.detach().cpu().numpy()
3143        v = np.asarray(v, dtype=float)
3144        if v.ndim >= 3 and v.shape[1] == 1:
3145            v = v.squeeze(1)
3146        if v.ndim < 2 or feature_idx >= v.shape[1]:
3147            return True
3148        col = v[:, feature_idx]
3149        lo = np.quantile(col, 0.025)
3150        hi = np.quantile(col, 0.975)
3151        return not (lo <= 0 <= hi)
3152
3153    return _excludes_zero('n_a'), _excludes_zero('n_b')
3154
3155
3156def _resolve_hill_null_flags(feature, feature_idx, posterior, fdr_df=None, fdr_threshold=0.05):
3157    """
3158    Resolve (a_null, b_null): whether the additive-hill A/B components are
3159    inactive for this feature, i.e. whether they should be gated to zero.
3160
3161    Single source of truth for component-activity gating shared by
3162    predict_trans_function, predict_trans_derivatives, and _compute_hill_markers
3163    (and their _samples variants), so the fitted curve, its derivatives, and its
3164    markers always agree on which component(s) are "on". A component is active
3165    iff BOTH: Bayesian q-value < fdr_threshold AND its Hill exponent's (n_a/n_b)
3166    95% CI excludes 0 — this is exactly the active_a/active_b criterion in
3167    io/summary.py (is_dependent/fit_type and the point-estimate/CI gating). The
3168    q-value alone can't distinguish a real dose-response from alpha/beta
3169    absorbing a constant offset while n ≈ 0 (flat Hill, unidentified K); the CI
3170    check catches that degenerate case.
3171
3172    Prefers a precomputed fdr_df (e.g. a save_trans_summary row, which already
3173    has fdr_alpha/fdr_beta/n_a_lower/n_a_upper/n_b_lower/n_b_upper columns) when
3174    available — cheap and avoids recomputing q-values/quantiles on every call —
3175    falling back to a live computation from the posterior otherwise.
3176
3177    Returns
3178    -------
3179    (a_null, b_null) : (bool, bool)
3180    """
3181    if fdr_df is not None:
3182        _name_col = next((c for c in ['gene_name', 'gene'] if c in fdr_df.columns), None)
3183        if _name_col:
3184            _match = fdr_df[fdr_df[_name_col] == feature]
3185            if not _match.empty:
3186                row = _match.iloc[0]
3187                a_null = not _row_component_active(row, 'fdr_alpha', 'n_a_lower', 'n_a_upper', fdr_threshold)
3188                b_null = not _row_component_active(row, 'fdr_beta', 'n_b_lower', 'n_b_upper', fdr_threshold)
3189                return a_null, b_null
3190
3191    fdr_a, fdr_b = _compute_posterior_fdr(posterior)
3192    if fdr_a is not None and feature_idx < len(fdr_a):
3193        n_a_excludes_zero, n_b_excludes_zero = _posterior_n_excludes_zero(posterior, feature_idx)
3194        a_null = not (float(fdr_a[feature_idx]) < fdr_threshold and n_a_excludes_zero)
3195        b_null = (not (float(fdr_b[feature_idx]) < fdr_threshold and n_b_excludes_zero)
3196                  if fdr_b is not None and not np.isnan(fdr_b[feature_idx])
3197                  else False)
3198        return a_null, b_null
3199
3200    return False, False
3201
3202
3203# ============================================================================
3204# Hill Parameter Marker Helpers
3205# ============================================================================
3206
3207def _extract_hill_param_samples(posterior, feature_idx):
3208    """Extract per-feature posterior samples (shape S,) for all Hill parameters."""
3209    def _get(key):
3210        if key not in posterior:
3211            return None
3212        arr = posterior[key]
3213        if hasattr(arr, 'cpu'):
3214            arr = arr.cpu().numpy()
3215        elif not isinstance(arr, np.ndarray):
3216            arr = np.asarray(arr)
3217        if arr.ndim == 2:        # (S, T)
3218            return arr[:, feature_idx]
3219        elif arr.ndim == 3:      # (S, C, T) - squeeze cis dim
3220            return arr[:, 0, feature_idx]
3221        return None
3222
3223    return {k: _get(k) for k in ['A', 'alpha', 'beta', 'Vmax_a', 'Vmax_b', 'K_a', 'K_b', 'n_a', 'n_b']
3224            if _get(k) is not None}
3225
3226
3227def _build_hill_markers_from_params(
3228    A, alpha, Vmax_a, K_a, n_a,
3229    beta=None, Vmax_b=None, K_b=None, n_b=None,
3230    a_null=False, b_null=False,
3231    is_additive=False,
3232    log2_space=True, y_scale=1.0,
3233) -> list:
3234    """
3235    Core Hill marker building logic shared by both posterior-based and summary-row-based callers.
3236
3237    Parameters
3238    ----------
3239    A, alpha, Vmax_a, K_a, n_a : float
3240        Posterior/summary mean values for component A parameters.
3241    beta, Vmax_b, K_b, n_b : float or None
3242        Component B parameters (additive_hill only).
3243    a_null, b_null : bool
3244        Whether each component is FDR-inactive (True = skip that component).
3245    is_additive : bool
3246        Whether this is an additive_hill model with both components.
3247    log2_space : bool
3248        True for negbinom (y-axis in log2). False for linear distributions.
3249    y_scale : float
3250        Multiplicative scale applied to linear y-values before plotting.
3251    """
3252    def yv(v):
3253        if v is None:
3254            return None
3255        if log2_space:
3256            return float(np.log2(v)) if v > 0 else None
3257        return float(v * y_scale)
3258
3259    def xv(k):
3260        if k is None or k <= 0:
3261            return None
3262        return float(np.log2(k))
3263
3264    markers = []
3265
3266    if not is_additive:
3267        # ── Single Hill ────────────────────────────────────────────────────
3268        lv = yv(A)
3269        hv = yv(A + alpha * Vmax_a)
3270        ev = xv(K_a)
3271        if lv is not None and np.isfinite(lv):
3272            markers.append({'axis': 'h', 'value': lv,
3273                            'label': 'log2(A)' if log2_space else 'A',
3274                            'linestyle': ':', 'color': 'darkred', 'alpha': 0.85})
3275        if hv is not None and np.isfinite(hv):
3276            markers.append({'axis': 'h', 'value': hv,
3277                            'label': 'log2(A+α·Vmax)' if log2_space else 'A+α·Vmax',
3278                            'linestyle': ':', 'color': 'darkblue', 'alpha': 0.85})
3279        if ev is not None and np.isfinite(ev):
3280            markers.append({'axis': 'v', 'value': ev, 'label': 'log2(EC50)',
3281                            'linestyle': '--', 'color': 'darkgreen', 'alpha': 0.85})
3282        return markers
3283
3284    # ── Additive Hill ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────
3285    if a_null or b_null:
3286        # ── Effectively single Hill ────────────────────────────────────────
3287        if a_null and not b_null:
3288            act_alpha, act_Vmax, act_K = beta, Vmax_b, K_b
3289        elif b_null and not a_null:
3290            act_alpha, act_Vmax, act_K = alpha, Vmax_a, K_a
3291        else:
3292            # Both null — just mark A
3293            lv = yv(A)
3294            if lv is not None and np.isfinite(lv):
3295                markers.append({'axis': 'h', 'value': lv,
3296                                'label': 'log2(A)' if log2_space else 'A',
3297                                'linestyle': ':', 'color': 'darkred', 'alpha': 0.85})
3298            return markers
3299
3300        lv = yv(A)
3301        hv = yv(A + act_alpha * act_Vmax)
3302        ev = xv(act_K)
3303        if lv is not None and np.isfinite(lv):
3304            markers.append({'axis': 'h', 'value': lv,
3305                            'label': 'log2(A)' if log2_space else 'A',
3306                            'linestyle': ':', 'color': 'darkred', 'alpha': 0.85})
3307        if hv is not None and np.isfinite(hv):
3308            markers.append({'axis': 'h', 'value': hv,
3309                            'label': 'log2(A+α·Vmax)' if log2_space else 'A+α·Vmax',
3310                            'linestyle': ':', 'color': 'darkblue', 'alpha': 0.85})
3311        if ev is not None and np.isfinite(ev):
3312            markers.append({'axis': 'v', 'value': ev, 'label': 'log2(EC50)',
3313                            'linestyle': '--', 'color': 'darkgreen', 'alpha': 0.85})
3314
3315    elif (n_a > 0) == (n_b > 0):
3316        # ── Same-sign monotone sum ─────────────────────────────────────────
3317        lv  = yv(A)
3318        hv  = yv(A + alpha * Vmax_a + beta * Vmax_b)
3319        e1  = xv(min(K_a, K_b))
3320        e2  = xv(max(K_a, K_b))
3321        if lv is not None and np.isfinite(lv):
3322            markers.append({'axis': 'h', 'value': lv,
3323                            'label': 'log2(A)' if log2_space else 'A',
3324                            'linestyle': ':', 'color': 'darkred', 'alpha': 0.85})
3325        if hv is not None and np.isfinite(hv):
3326            markers.append({'axis': 'h', 'value': hv,
3327                            'label': ('log2(A+α·Vmax_a+β·Vmax_b)' if log2_space
3328                                      else 'A+α·Vmax_a+β·Vmax_b'),
3329                            'linestyle': ':', 'color': 'darkblue', 'alpha': 0.85})
3330        if e1 is not None and np.isfinite(e1):
3331            markers.append({'axis': 'v', 'value': e1, 'label': 'log2(EC50_lower)',
3332                            'linestyle': '--', 'color': 'darkgreen', 'alpha': 0.85})
3333        if e2 is not None and np.isfinite(e2) and abs(e2 - e1) > 0.05:
3334            markers.append({'axis': 'v', 'value': e2, 'label': 'log2(EC50_upper)',
3335                            'linestyle': ':', 'color': 'darkgreen', 'alpha': 0.85})
3336
3337    else:
3338        # ── Non-monotonic (opposite-sign Hills) ───────────────────────────
3339        if n_a > 0:   # a activates, b inhibits
3340            asym_low_x  = A + beta  * Vmax_b
3341            asym_high_x = A + alpha * Vmax_a
3342            K_act, K_inh = K_a, K_b
3343        else:         # b activates, a inhibits
3344            asym_low_x  = A + alpha * Vmax_a
3345            asym_high_x = A + beta  * Vmax_b
3346            K_act, K_inh = K_b, K_a
3347
3348        has_peak  = (K_act < K_inh)
3349        peak_val  = A + alpha * Vmax_a + beta * Vmax_b
3350        a1 = yv(asym_low_x)
3351        a2 = yv(asym_high_x)
3352        e1 = xv(min(K_a, K_b))
3353        e2 = xv(max(K_a, K_b))
3354
3355        if a1 is not None and np.isfinite(a1):
3356            markers.append({'axis': 'h', 'value': a1,
3357                            'label': 'log2(y: x→0)' if log2_space else 'y(x→0)',
3358                            'linestyle': ':', 'color': 'darkred', 'alpha': 0.85})
3359        if a2 is not None and np.isfinite(a2) and (a1 is None or abs(a2 - a1) > 0.05):
3360            markers.append({'axis': 'h', 'value': a2,
3361                            'label': 'log2(y: x→∞)' if log2_space else 'y(x→∞)',
3362                            'linestyle': ':', 'color': 'darkblue', 'alpha': 0.85})
3363        if has_peak:
3364            pv = yv(peak_val)
3365            if pv is not None and np.isfinite(pv):
3366                markers.append({'axis': 'h', 'value': pv,
3367                                'label': ('log2(A+α·Vmax_a+β·Vmax_b) [peak]' if log2_space
3368                                          else 'A+α·Vmax_a+β·Vmax_b [peak]'),
3369                                'linestyle': '--', 'color': 'darkorange', 'alpha': 0.85})
3370        if e1 is not None and np.isfinite(e1):
3371            markers.append({'axis': 'v', 'value': e1, 'label': 'log2(EC50_lower)',
3372                            'linestyle': '--', 'color': 'darkgreen', 'alpha': 0.85})
3373        if e2 is not None and np.isfinite(e2) and abs(e2 - e1) > 0.05:
3374            markers.append({'axis': 'v', 'value': e2, 'label': 'log2(EC50_upper)',
3375                            'linestyle': ':', 'color': 'darkgreen', 'alpha': 0.85})
3376
3377    return markers
3378
3379
3380def _compute_hill_markers_from_summary_row(row, log2_space=True, y_scale=1.0,
3381                                           fdr_threshold=0.05) -> list:
3382    """
3383    Compute Hill parameter markers from a trans_summary DataFrame row.
3384
3385    Reads *_median columns for parameter values and fdr_alpha / fdr_beta for
3386    activity classification.  Returns the same list-of-dicts format as
3387    _compute_hill_markers / _build_hill_markers_from_params.
3388    """
3389    def _g(col, default=None):
3390        v = row.get(col, default)
3391        try:
3392            v = float(v)
3393        except (TypeError, ValueError):
3394            return default
3395        return v if np.isfinite(v) else default
3396
3397    A      = _g('A_median', 0.0);  alpha = _g('alpha_median', 1.0)
3398    Vmax_a = _g('Vmax_a_median');  K_a   = _g('K_a_median');  n_a = _g('n_a_median')
3399    if Vmax_a is None or K_a is None or n_a is None:
3400        return []
3401
3402    beta   = _g('beta_median', 0.0)
3403    Vmax_b = _g('Vmax_b_median');  K_b   = _g('K_b_median');  n_b = _g('n_b_median')
3404    is_additive = (Vmax_b is not None and K_b is not None and n_b is not None)
3405
3406    fdr_alpha_val = _g('fdr_alpha', 1.0)
3407    fdr_beta_val  = _g('fdr_beta',  1.0)
3408    a_null = fdr_alpha_val >= fdr_threshold
3409    b_null = fdr_beta_val  >= fdr_threshold
3410
3411    return _build_hill_markers_from_params(
3412        A=A, alpha=alpha, Vmax_a=Vmax_a, K_a=K_a, n_a=n_a,
3413        beta=beta, Vmax_b=Vmax_b, K_b=K_b, n_b=n_b,
3414        a_null=a_null, b_null=b_null,
3415        is_additive=is_additive,
3416        log2_space=log2_space, y_scale=y_scale,
3417    )
3418
3419
3420def _compute_hill_markers(model, feature, modality, log2_space=True, y_scale=1.0,
3421                          fdr_df=None, fdr_threshold=0.05):
3422    """
3423    Compute meaningful parameter markers for single_hill and additive_hill trans functions.
3424
3425    Returns a list of marker dicts with keys:
3426        'axis' ('h' or 'v'), 'value', 'label', 'linestyle', 'color', 'alpha'
3427
3428    Parameters
3429    ----------
3430    log2_space : bool
3431        True for negbinom (y-axis is log2). False for binomial/normal (linear y-axis).
3432    y_scale : float
3433        Multiplicative scale applied to linear y-values before plotting (e.g. 100 for PSI%).
3434    fdr_df : DataFrame, optional
3435        FDR summary table. If provided, used to determine which Hill components are active.
3436    fdr_threshold : float, default 0.05
3437        FDR threshold for classifying components as active.
3438    """
3439    # ── Resolve posterior and feature list ─────────────────────────────────
3440    if modality.name == model.primary_modality:
3441        if not hasattr(model, 'posterior_samples_trans') or model.posterior_samples_trans is None:
3442            return []
3443        posterior = model.posterior_samples_trans
3444        # Use modality.feature_names — always matches the fitted posterior dimensions.
3445        feature_list = list(modality.feature_names) if modality.feature_names is not None else []
3446    else:
3447        if not hasattr(modality, 'posterior_samples_trans') or modality.posterior_samples_trans is None:
3448            return []
3449        posterior = modality.posterior_samples_trans
3450        # modality.feature_names is the single source of truth (resolved + deduped
3451        # in Modality.__init__), no need to re-derive it here.
3452        if modality.feature_names is None:
3453            return []
3454        feature_list = list(modality.feature_names)
3455
3456    if feature not in feature_list:
3457        return []
3458    if 'Vmax_a' not in posterior:   # polynomial or unknown
3459        return []
3460
3461    feature_idx = feature_list.index(feature)
3462    params = _extract_hill_param_samples(posterior, feature_idx)
3463
3464    required = ['A', 'alpha', 'Vmax_a', 'K_a', 'n_a']
3465    if not all(k in params for k in required):
3466        return []
3467
3468    def pmean(key):
3469        return float(params[key].mean()) if key in params else None
3470
3471    A      = pmean('A');     alpha = pmean('alpha');  Vmax_a = pmean('Vmax_a')
3472    K_a    = pmean('K_a');   n_a   = pmean('n_a')
3473
3474    is_additive = ('Vmax_b' in posterior and 'Vmax_b' in params and
3475                   'n_b' in params and 'beta' in params and 'K_b' in params)
3476
3477    beta = Vmax_b = K_b = n_b = None
3478    if is_additive:
3479        beta   = pmean('beta');  Vmax_b = pmean('Vmax_b')
3480        K_b    = pmean('K_b');   n_b    = pmean('n_b')
3481
3482        # Null classification: same criterion used everywhere else (predict_trans_function,
3483        # predict_trans_derivatives, save_trans_summary) so the curve, its derivatives,
3484        # and these markers always agree on which component(s) are "on".
3485        a_null, b_null = _resolve_hill_null_flags(
3486            feature, feature_idx, posterior, fdr_df=fdr_df, fdr_threshold=fdr_threshold
3487        )
3488    else:
3489        a_null = b_null = False
3490
3491    return _build_hill_markers_from_params(
3492        A=A, alpha=alpha, Vmax_a=Vmax_a, K_a=K_a, n_a=n_a,
3493        beta=beta, Vmax_b=Vmax_b, K_b=K_b, n_b=n_b,
3494        a_null=a_null, b_null=b_null,
3495        is_additive=is_additive,
3496        log2_space=log2_space, y_scale=y_scale,
3497    )
3498
3499
3500def _draw_hill_markers(ax, markers, x_offset=0.0, y_offset=0.0):
3501    """Draw Hill parameter marker lines (axhline / axvline) on ax.
3502
3503    Parameters
3504    ----------
3505    x_offset, y_offset : float
3506        Subtract these from x/y marker values before drawing.  Pass the
3507        log2FC offsets (log2(x_ntc), log2(y_ntc)) when the plot axes are in
3508        log2FC space so that markers align with the shifted data.  Labels are
3509        automatically updated to say ``log2FC(...)`` when offsets are non-zero.
3510    """
3511    in_log2fc = (x_offset != 0.0 or y_offset != 0.0)
3512    for m in markers:
3513        label = m['label']
3514        if in_log2fc:
3515            label = label.replace('log2(', 'log2FC(')
3516        kw = dict(linestyle=m['linestyle'], color=m['color'],
3517                  alpha=m['alpha'], linewidth=1, label=label)
3518        if m['axis'] == 'h':
3519            ax.axhline(m['value'] - y_offset, **kw)
3520        elif m['axis'] == 'v':
3521            ax.axvline(m['value'] - x_offset, **kw)
3522

3528def _save_figure(fig, model, filename):
3529    """Save fig to model.output_dir/filename (adds .png if no extension)."""
3530    if filename is None:
3531        return
3532    import os
3533    if not os.path.splitext(filename)[1]:
3534        filename = filename + '.png'
3535    if os.path.isabs(filename):
3536        save_path = filename
3537    else:
3538        save_path = os.path.join(model.output_dir, filename)
3539    os.makedirs(os.path.dirname(save_path), exist_ok=True)
3540    fig.savefig(save_path, bbox_inches='tight')
3541    print(f"[PLOT] Saved to {save_path}")
3542
3543
3544def _compute_global_log2fc_offsets(
3545    model, modality, feature_name: str, x_true: np.ndarray,
3546    subset_mask: Optional[np.ndarray], sum_factor_col: str
3547) -> Tuple[float, float]:
3548    """
3549    Compute the NTC log2 x_offset and y_offset from the GLOBAL (non-faceted) data.
3550
3551    This must be called with only the top-level ``subset_mask`` (no facet mask),
3552    so that all panels for the same feature share an identical NTC reference —
3553    even panels that contain no NTC cells (e.g. a "Targeting" facet column).
3554
3555    y_offset priority (consistent with ``save_trans_summary``):
3556    1. ``mu_ntc`` from ``modality.posterior_samples_ntc`` (model-smoothed reference-
3557       group NTC expression rate from ``fit_technical``).  Shape [n_samples, T]; we take
3558       the posterior mean for the requested feature.
3559    2. Fallback (``fit_technical`` not run): empirical mean of ``y_obs / sum_factor`` for
3560       NTC reference-group cells (group_code == 0), or all NTC cells if no reference group
3561       is tagged.
3562
3563    Returns
3564    -------
3565    (x_offset, y_offset) : (float, float)
3566        Both in log2 space; 0.0 if no valid NTC cells found.
3567    """
3568    feature_idx = _get_feature_index(feature_name, modality)
3569    if feature_idx is None:
3570        return 0.0, 0.0
3571
3572    # Get counts for this feature
3573    if modality.cells_axis == 1:
3574        y_obs = modality.counts[feature_idx, :]
3575    else:
3576        y_obs = modality.counts[:, feature_idx]
3577
3578    # Align cells using the global subset_mask (no facet restriction)
3579    x_true_aligned, y_obs_aligned, meta_aligned = _align_cells_to_modality(
3580        model, modality, x_true, y_obs, subset_mask
3581    )
3582
3583    is_ntc = (meta_aligned['target'].str.lower() == 'ntc').values
3584
3585    # x_offset: mean log2 NTC x_true (pooled, group-independent)
3586    x_ntc = x_true_aligned[is_ntc & (x_true_aligned > 0)]
3587    x_offset = np.log2(float(x_ntc.mean())) if len(x_ntc) > 0 else 0.0
3588
3589    # y_offset: use mu_ntc from technical fit when available (matches save_trans_summary).
3590    # mu_ntc shape in posterior_samples_ntc: [n_samples, T].
3591    # It represents the reference-group NTC expression rate — the same quantity that
3592    # save_trans_summary uses as y_ntc for log2FC parameter computation.
3593    y_offset = None
3594    if (hasattr(modality, 'posterior_samples_ntc')
3595            and modality.posterior_samples_ntc is not None
3596            and 'mu_ntc' in modality.posterior_samples_ntc):
3597        mu_ntc = modality.posterior_samples_ntc['mu_ntc']
3598        if hasattr(mu_ntc, 'cpu'):          # torch.Tensor
3599            mu_ntc = mu_ntc.cpu().numpy()
3600        mu_ntc = np.asarray(mu_ntc, dtype=float)
3601        # Collapse any unexpected leading dims beyond (samples, features)
3602        while mu_ntc.ndim > 2:
3603            mu_ntc = mu_ntc.mean(axis=0)
3604        # Average over posterior samples → [T], then pick this feature
3605        mu_ntc_mean = mu_ntc.mean(axis=0)   # [T]
3606        if feature_idx < len(mu_ntc_mean):
3607            y_ntc_val = float(mu_ntc_mean[feature_idx])
3608            if np.isfinite(y_ntc_val) and y_ntc_val > 0:
3609                y_offset = np.log2(y_ntc_val)
3610
3611    if y_offset is None:
3612        # Fallback: empirical NTC reference-group mean (when fit_technical not run).
3613        # Requires modality.sum_factors, which is only populated for modalities that
3614        # went through sum-factor normalization (typically the primary 'gene'/'cis'
3615        # modality) -- other modalities (e.g. splicing) may have sum_factors=None.
3616        # This fallback -- and therefore y_offset -- is only meaningful for negbinom
3617        # callers anyway (non-negbinom distributions discard y_offset), so silently
3618        # fall back to 0.0 rather than raising when sum_factors is unavailable.
3619        if getattr(modality, 'sum_factors', None) is not None:
3620            sf_aligned = modality.sum_factors.loc[
3621                meta_aligned['cell'].values, sum_factor_col
3622            ].values
3623            if 'technical_group_code' in meta_aligned.columns:
3624                ntc_ref_mask = is_ntc & (meta_aligned['technical_group_code'].values == 0)
3625            else:
3626                ntc_ref_mask = is_ntc
3627            y_ntc_expr = y_obs_aligned[ntc_ref_mask] / sf_aligned[ntc_ref_mask]
3628            y_ntc_valid = y_ntc_expr[(y_ntc_expr > 0) & np.isfinite(y_ntc_expr)]
3629            if len(y_ntc_valid) == 0:           # fallback: pooled NTC (all groups)
3630                y_ntc_expr = y_obs_aligned[is_ntc] / sf_aligned[is_ntc]
3631                y_ntc_valid = y_ntc_expr[(y_ntc_expr > 0) & np.isfinite(y_ntc_expr)]
3632            y_offset = np.log2(float(y_ntc_valid.mean())) if len(y_ntc_valid) > 0 else 0.0
3633        else:
3634            y_offset = 0.0
3635
3636    return x_offset, y_offset
3637

3639def _collect_legend_handles(axes):
3640    """Collect deduplicated (handle, label) pairs from a list of axes."""
3641    handles, labels = [], []
3642    for ax in axes:
3643        for h, l in zip(*ax.get_legend_handles_labels()):
3644            if l not in labels:
3645                handles.append(h)
3646                labels.append(l)
3647    return handles, labels

3650def plot_negbinom_xy(
3651    model,
3652    feature: str,
3653    modality,
3654    x_true: np.ndarray,
3655    window: int,
3656    show_correction: str,
3657    color_palette: Dict[str, str],
3658    show_hill_function: bool,
3659    show_ntc_gradient: bool = False,
3660    sum_factor_col: str = 'sum_factor',
3661    min_counts: int = 0,
3662    xlabel: str = "log2(x_true)",
3663    ax: Optional[plt.Axes] = None,
3664    subset_mask: Optional[np.ndarray] = None,
3665    mark_params = False,
3666    ci_level: float = 95.0,
3667    legend_outside: bool = False,
3668    figsize: Optional[Tuple[float, float]] = None,
3669    log2fc: bool = False,
3670    reference_df=None,
