3672    fdr_threshold: float = 0.05,
3673    color_by: Union[str, List[str]] = 'technical_group',
3674    ntc_x_offset: Optional[float] = None,
3675    ntc_y_offset: Optional[float] = None,
3676    hill_color: str = 'black',
3677    hill_label: str = 'Fitted Trans Function',
3678    ref_color: str = 'red',
3679    ref_label: str = 'Reference Function',
3680    expand_x_to_params: bool = False,
3681    expand_y_to_params: bool = False,
3682    ylabel: Optional[str] = None,
3683    **kwargs
3684) -> plt.Axes:
3685    """
3686    Plot negbinom (gene counts) with optional Hill function overlay.
3687
3688    Y-axis: log2(counts / sum_factor), optionally alpha_y-corrected.
3689
3690    Parameters (selected)
3691    ---------------------
3692    color_by : str or list of two str
3693        What to color smoothed lines by. Options:
3694        - ``'technical_group'`` (default): one line per cell-line / technical group
3695        - ``'targeting'``: two lines — NTC vs all targeting cells
3696        - Any column name in ``model.meta``: one line per unique value
3697        - A **list of two** values (e.g. ``['technical_group', 'targeting']``): cross-product
3698          of two groupings. The first determines hue; the second determines shade — NTC gets
3699          a lighter tint of the group colour, Targeting gets the full colour.
3700
3701    Parameters
3702    ----------
3703    show_ntc_gradient : bool
3704        If True, color lines by NTC proportion in k-NN window (default: False)
3705        Lighter colors = more NTC cells, Darker colors = fewer NTC cells
3706        Only applies to uncorrected plots
3707    sum_factor_col : str
3708        Column name in model.meta for sum factors (default: 'sum_factor')
3709        Can be 'sum_factor', 'sum_factor_adj', or any other sum factor column
3710    min_counts : int
3711        Minimum raw counts to include a cell (default: 0, i.e., include all cells)
3712    """
3713    # Get data
3714    feature_idx = _get_feature_index(feature, modality)
3715    if feature_idx is None:
3716        raise ValueError(f"Feature '{feature}' not found in modality")
3717
3718    # Get counts for this feature
3719    if modality.cells_axis == 1:
3720        y_obs = modality.counts[feature_idx, :]
3721    else:
3722        y_obs = modality.counts[:, feature_idx]
3723
3724    # Check if sum_factor_col exists on modality sum_factors
3725    if modality.sum_factors is None or sum_factor_col not in modality.sum_factors.columns:
3726        raise ValueError(
3727            f"Sum factor column '{sum_factor_col}' not found in modality sum_factors. "
3728            f"Available columns: {list(modality.sum_factors.columns) if modality.sum_factors is not None else '(none)'}"
3729        )
3730
3731    # Align cells between model.meta and modality
3732    x_true_aligned, y_obs_aligned, meta_aligned = _align_cells_to_modality(
3733        model, modality, x_true, y_obs, subset_mask
3734    )
3735
3736    # Build dataframe — read sum factors from modality, not from meta_aligned
3737    df_data = {
3738        'x_true': x_true_aligned,
3739        'y_obs': y_obs_aligned,
3740        'target': meta_aligned['target'].values,
3741        'sum_factor': modality.sum_factors.loc[meta_aligned['cell'].values, sum_factor_col].values
3742    }
3743
3744    # Conditionally add technical_group_code if it exists
3745    if 'technical_group_code' in meta_aligned.columns:
3746        df_data['technical_group_code'] = meta_aligned['technical_group_code'].values
3747
3748    # Forward any extra meta columns referenced in color_by into df_data now,
3749    # before the DataFrame is built, so that the min_counts filter applies to them too.
3750    _cb_items = [color_by] if isinstance(color_by, str) else list(color_by)
3751    _SPECIAL_CB = {'technical_group', 'targeting'}
3752    for _cb in _cb_items:
3753        if _cb in _SPECIAL_CB or _cb in df_data:
3754            continue
3755        if _cb in meta_aligned.columns:
3756            df_data[_cb] = meta_aligned[_cb].values
3757        # If not found anywhere, _resolve_grouping will warn later.
3758
3759    df = pd.DataFrame(df_data)
3760
3761    # Filter by min_counts (exclude cells with raw counts below threshold)
3762    if min_counts > 0:
3763        df = df[df['y_obs'] >= min_counts].copy()
3764
3765    # Technical correction
3766    has_technical_fit = modality.alpha_y_prefit is not None
3767
3768    if show_correction == 'corrected' and not has_technical_fit:
3769        warnings.warn(f"Technical fit not available for modality '{modality.name}' - showing uncorrected only")
3770        show_correction = 'uncorrected'
3771
3772    # Create axes
3773    if ax is None:
3774        if show_correction == 'both':
3775            fig, axes = plt.subplots(1, 2, figsize=figsize or (14, 5))
3776        else:
3777            fig, ax = plt.subplots(1, 1, figsize=figsize or (8, 5))
3778            axes = [ax]
3779    else:
3780        # Single axis provided - in multifeature mode, function is called twice
3781        # (once with 'uncorrected' and once with 'corrected'), so don't override show_correction
3782        axes = [ax]
3783
3784    # Map technical_group_code → label using only codes present in this df
3785    # If no technical groups, treat as single group
3786    code_to_label = _labels_by_code_for_df(model, df)
3787
3788    if 'technical_group_code' in df.columns:
3789        group_codes = np.sort(df['technical_group_code'].unique())
3790    else:
3791        group_codes = np.array([0])  # Single group
3792
3793    group_labels = [code_to_label[int(c)] for c in group_codes]
3794
3795    # Detect NTC cells for gradient coloring
3796    is_ntc = df['target'].str.lower() == 'ntc'
3797
3798    # Compute NTC reference offsets for log2FC mode.
3799    # x_offset: pooled NTC x_true (x_true is group-independent).
3800    # y_offset: reference group (group_code=0, alpha_y=1.0) NTC uncorrected expression.
3801    #   Because alpha_y=1.0 for the reference group, its uncorrected NTC equals the corrected
3802    #   NTC for any group — so this is the natural "true NTC" baseline.
3803    #
3804    # ntc_x_offset / ntc_y_offset: pre-computed overrides supplied by the caller
3805    # (plot_xy_data passes these when faceting, so that panels without NTC cells —
3806    # e.g. the "Targeting" facet — still use the correct global NTC baseline).
3807    if log2fc:
3808        if ntc_x_offset is not None and ntc_y_offset is not None:
3809            # Use caller-supplied global offsets (correct even when df has no NTC cells)
3810            x_offset = ntc_x_offset
3811            y_offset = ntc_y_offset
3812        else:
3813            ntc_df = df[is_ntc]
3814            x_ntc_valid = ntc_df['x_true'][ntc_df['x_true'] > 0]
3815            if len(x_ntc_valid) > 0:
3816                x_offset = np.log2(float(x_ntc_valid.mean()))
3817            else:
3818                warnings.warn("log2fc=True: no valid NTC cells found for x; plotting raw log2 instead.")
3819                x_offset = 0.0
3820            # y_offset: prefer mu_ntc from technical fit (same source as save_trans_summary).
3821            # mu_ntc is the model-inferred reference-group NTC expression rate [n_samples, T].
3822            # Fall back to empirical NTC reference-group mean when fit_technical not run.
3823            _feature_idx = _get_feature_index(feature, modality)
3824            _y_offset_from_technical = None
3825            if (_feature_idx is not None
3826                    and hasattr(modality, 'posterior_samples_ntc')
3827                    and modality.posterior_samples_ntc is not None
3828                    and 'mu_ntc' in modality.posterior_samples_ntc):
3829                _mu_ntc = modality.posterior_samples_ntc['mu_ntc']
3830                if hasattr(_mu_ntc, 'cpu'):
3831                    _mu_ntc = _mu_ntc.cpu().numpy()
3832                _mu_ntc = np.asarray(_mu_ntc, dtype=float)
3833                while _mu_ntc.ndim > 2:
3834                    _mu_ntc = _mu_ntc.mean(axis=0)
3835                _mu_ntc_mean = _mu_ntc.mean(axis=0)   # [T]
3836                if _feature_idx < len(_mu_ntc_mean):
3837                    _val = float(_mu_ntc_mean[_feature_idx])
3838                    if np.isfinite(_val) and _val > 0:
3839                        _y_offset_from_technical = np.log2(_val)
3840            if _y_offset_from_technical is not None:
3841                y_offset = _y_offset_from_technical
3842            else:
3843                # Empirical fallback: reference-group NTC mean
3844                if 'technical_group_code' in ntc_df.columns:
3845                    ntc_ref_df = ntc_df[ntc_df['technical_group_code'] == 0]
3846                else:
3847                    ntc_ref_df = ntc_df
3848                y_ntc_expr = ntc_ref_df['y_obs'] / ntc_ref_df['sum_factor']
3849                y_ntc_valid = y_ntc_expr[(y_ntc_expr > 0) & np.isfinite(y_ntc_expr)]
3850                if len(y_ntc_valid) == 0:  # fallback to pooled if reference group has no NTC
3851                    y_ntc_expr = ntc_df['y_obs'] / ntc_df['sum_factor']
3852                    y_ntc_valid = y_ntc_expr[(y_ntc_expr > 0) & np.isfinite(y_ntc_expr)]
3853                y_offset = np.log2(float(y_ntc_valid.mean())) if len(y_ntc_valid) > 0 else 0.0
3854    else:
3855        x_offset = 0.0
3856        y_offset = 0.0
3857
3858    # Build color groups based on color_by.
3859    # color_by can be a str (single grouping) or a list of two str (cross-product).
3860    # Alpha_y correction is always per technical_group_code regardless of color_by.
3861
3862    def _resolve_grouping(cb):
3863        """Return list of (label, boolean_mask) for one color_by value, or None if not found."""
3864        if cb == 'technical_group':
3865            if 'technical_group_code' in df.columns:
3866                return [(code_to_label[int(gc)], df['technical_group_code'] == gc)
3867                        for gc in group_codes]
3868            return [('All', pd.Series(True, index=df.index))]
3869        if cb == 'targeting':
3870            ntc_m = df['target'].str.lower() == 'ntc'
3871            return [('NTC', ntc_m), ('Targeting', ~ntc_m)]
3872        if cb in df.columns:
3873            n_unique = df[cb].nunique()
3874            if n_unique == 0:
3875                warnings.warn(f"color_by='{cb}': column has no values after filtering.")
3876                return [('All', pd.Series(True, index=df.index))]
3877            if pd.api.types.is_float_dtype(df[cb]) and n_unique > 10:
3878                warnings.warn(
3879                    f"color_by='{cb}' looks continuous (float dtype, {n_unique} unique values). "
3880                    f"Coloring by a continuous column will produce many overlapping lines. "
3881                    f"Consider binning or using a categorical column instead."
3882                )
3883            elif n_unique > 30:
3884                warnings.warn(
3885                    f"color_by='{cb}' has {n_unique} unique values — this will produce "
3886                    f"{n_unique} smoothed lines and may be hard to read. "
3887                    f"Consider a coarser grouping."
3888                )
3889            uvals = sorted(df[cb].dropna().unique(), key=str)
3890            return [(str(v), df[cb] == v) for v in uvals]
3891        return None  # not found
3892
3893    _cb_list = [color_by] if isinstance(color_by, str) else list(color_by)
3894
3895    if len(_cb_list) == 1:
3896        # ── Single grouping ──────────────────────────────────────────────────
3897        groups = _resolve_grouping(_cb_list[0])
3898        if groups is None:
3899            warnings.warn(f"color_by='{_cb_list[0]}' not found in data; "
3900                          "falling back to 'technical_group'.")
3901            groups = _resolve_grouping('technical_group')
3902        color_groups_list = groups
3903
3904    else:
3905        # ── Cross-product of two groupings, with auto shade variation ────────
3906        # Primary grouping determines hue; secondary determines shade.
3907        # For 'targeting' as secondary: NTC → light shade, Targeting → full color.
3908        # For any other secondary: shades spread evenly from light to full.
3909        primary_cb, secondary_cb = _cb_list[0], _cb_list[1]
3910        primary_groups   = _resolve_grouping(primary_cb)   or _resolve_grouping('technical_group')
3911        secondary_groups = _resolve_grouping(secondary_cb) or [('All', pd.Series(True, index=df.index))]
3912
3913        if secondary_cb == 'targeting':
3914            _shade_for = {'NTC': 0.35, 'Targeting': 1.0}
3915        else:
3916            _n = len(secondary_groups)
3917            _shade_for = {lbl: 0.3 + 0.7 * i / max(_n - 1, 1)
3918                          for i, (lbl, _) in enumerate(secondary_groups)}
3919
3920        # Build cross-product; auto-populate color_palette with shade colours.
3921        # shade=1.0 → full base colour; shade<1.0 → mixed with white (lighter).
3922        from matplotlib.colors import to_rgb, to_hex
3923        color_palette = dict(color_palette)  # local copy — do not mutate caller's dict
3924        color_groups_list = []
3925        for pidx, (plabel, pmask) in enumerate(primary_groups):
3926            base_color = _color_for_label(plabel, fallback_idx=pidx, palette=color_palette)
3927            try:
3928                base_rgb = np.array(to_rgb(base_color))
3929            except ValueError:
3930                base_rgb = np.array([0.5, 0.5, 0.5])
3931            for slabel, smask in secondary_groups:
3932                combined_mask = pmask & smask
3933                if not combined_mask.any():
3934                    continue
3935                combined_label = f"{plabel} / {slabel}"
3936                if combined_label not in color_palette:
3937                    shade = _shade_for.get(slabel, 1.0)
3938                    shaded = np.clip(1 - shade * (1 - base_rgb), 0, 1)
3939                    color_palette[combined_label] = to_hex(shaded)
3940                color_groups_list.append((combined_label, combined_mask))
3941
3942    # Create colormaps for NTC gradient — one per color group (white → group color)
3943    group_cmaps = {}
3944    if show_ntc_gradient:
3945        for idx, (group_label, _) in enumerate(color_groups_list):
3946            base_color = _color_for_label(group_label, fallback_idx=idx, palette=color_palette)
3947            group_cmaps[group_label] = LinearSegmentedColormap.from_list(
3948                f"white_{group_label}", ["white", base_color]
3949            )
3950
3951    # Plot function
3952    def _plot_one(ax_plot, corrected):
3953        # Compute per-cell y_expr with alpha_y correction applied per technical group.
3954        # This is independent of color_by — correction always uses technical_group_code.
3955        if corrected and has_technical_fit:
3956            alpha_y_full = modality.alpha_y_prefit  # [C, T] or [S, C, T]
3957            y_expr_vals = np.empty(len(df))
3958            if 'technical_group_code' in df.columns:
3959                for gc in df['technical_group_code'].unique():
3960                    gc = int(gc)
3961                    if alpha_y_full.ndim == 3:
3962                        a = _to_scalar(alpha_y_full[:, gc, feature_idx].mean())
3963                    else:
3964                        a = _to_scalar(alpha_y_full[gc, feature_idx])
3965                    mask = df['technical_group_code'].values == gc
3966                    y_expr_vals[mask] = (df['y_obs'].values[mask] /
3967                                         (df['sum_factor'].values[mask] * a))
3968            else:
3969                y_expr_vals = (df['y_obs'] / df['sum_factor']).values
3970        else:
3971            y_expr_vals = (df['y_obs'] / df['sum_factor']).values
3972        y_expr_all = pd.Series(y_expr_vals, index=df.index)
3973
3974        # Accumulate bounds from plotted data so we can set explicit axis limits.
3975        # axhline / axvline are infinite lines that confuse matplotlib's auto-scaling;
3976        # explicit set_xlim / set_ylim ensures the view is driven by the data.
3977        _ax_x_segments = []   # (x_min, x_max) from each smooth curve
3978        _ax_y_segments = []   # (y_min, y_max) from each smooth curve
3979        _ax_y_hill = []       # y values from Hill curve (filtered to displayed x range)
3980        _ax_h_markers = []    # y positions of horizontal parameter lines
3981        _ax_v_markers = []    # x positions of vertical parameter lines (K / EC50)
3982
3983        colorbar_added = False
3984        for idx, (group_label, group_mask) in enumerate(color_groups_list):
3985            df_group = df[group_mask].copy()
3986            y_expr = y_expr_all[group_mask]
3987
3988            # Filter valid cells for kNN smoothing.
3989            # Require positive x_true (log2 axis) and finite y_expr.
3990            # Zero-count cells (y_expr=0) ARE included: isfinite(0) = True.
3991            # The Hill function is the model's *unconditional* expected value
3992            # E[y/SF] = A + α·Hill_a + β·Hill_b, which averages over all cells
3993            # including zero-count ones.  The y_offset (from mu_ntc or empirical NTC
3994            # mean) is also the unconditional reference.  Excluding zeros would raise
3995            # the kNN smooth to the *conditional* mean E[y/SF | y>0] > E[y/SF],
3996            # making it appear above the Hill curve.
3997            # Windows where every cell in the kNN neighbourhood has zero counts
3998            # are removed by the subsequent valid_smooth = y_smooth_linear > 0 filter,
3999            # so no log2(0) is ever taken.
4000            valid = (df_group['x_true'] > 0) & np.isfinite(y_expr)
4001            df_group = df_group[valid].copy()
4002            y_expr = y_expr[valid]
4003
4004            if len(df_group) == 0:
4005                continue
4006
4007            is_ntc_group = is_ntc[df_group.index].values
4008            k = _knn_k(len(df_group), window)
4009
4010            # k-NN smoothing in LINEAR space first (log2(mean(y)) ≥ mean(log2(y)))
4011            if show_ntc_gradient:
4012                x_smooth, y_smooth_linear, ntc_prop = _smooth_knn(
4013                    df_group['x_true'].values,
4014                    y_expr.values if hasattr(y_expr, 'values') else np.asarray(y_expr),
4015                    k, is_ntc=is_ntc_group
4016                )
4017                valid_smooth = y_smooth_linear > 0
4018                if not valid_smooth.all():
4019                    x_smooth = x_smooth[valid_smooth]
4020                    y_smooth_linear = y_smooth_linear[valid_smooth]
4021                    ntc_prop = ntc_prop[valid_smooth]
4022                y_smooth_log = np.log2(y_smooth_linear)
4023                _xs = np.log2(x_smooth) - x_offset
4024                _ys = y_smooth_log - y_offset
4025                group_cmap = group_cmaps.get(group_label, plt.cm.gray)
4026                plot_colored_line(
4027                    x=_xs, y=_ys,
4028                    color_values=1 - ntc_prop,
4029                    cmap=group_cmap, ax=ax_plot, linewidth=2
4030                )
4031                if len(_xs) > 0:
4032                    _ax_x_segments.append((float(_xs.min()), float(_xs.max())))
4033                    _ax_y_segments.append((float(_ys.min()), float(_ys.max())))
4034                color = _color_for_label(group_label, fallback_idx=idx, palette=color_palette)
4035                ax_plot.plot([], [], color=color, linewidth=2, label=group_label)
4036                if not colorbar_added:
4037                    fig = ax_plot.get_figure()
4038                    cmap_gray = LinearSegmentedColormap.from_list("gray_gradient", ["white", "black"])
4039                    sm = ScalarMappable(cmap=cmap_gray, norm=Normalize(0, 1))
4040                    sm.set_array([])
4041                    cbar = fig.colorbar(sm, ax=ax_plot)
4042                    cbar.set_label('1 - Proportion NTC (darker = fewer NTCs)')
4043                    colorbar_added = True
4044            else:
4045                x_smooth, y_smooth_linear = _smooth_knn(
4046                    df_group['x_true'].values,
4047                    y_expr.values if hasattr(y_expr, 'values') else np.asarray(y_expr),
4048                    k
4049                )
4050                valid_smooth = y_smooth_linear > 0
4051                if not valid_smooth.all():
4052                    x_smooth = x_smooth[valid_smooth]
4053                    y_smooth_linear = y_smooth_linear[valid_smooth]
4054                y_smooth_log = np.log2(y_smooth_linear)
4055                _xs = np.log2(x_smooth) - x_offset
4056                _ys = y_smooth_log - y_offset
4057                color = _color_for_label(group_label, fallback_idx=idx, palette=color_palette)
4058                ax_plot.plot(_xs, _ys, color=color, linewidth=2, label=group_label)
4059                if len(_xs) > 0:
4060                    _ax_x_segments.append((float(_xs.min()), float(_xs.max())))
4061                    _ax_y_segments.append((float(_ys.min()), float(_ys.max())))
4062
4063        # Trans function overlay (if trans model fitted)
4064        # Show on corrected plot if available, otherwise show on uncorrected plot
4065        if show_hill_function and (corrected or not has_technical_fit):
4066            # Evenly spaced points in log2 space for smooth curve on log-log plot
4067            log2_min = np.log2(max(x_true.min(), 1e-6))
4068            log2_max = np.log2(x_true.max())
4069            if expand_x_to_params and mark_params:
4070                # Extend range to include K_a / K_b posterior means
4071                _posterior_ep = (model.posterior_samples_trans
4072                                 if modality.name == model.primary_modality
4073                                 else getattr(modality, 'posterior_samples_trans', None))
4074                if _posterior_ep is not None and 'K_a' in _posterior_ep:
4075                    _fnames_ep = (list(modality.feature_names)
4076                                  if modality.feature_names is not None else [])
4077                    if feature in _fnames_ep:
4078                        _fi_ep = _fnames_ep.index(feature)
4079                        for _kname in ('K_a', 'K_b'):
4080                            if _kname in _posterior_ep:
4081                                _ks = _posterior_ep[_kname]
4082                                _km = (_ks.mean(dim=0) if hasattr(_ks, 'mean')
4083                                       else np.mean(_ks, axis=0))
4084                                if hasattr(_km, 'detach'):
4085                                    _km = _km.detach().cpu().numpy()
4086                                _km = np.asarray(_km).ravel()
4087                                if _fi_ep < len(_km):
4088                                    _k_val = float(_km[_fi_ep])
4089                                    if _k_val > 0:
4090                                        log2_min = min(log2_min, np.log2(_k_val))
4091                                        log2_max = max(log2_max, np.log2(_k_val))
4092            x_range = 2 ** np.linspace(log2_min, log2_max, 2000)
4093            # Use reference_df as FDR source if no explicit fdr_df provided (also
4094            # used below for markers, so components are gated consistently
4095            # between the plotted curve and its parameter markers).
4096            _effective_fdr_df = fdr_df if fdr_df is not None else reference_df
4097            y_pred = predict_trans_function(model, feature, x_range, modality_name=None,
4098                                             fdr_threshold=fdr_threshold, fdr_df=_effective_fdr_df)
4099
4100            if y_pred is not None:
4101                # Transform prediction to log2(y) space to match data
4102                # Filter out zero/negative predictions
4103                valid_pred = y_pred > 0
4104                if valid_pred.any():
4105                    _xh = np.log2(x_range[valid_pred]) - x_offset
4106                    _yh = np.log2(y_pred[valid_pred]) - y_offset
4107                    ax_plot.plot(_xh, _yh,
4108                                color=hill_color, linestyle='--', linewidth=2,
4109                                label=hill_label)
4110                    # Collect Hill y values within the smooth x range (extended by
4111                    # any V markers below) — done after markers are computed.
4112                    # Store the full arrays for now; we trim after markers.
4113                    _ax_y_hill_xh = _xh
4114                    _ax_y_hill_yh = _yh
4115                else:
4116                    _ax_y_hill_xh = _ax_y_hill_yh = None
4117            else:
4118                _ax_y_hill_xh = _ax_y_hill_yh = None
4119
4120            # Full parameter markers (replaces simple A baseline)
4121            _show_fit_markers = mark_params in (True, 'both', 'fit')
4122            _show_ref_markers = mark_params in (True, 'both', 'reference')
4123            if _show_fit_markers and (corrected or not has_technical_fit):
4124                _markers = _compute_hill_markers(
4125                    model, feature, modality,
4126                    log2_space=True, y_scale=1.0,
4127                    fdr_df=_effective_fdr_df, fdr_threshold=fdr_threshold,
4128                )
4129                # In log2FC mode the axes are shifted; pass the same offsets so
4130                # that parameter lines (A, Vmax ceiling, EC50) land at the correct
4131                # positions — consistent with A_log2fc / EC50_*_log2fc in
4132                # save_trans_summary.
4133                _moff_x = x_offset if log2fc else 0.0
4134                _moff_y = y_offset if log2fc else 0.0
4135                _draw_hill_markers(ax_plot, _markers,
4136                                   x_offset=_moff_x,
4137                                   y_offset=_moff_y)
4138                # Collect marker positions for axis-limit computation
4139                for _m in _markers:
4140                    if _m['axis'] == 'h':
4141                        _ax_h_markers.append(_m['value'] - _moff_y)
4142                    elif _m['axis'] == 'v':
4143                        _ax_v_markers.append(_m['value'] - _moff_x)
4144
4145            # Now that V markers are known, compute final displayed x range and
4146            # trim Hill y to that range (so Hill y doesn't set limits for x values
4147            # that aren't visible in the smooth).
4148            if _ax_x_segments:
4149                _x_lo = min(s[0] for s in _ax_x_segments)
4150                _x_hi = max(s[1] for s in _ax_x_segments)
4151                if _ax_v_markers:             # K markers extend x range
4152                    _x_lo = min(_x_lo, min(_ax_v_markers))
4153                    _x_hi = max(_x_hi, max(_ax_v_markers))
4154                if _ax_y_hill_xh is not None and len(_ax_y_hill_xh) > 0:
4155                    if expand_y_to_params:
4156                        _ax_y_hill.extend(_ax_y_hill_yh.tolist())
4157                    else:
4158                        _in_xr = (_ax_y_hill_xh >= _x_lo) & (_ax_y_hill_xh <= _x_hi)
4159                        if _in_xr.any():
4160                            _ax_y_hill.extend(_ax_y_hill_yh[_in_xr].tolist())
4161
4162            # When expand_y_to_params, also sample Hill at x→0 and x→∞ to capture
4163            # asymptotes (A floor and A+α·Vmax ceiling) even when they are outside
4164            # the data x range or when both Hill components are classified as null
4165            # (which suppresses the A+Vmax ceiling h_marker in mark_params mode).
4166            if expand_y_to_params and y_pred is not None:
4167                _x_asym = np.array([max(x_range[0] * 1e-6, 1e-30), x_range[-1] * 1e6])
4168                _y_asym = predict_trans_function(model, feature, _x_asym, modality_name=None,
4169                                                  fdr_threshold=fdr_threshold, fdr_df=_effective_fdr_df)
4170                if _y_asym is not None:
4171                    _valid_asym = _y_asym > 0
4172                    if _valid_asym.any():
4173                        _ax_y_hill.extend(
4174                            (np.log2(_y_asym[_valid_asym]) - y_offset).tolist()
4175                        )
4176
4177            # Reference curve overlay (from trans_summary DataFrame)
4178            if reference_df is not None and (corrected or not has_technical_fit):
4179                _name_col = next((c for c in ['gene_name', 'gene'] if c in reference_df.columns), None)
4180                if _name_col:
4181                    _ref_match = reference_df[reference_df[_name_col] == feature]
4182                    if not _ref_match.empty:
4183                        _ref_row = _ref_match.iloc[0]
4184                        _x_ref = x_range if 'x_range' in dir() else (
4185                            2 ** np.linspace(np.log2(max(x_true.min(), 1e-6)),
4186                                             np.log2(x_true.max()), 2000))
4187                        # Resolve reference model's NTC baselines.
4188                        _y_ntc_ref = float(_ref_row.get('y_ntc', 0.0)) if hasattr(_ref_row, 'get') else float(_ref_row['y_ntc'])
4189                        _x_ntc_ref = float(_ref_row.get('x_ntc', 0.0)) if hasattr(_ref_row, 'get') else float(_ref_row['x_ntc'])
4190                        _y_ref_offset = np.log2(_y_ntc_ref) if (log2fc and _y_ntc_ref > 0) else y_offset
4191                        _x_ref_offset = np.log2(_x_ntc_ref) if (log2fc and _x_ntc_ref > 0) else x_offset
4192                        # Build _x_ref so that after subtracting _x_ref_offset it spans
4193                        # the same visible log2FC x range as the current plot.  If we used
4194                        # x_range directly and the two models have different NTC levels, the
4195                        # reference curve would be horizontally shifted off-screen.
4196                        _log2fc_x_min = np.log2(max(x_true.min(), 1e-6)) - x_offset
4197                        _log2fc_x_max = np.log2(x_true.max()) - x_offset
4198                        _x_ref_abs = 2 ** (np.linspace(_log2fc_x_min, _log2fc_x_max, 2000)
4199                                           + _x_ref_offset)
4200                        _y_ref = predict_hill_from_summary_row(_ref_row, _x_ref_abs, fdr_threshold=fdr_threshold)
4201                        if _y_ref is not None:
4202                            _valid_ref = _y_ref > 0
4203                            if _valid_ref.any():
4204                                ax_plot.plot(
4205                                    np.log2(_x_ref_abs[_valid_ref]) - _x_ref_offset,
4206                                    np.log2(_y_ref[_valid_ref]) - _y_ref_offset,
4207                                    color=ref_color, linestyle='--', linewidth=2,
4208                                    alpha=0.8, label=ref_label)
4209                        # Reference mark_params: full set of Hill markers (A, Vmax, K)
4210                        if _show_ref_markers:
4211                            _ref_markers = _compute_hill_markers_from_summary_row(
4212                                _ref_row, log2_space=True, y_scale=1.0,
4213                                fdr_threshold=fdr_threshold,
4214                            )
4215                            # Reference markers use x_ntc/y_ntc as baselines (same as curve).
4216                            _y_ntc_ref_mk = float(_ref_row.get('y_ntc', 0.0)) if hasattr(_ref_row, 'get') else float(_ref_row['y_ntc'])
4217                            _x_ntc_ref_mk = float(_ref_row.get('x_ntc', 0.0)) if hasattr(_ref_row, 'get') else float(_ref_row['x_ntc'])
4218                            _y_ref_mk_offset = np.log2(_y_ntc_ref_mk) if (log2fc and _y_ntc_ref_mk > 0) else y_offset
4219                            _x_ref_mk_offset = np.log2(_x_ntc_ref_mk) if (log2fc and _x_ntc_ref_mk > 0) else x_offset
4220                            for _m in _ref_markers:
4221                                _kw = dict(linestyle=_m['linestyle'], color=ref_color,
4222                                           alpha=0.5, linewidth=1.2,
4223                                           label=f'Ref {_m["label"]}')
4224                                if _m['axis'] == 'h':
4225                                    ax_plot.axhline(_m['value'] - _y_ref_mk_offset, **_kw)
4226                                elif _m['axis'] == 'v':
4227                                    ax_plot.axvline(_m['value'] - _x_ref_mk_offset, **_kw)
4228
4229        ax_plot.set_xlabel("log2FC(x_true)" if log2fc else xlabel)
4230        ax_plot.set_ylabel(ylabel if ylabel is not None else ("log2FC(counts)" if log2fc else "log2(counts)"))
4231        title_suffix = ' (corrected)' if corrected else ' (uncorrected)'
4232        ax_plot.set_title(f"{model.cis_gene} → {feature}{title_suffix}")
4233        if log2fc:
4234            ax_plot.axhline(0, color='gray', linestyle=':', linewidth=0.8, alpha=0.6)
4235            ax_plot.axvline(0, color='gray', linestyle=':', linewidth=0.8, alpha=0.6)
4236
4237        # ── Explicit axis limits ──────────────────────────────────────────────
4238        # X: smooth data range, extended to include K/EC50 vertical markers.
4239        # Y: smooth data range + Hill curve (within displayed x range) + h markers.
4240        # axhline / axvline don't constrain auto-scaling reliably, so we set
4241        # limits manually to keep the view focused on the actual content.
4242        if _ax_x_segments:
4243            _x_lo = min(s[0] for s in _ax_x_segments)
4244            _x_hi = max(s[1] for s in _ax_x_segments)
4245            if _ax_v_markers:
4246                _x_lo = min(_x_lo, min(_ax_v_markers))
4247                _x_hi = max(_x_hi, max(_ax_v_markers))
4248
4249            _y_lo = min(s[0] for s in _ax_y_segments)
4250            _y_hi = max(s[1] for s in _ax_y_segments)
4251            if _ax_y_hill:
4252                _y_lo = min(_y_lo, min(_ax_y_hill))
4253                _y_hi = max(_y_hi, max(_ax_y_hill))
4254            if _ax_h_markers:
4255                _y_lo = min(_y_lo, min(_ax_h_markers))
4256                _y_hi = max(_y_hi, max(_ax_h_markers))
4257
4258            _x_pad = max(0.05 * (_x_hi - _x_lo), 0.1)
4259            _y_pad = max(0.05 * (_y_hi - _y_lo), 0.1)
4260            ax_plot.set_xlim(_x_lo - _x_pad, _x_hi + _x_pad)
4261            ax_plot.set_ylim(_y_lo - _y_pad, _y_hi + _y_pad)
4262
4263        if not legend_outside:
4264            ax_plot.legend(frameon=False)
4265
4266    # Plot
4267    if show_correction == 'both':
4268        _plot_one(axes[0], corrected=False)
4269        _plot_one(axes[1], corrected=True)
4270    elif show_correction == 'corrected':
4271        _plot_one(axes[0], corrected=True)
4272    else:
4273        _plot_one(axes[0], corrected=False)
4274
4275    if legend_outside:
4276        handles, labels = _collect_legend_handles(axes)
4277        axes[-1].legend(handles, labels, bbox_to_anchor=(1.03, 0.5), loc='center left', frameon=False)
4278
4279    return axes[0] if len(axes) == 1 else axes
4280
4281
4282def plot_binomial_xy(
4283    model,
4284    feature: str,
4285    modality,
4286    x_true: np.ndarray,
4287    window: int,
4288    min_counts: int,
4289    color_palette: Dict[str, str],
4290    show_trans_function: bool,
4291    show_ntc_gradient: bool = False,
4292    show_correction: str = 'both',
4293    xlabel: str = "log2(x_true)",
4294    ax: Optional[plt.Axes] = None,
4295    subset_mask: Optional[np.ndarray] = None,
4296    mark_params = False,
4297    ci_level: float = 95.0,
4298    legend_outside: bool = False,
4299    figsize: Optional[Tuple[float, float]] = None,
4300    log2fc: bool = False,
4301    ntc_x_offset: Optional[float] = None,
4302    ylabel: Optional[str] = None,
4303    **kwargs
4304) -> plt.Axes:
4305    """
4306    Plot binomial (a bounded count/denominator ratio, e.g. PSI or a
4307    spliced/unspliced fraction).
4308
4309    Y-axis: 100 * counts / denominator (percentage scale: 0-100). Labeled
4310    ``'Percentage (%)'`` by default since this distribution is used for any
4311    bounded count/denominator ratio, not just splicing PSI (e.g. gene-level
4312    spliced-vs-unspliced fractions for velocity) -- pass ``ylabel='PSI (%)'``
4313    (or another description) to be more specific for a given modality.
4314    Filter: min_counts on denominator
4315
4316    Parameters
4317    ----------
4318    show_ntc_gradient : bool
4319        If True, color lines by NTC proportion in k-NN window (default: False)
4320        Lighter colors = more NTC cells, Darker colors = fewer NTC cells
4321    show_correction : str
4322        'uncorrected': no technical correction
4323        'corrected': apply alpha_y_add additive correction (PSI - alpha_y_add)
4324        'both': show both side-by-side
4325    log2fc : bool
4326        If True, x-axis becomes log2(x_true) - log2(mean NTC x_true) (log2FC
4327        relative to NTC) instead of raw log2(x_true). The y-axis (PSI%) is left
4328        as-is -- unlike negbinom, there is no natural log2FC transform for a
4329        bounded proportion, so only the x-axis shifts. A grey dotted vertical
4330        line is drawn at x=0 to mark the NTC reference.
4331    ntc_x_offset : float, optional
4332        Precomputed log2(mean NTC x_true) offset (see ``_compute_global_log2fc_offsets``).
4333        Required for ``log2fc=True`` to have any effect; ``plot_xy_data`` computes
4334        and passes this automatically.
4335    ylabel : str, optional
4336        Override the y-axis label (default: ``'Percentage (%)'``). Pass
4337        ``ylabel='PSI (%)'`` for splicing modalities, or e.g.
4338        ``ylabel='Spliced (%)'`` for a gene velocity modality.
4339
4340    Notes
4341    -----
4342    Technical correction for binomial uses alpha_y_add (additive correction on LOGIT scale).
4343    logit(PSI) = log(PSI / (1 - PSI))
4344    logit_corrected = logit(PSI) - alpha_y_add
4345    PSI_corrected = 1 / (1 + exp(-logit_corrected))
4346    """
4347    _x_off = ntc_x_offset if (log2fc and ntc_x_offset is not None) else 0.0
4348    # Get data
4349    feature_idx = _get_feature_index(feature, modality)
4350    if feature_idx is None:
4351        raise ValueError(f"Feature '{feature}' not found in modality")
4352
4353    # Get counts and denominator
4354    if modality.cells_axis == 1:
4355        counts = modality.counts[feature_idx, :]
4356        denom = modality.denominator[feature_idx, :]
4357    else:
4358        counts = modality.counts[:, feature_idx]
4359        denom = modality.denominator[:, feature_idx]
4360
4361    # Align cells between model.meta and modality
4362    x_true_aligned, counts_aligned, meta_aligned = _align_cells_to_modality(
4363        model, modality, x_true, counts, subset_mask
4364    )
4365    # Also align denominator (same cell alignment)
4366    _, denom_aligned, _ = _align_cells_to_modality(
4367        model, modality, x_true, denom, subset_mask
4368    )
4369
4370    # Filter by min_counts
4371    valid_mask = denom_aligned >= min_counts
4372
4373    # Build dataframe
4374    df_data = {
4375        'x_true': x_true_aligned[valid_mask],
4376        'counts': counts_aligned[valid_mask],
4377        'denominator': denom_aligned[valid_mask],
4378        'target': meta_aligned['target'].values[valid_mask]
4379    }
4380
4381    # Conditionally add technical_group_code if it exists
4382    if 'technical_group_code' in meta_aligned.columns:
4383        df_data['technical_group_code'] = meta_aligned['technical_group_code'].values[valid_mask]
4384
4385    df = pd.DataFrame(df_data)
4386
4387    # Keep counts and denominators for binning (don't compute PSI per-cell)
4388    # Filter valid
4389    valid = (df['x_true'] > 0) & (df['denominator'] > 0)
4390    df = df[valid].copy()
4391
4392    if len(df) == 0:
4393        raise ValueError(f"No data remaining after filtering (min_counts={min_counts})")
4394
4395    # Check technical correction availability
4396    # First check attribute, then fall back to posterior_samples_ntc dict
4397    has_technical_fit = False
4398    if hasattr(modality, 'alpha_y_prefit_add') and modality.alpha_y_prefit_add is not None:
4399        has_technical_fit = True
4400    elif hasattr(modality, 'posterior_samples_ntc') and modality.posterior_samples_ntc is not None:
4401        if 'alpha_y_add' in modality.posterior_samples_ntc:
4402            has_technical_fit = True
4403            # Set the attribute for future use
4404            modality.alpha_y_prefit_add = modality.posterior_samples_ntc['alpha_y_add']
4405            print(f"[INFO] Set alpha_y_prefit_add from posterior_samples_ntc for modality '{modality.name}'")
4406
4407    if show_correction == 'corrected' and not has_technical_fit:
4408        warnings.warn(f"Technical fit not available for modality '{modality.name}' - showing uncorrected only")
4409        show_correction = 'uncorrected'
4410
4411    # Create axes
4412    if ax is None:
4413        if show_correction == 'both':
4414            fig, axes = plt.subplots(1, 2, figsize=figsize or (14, 5))
4415        else:
4416            fig, ax = plt.subplots(1, 1, figsize=figsize or (8, 5))
4417            axes = [ax]
4418    else:
4419        # Single axis provided - in multifeature mode, function is called twice
4420        # (once with 'uncorrected' and once with 'corrected'), so don't override show_correction
4421        axes = [ax]
4422
4423    # Get technical group labels
4424    code_to_label = _labels_by_code_for_df(model, df)
4425
4426    if 'technical_group_code' in df.columns:
4427        group_codes = np.sort(df['technical_group_code'].unique())
4428    else:
4429        group_codes = np.array([0])  # Single group
4430
4431    group_labels = [code_to_label[int(c)] for c in group_codes]
4432
4433    # Detect NTC cells for gradient coloring
4434    is_ntc = df['target'].str.lower() == 'ntc'
4435
4436    # Create colormaps for NTC gradient (per technical group)
4437    # Each group gets white → group_color gradient
4438    group_cmaps = {}
4439    if show_ntc_gradient:
4440        for group_label in group_labels:
4441            base_color = color_palette.get(group_label, f'C0')
4442            # Create colormap: white (low color value) → group color (high color value)
4443            group_cmaps[group_label] = LinearSegmentedColormap.from_list(
4444                f"white_{group_label}",
4445                ["white", base_color]
4446            )
4447
4448    # Plot function
4449    def _plot_one(ax_plot, corrected):
4450        colorbar_added = False  # Track if colorbar added
4451        
4452        for idx, group_code in enumerate(group_codes):
4453            group_code = int(group_code)
4454            group_label = code_to_label[group_code]
4455            color = _color_for_label(group_label, fallback_idx=idx, palette=color_palette)
4456
4457            # Get data for this group
4458            if 'technical_group_code' in df.columns:
4459                group_mask = df['technical_group_code'] == group_code
4460            else:
4461                group_mask = pd.Series([True] * len(df), index=df.index)
4462
4463            if group_mask.sum() == 0:
4464                continue
4465
4466            x_group = df.loc[group_mask, 'x_true'].values
4467            counts_group = df.loc[group_mask, 'counts'].values       # (n_cells_group,)
4468            denom_group = df.loc[group_mask, 'denominator'].values   # (n_cells_group,)
4469
4470            # Bin counts using k-NN
4471            k = _knn_k(len(x_group), window)
4472            x_smooth, counts_binned, denom_binned = _smooth_knn_counts(
4473                x_group, counts_group, denom_group, k
4474            )  # counts_binned: (n_bins,), denom_binned: (n_bins,)
4475
4476            # Compute PSI from binned counts (as proportion [0, 1])
4477            epsilon = 1e-10
4478            with np.errstate(divide='ignore', invalid='ignore'):
4479                p_binned = np.where(denom_binned > epsilon,
4480                                    counts_binned / denom_binned,
4481                                    0.5)  # Default to 0.5 if no data
4482
4483            if corrected and has_technical_fit:
4484                # Apply additive correction on LOGIT scale to binned proportions
4485                # 1. Clip proportions to avoid log(0) or log(1)
4486                epsilon_clip = 1e-6
4487                p_clipped = np.clip(p_binned, epsilon_clip, 1 - epsilon_clip)
4488
4489                # 2. Calculate logit
4490                logit_p = np.log(p_clipped / (1 - p_clipped))
4491
4492                # 3. Apply correction on logit scale
4493                alpha_y_add = modality.alpha_y_prefit_add
4494                if alpha_y_add.ndim == 3:
4495                    correction = _to_scalar(alpha_y_add[:, group_code, feature_idx].mean())
4496                else:
4497                    correction = _to_scalar(alpha_y_add[group_code, feature_idx])
4498                logit_corrected = logit_p - correction
4499
4500                # 4. Convert back to proportion
4501                p_corrected = 1.0 / (1.0 + np.exp(-logit_corrected))
4502
4503                # 5. Convert to percentage
4504                y_smooth = p_corrected * 100.0
4505            else:
4506                # Convert uncorrected proportion to percentage
4507                y_smooth = p_binned * 100.0
4508
4509            # Plot (no additional smoothing needed - already binned)
4510            # Note: We don't currently support NTC gradient for binned data
4511            ax_plot.plot(np.log2(x_smooth) - _x_off, y_smooth, color=color, linewidth=2, label=group_label)
4512
4513        # Trans function overlay (if trans model fitted)
4514        # Show on corrected plot if available, otherwise show on uncorrected plot
4515        if show_trans_function and (corrected or not has_technical_fit):
4516            # Evenly spaced points in log2 space for smooth curve on log-log plot
4517            log2_min = np.log2(max(x_true.min(), 1e-6))
4518            log2_max = np.log2(x_true.max())
4519            x_range = 2 ** np.linspace(log2_min, log2_max, 2000)
4520            y_pred = predict_trans_function(model, feature, x_range, modality_name=modality.name)
4521
4522            if y_pred is not None:
4523                # For binomial, PSI is in percentage scale [0, 100], so scale and clip predictions
4524                y_pred_pct = y_pred * 100.0
4525                y_pred_clipped = np.clip(y_pred_pct, 0, 100)
4526                ax_plot.plot(np.log2(x_range) - _x_off, y_pred_clipped,
4527                           color='black', linestyle='--', linewidth=2,
4528                           label='Fitted Trans Function')
4529
4530        # Full parameter markers (PSI%, linear y-axis)
4531        if mark_params and (corrected or not has_technical_fit):
4532            _markers = _compute_hill_markers(
4533                model, feature, modality,
4534                log2_space=False, y_scale=100.0
4535            )
4536            _draw_hill_markers(ax_plot, _markers, x_offset=_x_off)
4537
4538        ax_plot.set_xlabel("log2FC(x_true)" if log2fc else xlabel)
4539        ax_plot.set_ylabel(ylabel if ylabel is not None else 'Percentage (%)')
4540        title_suffix = ' (corrected)' if corrected else ' (uncorrected)'
4541        ax_plot.set_title(f"{model.cis_gene} → {feature} (min_counts={min_counts}{title_suffix})")
4542        if log2fc:
4543            ax_plot.axvline(0, color='gray', linestyle=':', linewidth=0.8, alpha=0.6)
4544        if not legend_outside:
4545            ax_plot.legend(frameon=False)
4546
4547    # Plot
4548    # NOTE: When ax is provided (multifeature mode), show_correction will be 'uncorrected' or 'corrected'
4549    # (forced by warning above), so we respect the show_correction value
4550    if show_correction == 'both':
4551        _plot_one(axes[0], corrected=False)
4552        _plot_one(axes[1], corrected=True)
4553    elif show_correction == 'corrected':
4554        _plot_one(axes[0], corrected=True)
4555    else:  # show_correction == 'uncorrected'
4556        _plot_one(axes[0], corrected=False)
4557
4558    if legend_outside:
4559        handles, labels = _collect_legend_handles(axes)
4560        axes[-1].legend(handles, labels, bbox_to_anchor=(1.03, 0.5), loc='center left', frameon=False)
4561
4562    return axes[0] if len(axes) == 1 else axes
4563
4564
4565def plot_multinomial_xy(
4566    model,
4567    feature: str,
4568    modality,
4569    x_true: np.ndarray,
4570    window: int,
4571    min_counts: int,
4572    show_correction: str,
4573    color_palette: Dict[str, str],
4574    show_trans_function: bool,
4575    show_ntc_gradient: bool = False,
4576    xlabel: str = "log2(x_true)",
4577    figsize: Optional[Tuple[int, int]] = None,
4578    subset_mask: Optional[np.ndarray] = None,
4579    log2fc: bool = False,
4580    ntc_x_offset: Optional[float] = None,
4581    ylabel: Optional[str] = None,
4582    **kwargs
4583) -> Union[plt.Figure, List[plt.Axes]]:
4584    """
4585    Plot multinomial (e.g., donor/acceptor usage) - one subplot per category.
4586
4587    Y-axis: Proportion for each category
4588    Layout:
4589    - If show_correction='uncorrected' or 'corrected': K columns (one per category), 1 row
4590    - If show_correction='both': 2 columns (uncorrected left, corrected right), K rows (one per category)
4591
4592    Parameters
4593    ----------
4594    show_ntc_gradient : bool
4595        If True, color lines by NTC proportion in k-NN window (default: False)
4596        **Note**: Not yet fully implemented for multinomial - will issue warning
4597    log2fc : bool
4598        If True, x-axis becomes log2(x_true) - log2(mean NTC x_true) (log2FC
4599        relative to NTC) instead of raw log2(x_true). The y-axis (proportion) is
4600        left as-is. A grey dotted vertical line is drawn at x=0 (NTC reference).
4601    ntc_x_offset : float, optional
4602        Precomputed log2(mean NTC x_true) offset (see ``_compute_global_log2fc_offsets``).
4603        Required for ``log2fc=True`` to have any effect; ``plot_xy_data`` computes
4604        and passes this automatically.
4605
4606    Notes
4607    -----
4608    Technical correction for multinomial uses alpha_y_add (additive on LOGIT scale).
4609    logits_corrected = logits - alpha_y_add
4610    proportions_corrected = softmax(logits_corrected)
4611    """
4612    _x_off = ntc_x_offset if (log2fc and ntc_x_offset is not None) else 0.0
4613    if show_ntc_gradient:
4614        warnings.warn("NTC gradient coloring not yet implemented for multinomial distributions - using standard colors")
4615
4616    # Get data
4617    feature_idx = _get_feature_index(feature, modality)
4618    if feature_idx is None:
4619        raise ValueError(f"Feature '{feature}' not found in modality")
4620
4621    # Get counts: shape (cells, K) for this feature
4622    if modality.counts.ndim == 3:
4623        counts_3d = modality.counts[feature_idx, :, :]  # (cells, K)
4624    else:
4625        raise ValueError(f"Expected 3D counts for multinomial, got {modality.counts.ndim}D")
4626
4627    K = counts_3d.shape[1]
4628
4629    # Align cells between model.meta and modality
4630    # For multinomial, we need to align the first dimension (cells) of the 3D array
4631    # We'll use the total counts across categories for alignment
4632    total_counts_all = counts_3d.sum(axis=1)
4633    x_true_aligned, total_aligned, meta_aligned = _align_cells_to_modality(
4634        model, modality, x_true, total_counts_all, subset_mask
4635    )
4636
4637    # Now we need to align the full 3D counts array using the same cell mapping
4638    # Get the cell mapping
4639    if 'cell' in model.meta.columns:
4640        model_cells = model.meta['cell'].values
4641    else:
4642        model_cells = model.meta.index.values
4643    modality_cells = modality.cell_names
4644    modality_mask = np.isin(model_cells, modality_cells)
4645    if subset_mask is not None:
4646        final_mask = modality_mask & subset_mask
4647    else:
4648        final_mask = modality_mask
4649    final_cells = model_cells[final_mask]
4650    modality_cell_to_idx = {cell: idx for idx, cell in enumerate(modality_cells)}
4651    y_indices = np.array([modality_cell_to_idx[cell] for cell in final_cells])
4652    counts_3d = counts_3d[y_indices, :]  # Align 3D array
4653
4654    # Get category labels if available in feature_meta
4655    category_labels = None
4656    if hasattr(modality, 'feature_meta') and modality.feature_meta is not None:
4657        if 'category_labels' in modality.feature_meta.columns:
4658            category_labels = modality.feature_meta.loc[feature_idx, 'category_labels']
4659            if category_labels is not None and len(category_labels) != K:
4660                warnings.warn(f"category_labels length ({len(category_labels)}) doesn't match K ({K}) - ignoring labels")
4661                category_labels = None
4662
4663    # Identify non-zero categories (skip padded zeros and empty labels)
4664    # A category is non-zero if it has any counts across all cells AND has a non-empty label
4665    non_zero_cats = []
4666    for k in range(K):
4667        has_counts = counts_3d[:, k].sum() > 0
4668        has_label = True if category_labels is None else (k < len(category_labels) and category_labels[k] != "")
4669        if has_counts and has_label:
4670            non_zero_cats.append(k)
4671
4672    if len(non_zero_cats) == 0:
4673        raise ValueError(f"No non-zero categories found for feature '{feature}'")
4674
4675    K_plot = len(non_zero_cats)  # Only plot non-zero categories
4676
4677    # Filter by min_counts (total across categories)
4678    total_counts = counts_3d.sum(axis=1)
4679    valid_mask = total_counts >= min_counts
4680
4681    # Build dataframe
4682    df_data = {
4683        'x_true': x_true_aligned[valid_mask],
4684        'target': meta_aligned['target'].values[valid_mask]
4685    }
4686
4687    # Conditionally add technical_group_code if it exists
4688    if 'technical_group_code' in meta_aligned.columns:
4689        df_data['technical_group_code'] = meta_aligned['technical_group_code'].values[valid_mask]
4690
4691    df = pd.DataFrame(df_data)
4692
4693    # Store raw counts for each category (needed for binning)
4694    counts_filtered = counts_3d[valid_mask, :]  # (n_cells_filtered, K)
4695    total_filtered = total_counts[valid_mask]
4696
4697    # Filter valid x_true
4698    valid = df['x_true'] > 0
4699    df = df[valid].copy()
4700    counts_filtered = counts_filtered[valid, :]
4701    total_filtered = total_filtered[valid]
4702
4703    if len(df) == 0:
4704        raise ValueError(f"No data remaining after filtering (min_counts={min_counts})")
4705
4706    # Check technical correction availability
4707    has_technical_fit = False
4708    if hasattr(modality, 'alpha_y_prefit_add') and modality.alpha_y_prefit_add is not None:
4709        has_technical_fit = True
4710    elif hasattr(modality, 'posterior_samples_ntc') and modality.posterior_samples_ntc is not None:
4711        if 'alpha_y_add' in modality.posterior_samples_ntc:
4712            has_technical_fit = True
4713            # Set the attribute for future use
4714            modality.alpha_y_prefit_add = modality.posterior_samples_ntc['alpha_y_add']
4715            print(f"[INFO] Set alpha_y_prefit_add from posterior_samples_ntc for modality '{modality.name}'")
4716
4717    if show_correction == 'corrected' and not has_technical_fit:
4718        warnings.warn(f"Technical fit not available for modality '{modality.name}' - showing uncorrected only")
4719        show_correction = 'uncorrected'
4720
4721    # Create figure
4722    # Layout: if show_correction='both', then K_plot rows × 2 columns, else 1 row × K_plot columns
4723    if show_correction == 'both':
4724        if figsize is None:
4725            figsize = (12, 3 * K_plot)  # 2 columns, K_plot rows
4726        fig, axes = plt.subplots(K_plot, 2, figsize=figsize, squeeze=False,
4727                                 constrained_layout=True)
4728    else:
4729        if figsize is None:
4730            figsize = (4 * K_plot, 5)  # K_plot columns, 1 row
4731        fig, axes_row = plt.subplots(1, K_plot, figsize=figsize, squeeze=False,
4732                                     constrained_layout=True)
4733        axes = axes_row  # Shape: (1, K_plot)
4734
4735    # Get technical group labels
4736    code_to_label = _labels_by_code_for_df(model, df)
4737
4738    if 'technical_group_code' in df.columns:
4739        group_codes = np.sort(df['technical_group_code'].unique())
4740    else:
4741        group_codes = np.array([0])  # Single group
4742
4743    group_labels = [code_to_label[int(c)] for c in group_codes]
4744
4745    # Plot each non-zero category
4746    for plot_idx, k in enumerate(non_zero_cats):
4747        # Get label for this category
4748        if category_labels is not None:
4749            cat_label = category_labels[k]
4750        else:
4751            cat_label = f"Category {k}"
4752
4753        if show_correction == 'both':
4754            # Row plot_idx, columns 0 (uncorrected) and 1 (corrected)
4755            for col_idx, corrected in enumerate([False, True]):
4756                ax = axes[plot_idx, col_idx]
4757
4758                for idx, group_code in enumerate(group_codes):
4759                    group_code = int(group_code)
4760                    group_label = code_to_label[group_code]
4761                    color = _color_for_label(group_label, fallback_idx=idx, palette=color_palette)
4762
4763                    # Get data for this group
4764                    if 'technical_group_code' in df.columns:
4765                        group_mask = df['technical_group_code'] == group_code
4766                    else:
4767                        group_mask = pd.Series([True] * len(df), index=df.index)
4768
4769                    if group_mask.sum() == 0:
4770                        continue
4771
4772                    x_group = df.loc[group_mask, 'x_true'].values
4773                    counts_group = counts_filtered[group_mask, :]  # (n_cells_group, K)
4774                    totals_group = total_filtered[group_mask]      # (n_cells_group,)
4775
4776                    # Bin counts using k-NN
4777                    knn = _knn_k(len(x_group), window)
4778                    x_smooth, counts_binned, totals_binned = _smooth_knn_counts(
4779                        x_group, counts_group, totals_group, knn
4780                    )  # counts_binned: (n_bins, K), totals_binned: (n_bins,)
4781
4782                    # Compute proportions from binned counts
4783                    epsilon = 1e-10
4784                    with np.errstate(divide='ignore', invalid='ignore'):
4785                        props_binned = np.where(totals_binned[:, None] > epsilon,
4786                                                counts_binned / totals_binned[:, None],
4787                                                1.0 / K)
4788
4789                    if corrected and has_technical_fit:
4790                        # Compute zero-category mask
4791                        zero_cat_mask = (counts_filtered.sum(axis=0) == 0)  # (K,)
4792
4793                        # Apply correction to binned proportions
4794                        alpha_y_add = modality.alpha_y_prefit_add
4795                        props_corrected = _multinomial_correct_binned_probs(
4796                            props_binned=props_binned,
4797                            alpha_y_add=alpha_y_add,
4798                            group_code=group_code,
4799                            feature_idx=feature_idx,
4800                            zero_cat_mask=zero_cat_mask
4801                        )  # (n_bins, K)
4802                        y_smooth = props_corrected[:, k]
4803                    else:
4804                        y_smooth = props_binned[:, k]
4805
4806                    # Plot (no additional smoothing needed - already binned)
4807                    ax.plot(np.log2(x_smooth) - _x_off, y_smooth, color=color, linewidth=2,
4808                           label=group_label if plot_idx == 0 else None)
4809
4810                ax.set_xlabel("log2FC(x_true)" if log2fc else xlabel)
4811                ax.set_ylabel(ylabel if ylabel is not None else 'Proportion')
4812                title_suffix = ' (corrected)' if corrected else ' (uncorrected)'
4813                ax.set_title(f"{cat_label}{title_suffix}")
4814                if log2fc:
4815                    ax.axvline(0, color='gray', linestyle=':', linewidth=0.8, alpha=0.6)
4816                if plot_idx == 0:
4817                    ax.legend(frameon=False, loc='upper right')
4818        else:
4819            # Single row, column plot_idx
4820            ax = axes[0, plot_idx]
4821            corrected = (show_correction == 'corrected')
4822
4823            for idx, group_code in enumerate(group_codes):
4824                group_code = int(group_code)
4825                group_label = code_to_label[group_code]
4826                color = _color_for_label(group_label, fallback_idx=idx, palette=color_palette)
4827
4828                # Get data for this group
4829                if 'technical_group_code' in df.columns:
4830                    group_mask = df['technical_group_code'] == group_code
4831                else:
4832                    group_mask = pd.Series([True] * len(df), index=df.index)
4833
4834                if group_mask.sum() == 0:
4835                    continue
4836
4837                x_group = df.loc[group_mask, 'x_true'].values
4838                counts_group = counts_filtered[group_mask, :]  # (n_cells_group, K)
4839                totals_group = total_filtered[group_mask]      # (n_cells_group,)
4840
4841                # Bin counts using k-NN
4842                knn = _knn_k(len(x_group), window)
4843                x_smooth, counts_binned, totals_binned = _smooth_knn_counts(
4844                    x_group, counts_group, totals_group, knn
4845                )  # counts_binned: (n_bins, K), totals_binned: (n_bins,)
4846
4847                # Compute proportions from binned counts
4848                epsilon = 1e-10
4849                with np.errstate(divide='ignore', invalid='ignore'):
4850                    props_binned = np.where(totals_binned[:, None] > epsilon,
4851                                            counts_binned / totals_binned[:, None],
4852                                            1.0 / K)
4853
4854                if corrected and has_technical_fit:
4855                    # Compute zero-category mask
4856                    zero_cat_mask = (counts_filtered.sum(axis=0) == 0)  # (K,)
4857
4858                    # Apply correction to binned proportions
4859                    alpha_y_add = modality.alpha_y_prefit_add
4860                    props_corrected = _multinomial_correct_binned_probs(
4861                        props_binned=props_binned,
4862                        alpha_y_add=alpha_y_add,
4863                        group_code=group_code,
4864                        feature_idx=feature_idx,
4865                        zero_cat_mask=zero_cat_mask
4866                    )  # (n_bins, K)
4867                    y_smooth = props_corrected[:, k]
4868                else:
4869                    y_smooth = props_binned[:, k]
4870
4871                # Plot (no additional smoothing needed - already binned)
4872                ax.plot(np.log2(x_smooth) - _x_off, y_smooth, color=color, linewidth=2,
4873                       label=group_label if plot_idx == 0 else None)
4874
4875            ax.set_xlabel("log2FC(x_true)" if log2fc else xlabel)
4876            ax.set_ylabel(f'Proportion')
4877            title_suffix = ' (corrected)' if corrected else ' (uncorrected)'
4878            ax.set_title(f"{cat_label}{title_suffix}")
4879            if log2fc:
4880                ax.axvline(0, color='gray', linestyle=':', linewidth=0.8, alpha=0.6)
4881            if plot_idx == 0:
4882                ax.legend(frameon=False, loc='upper right')
4883
4884    plt.suptitle(f"{model.cis_gene} → {feature} (min_counts={min_counts})")
4885    return fig
4886
4887
4888def plot_normal_xy(
4889    model,
4890    feature: str,
4891    modality,
4892    x_true: np.ndarray,
4893    window: int,
4894    show_correction: str,
4895    color_palette: Dict[str, str],
4896    show_trans_function: bool,
4897    show_ntc_gradient: bool = False,
4898    xlabel: str = "log2(x_true)",
4899    ax: Optional[plt.Axes] = None,
4900    subset_mask: Optional[np.ndarray] = None,
4901    mark_params = False,
4902    ci_level: float = 95.0,
4903    legend_outside: bool = False,
4904    figsize: Optional[Tuple[float, float]] = None,
4905    log2fc: bool = False,
4906    ntc_x_offset: Optional[float] = None,
4907    ylabel: Optional[str] = None,
4908    **kwargs
4909) -> plt.Axes:
4910    """
4911    Plot normal or studentT distribution (continuous scores like SpliZ).
4912
4913    Y-axis: Raw value
4914
4915    Parameters
4916    ----------
4917    show_ntc_gradient : bool
4918        If True, color lines by NTC proportion in k-NN window (default: False)
4919        Lighter colors = more NTC cells, Darker colors = fewer NTC cells
4920        Only applies to uncorrected plots
4921    log2fc : bool
4922        If True, x-axis becomes log2(x_true) - log2(mean NTC x_true) (log2FC
4923        relative to NTC) instead of raw log2(x_true). The y-axis (raw value) is
4924        left as-is. A grey dotted vertical line is drawn at x=0 (NTC reference).
4925    ntc_x_offset : float, optional
4926        Precomputed log2(mean NTC x_true) offset (see ``_compute_global_log2fc_offsets``).
4927        Required for ``log2fc=True`` to have any effect; ``plot_xy_data`` computes
4928        and passes this automatically.
4929    """
4930    _x_off = ntc_x_offset if (log2fc and ntc_x_offset is not None) else 0.0
4931    # Get data
4932    feature_idx = _get_feature_index(feature, modality)
4933    if feature_idx is None:
4934        raise ValueError(f"Feature '{feature}' not found in modality")
4935
4936    # Get values
4937    if modality.cells_axis == 1:
4938        y_vals = modality.counts[feature_idx, :]
4939    else:
4940        y_vals = modality.counts[:, feature_idx]
4941
4942    # Align cells between model.meta and modality
4943    x_true_aligned, y_vals_aligned, meta_aligned = _align_cells_to_modality(
4944        model, modality, x_true, y_vals, subset_mask
4945    )
4946
4947    # Build dataframe
4948    df_data = {
4949        'x_true': x_true_aligned,
4950        'y_val': y_vals_aligned,
4951        'target': meta_aligned['target'].values
4952    }
4953
4954    # Conditionally add technical_group_code if it exists
4955    if 'technical_group_code' in meta_aligned.columns:
4956        df_data['technical_group_code'] = meta_aligned['technical_group_code'].values
4957
4958    df = pd.DataFrame(df_data)
4959
4960    # Filter valid
4961    valid = (df['x_true'] > 0) & np.isfinite(df['y_val'])
4962    df = df[valid].copy()
4963
4964    # Check technical correction
4965    # For normal distribution, check alpha_y_prefit_add (additive correction)
4966    has_technical_fit = False
4967    if hasattr(modality, 'alpha_y_prefit_add') and modality.alpha_y_prefit_add is not None:
4968        has_technical_fit = True
4969    elif hasattr(modality, 'posterior_samples_ntc') and modality.posterior_samples_ntc is not None:
4970        if 'alpha_y_add' in modality.posterior_samples_ntc:
4971            has_technical_fit = True
4972            # Set the attribute for future use
4973            modality.alpha_y_prefit_add = modality.posterior_samples_ntc['alpha_y_add']
4974            print(f"[INFO] Set alpha_y_prefit_add from poster ior_samples_technical for modality '{modality.name}'")
4975
4976    if show_correction == 'corrected' and not has_technical_fit:
4977        warnings.warn(f"Technical fit not available for modality '{modality.name}' - showing uncorrected only")
4978        show_correction = 'uncorrected'
4979
4980    # Create axes
4981    if ax is None:
4982        if show_correction == 'both':
4983            fig, axes = plt.subplots(1, 2, figsize=figsize or (14, 5))
4984        else:
4985            fig, ax = plt.subplots(1, 1, figsize=figsize or (8, 5))
4986            axes = [ax]
4987    else:
4988        # Single axis provided - in multifeature mode, function is called twice
4989        # (once with 'uncorrected' and once with 'corrected'), so don't override show_correction
4990        axes = [ax]
4991
4992    # Get technical group labels
4993    code_to_label = _labels_by_code_for_df(model, df)
4994
4995    if 'technical_group_code' in df.columns:
4996        group_codes = np.sort(df['technical_group_code'].unique())
4997    else:
4998        group_codes = np.array([0])  # Single group
4999
5000    group_labels = [code_to_label[int(c)] for c in group_codes]
5001
5002    # Detect NTC cells for gradient coloring
5003    is_ntc = df['target'].str.lower() == 'ntc'
5004
5005    # Create colormaps for NTC gradient (per technical group)
5006    # Each group gets white → group_color gradient
5007    group_cmaps = {}
5008    if show_ntc_gradient:
5009        for group_label in group_labels:
5010            base_color = color_palette.get(group_label, f'C0')
5011            # Create colormap: white (low color value) → group color (high color value)
5012            group_cmaps[group_label] = LinearSegmentedColormap.from_list(
5013                f"white_{group_label}",
5014                ["white", base_color]
5015            )
5016
5017    # Plot function
5018    def _plot_one(ax_plot, corrected):
5019        colorbar_added = False  # Track if colorbar added
5020        
5021        for idx, group_code in enumerate(group_codes):
5022            group_code = int(group_code)
5023            group_label = code_to_label[group_code]
5024            color = _color_for_label(group_label, fallback_idx=idx, palette=color_palette)
5025            df_group = df[df['technical_group_code'] == group_code].copy()
5026
5027            if len(df_group) == 0:
5028                continue
5029
5030            y_plot = df_group['y_val'].values
5031
5032            if corrected and has_technical_fit:
5033                # Apply additive correction (alpha_y_add for normal)
5034                if hasattr(modality, 'alpha_y_prefit_add'):
5035                    alpha_y_add = modality.alpha_y_prefit_add
5036                    if alpha_y_add.ndim == 3:
5037                        correction = _to_scalar(alpha_y_add[:, group_code, feature_idx].mean())
5038                    else:
5039                        correction = _to_scalar(alpha_y_add[group_code, feature_idx])
5040                    y_plot = y_plot - correction
5041
5042            # Get is_ntc for this group
5043            is_ntc_group = is_ntc[df_group.index].values
5044
5045            # k-NN smoothing
5046            k = _knn_k(len(df_group), window)
5047            if show_ntc_gradient and not corrected:
5048                # Smoothing with NTC tracking
5049                x_smooth, y_smooth, ntc_prop = _smooth_knn(
5050                    df_group['x_true'].values,
5051                    y_plot,
5052                    k,
5053                    is_ntc=is_ntc_group
5054                )
5055
5056                # Use per-group gradient coloring (white → group color)
5057                # Color value = 1 - ntc_prop: high NTC → 0 → white, low NTC → 1 → group color
5058                group_cmap = group_cmaps.get(group_label, plt.cm.gray)
5059                plot_colored_line(
5060                    x=np.log2(x_smooth) - _x_off,
5061                    y=y_smooth,
5062                    color_values=1 - ntc_prop,  # Darker (group color) = fewer NTCs
5063                    cmap=group_cmap,
5064                    ax=ax_plot,
5065                    linewidth=2
5066                )
5067
5068                # Add dummy invisible line for legend label (using base group color)
5069                ax_plot.plot([], [], color=color, linewidth=2, label=group_label)
5070
5071                # Add colorbar (once per axis) - use grayscale to show NTC gradient
5072                if not colorbar_added:
5073                    fig = ax_plot.get_figure()
5074                    cmap_gray = LinearSegmentedColormap.from_list("gray_gradient", ["white", "black"])
5075                    sm = ScalarMappable(cmap=cmap_gray, norm=Normalize(0, 1))
5076                    sm.set_array([])
5077                    cbar = fig.colorbar(sm, ax=ax_plot)
5078                    cbar.set_label('1 - Proportion NTC (darker = fewer NTCs)')
5079                    colorbar_added = True
5080            else:
5081                # Standard smoothing without NTC tracking
5082                x_smooth, y_smooth = _smooth_knn(df_group['x_true'].values, y_plot, k)
5083
5084                # Use standard coloring
5085                ax_plot.plot(np.log2(x_smooth) - _x_off, y_smooth, color=color, linewidth=2, label=group_label)
5086
5087        # Trans function overlay (if trans model fitted)
5088        # Show on corrected plot if available, otherwise show on uncorrected plot
5089        if show_trans_function and (corrected or not has_technical_fit):
5090            # Evenly spaced points in log2 space for smooth curve on log-log plot
5091            log2_min = np.log2(max(x_true.min(), 1e-6))
5092            log2_max = np.log2(x_true.max())
5093            x_range = 2 ** np.linspace(log2_min, log2_max, 2000)
5094            y_pred = predict_trans_function(model, feature, x_range, modality_name=modality.name)
5095
5096            if y_pred is not None:
5097                ax_plot.plot(np.log2(x_range) - _x_off, y_pred,
5098                           color='black', linestyle='--', linewidth=2,
5099                           label='Fitted Trans Function')
5100
5101        # Full parameter markers (linear y-axis)
5102        if mark_params and (corrected or not has_technical_fit):
5103            _markers = _compute_hill_markers(
5104                model, feature, modality,
5105                log2_space=False, y_scale=1.0
5106            )
5107            _draw_hill_markers(ax_plot, _markers, x_offset=_x_off)
5108
5109        ax_plot.set_xlabel("log2FC(x_true)" if log2fc else xlabel)
5110        ax_plot.set_ylabel(ylabel if ylabel is not None else 'Value')
5111        title_suffix = ' (corrected)' if corrected else ' (uncorrected)'
5112        ax_plot.set_title(f"{model.cis_gene} → {feature}{title_suffix}")
5113        if log2fc:
5114            ax_plot.axvline(0, color='gray', linestyle=':', linewidth=0.8, alpha=0.6)
5115        if not legend_outside:
5116            ax_plot.legend(frameon=False)
5117
5118    # Plot
5119    if show_correction == 'both':
5120        _plot_one(axes[0], corrected=False)
5121        _plot_one(axes[1], corrected=True)
5122    elif show_correction == 'corrected':
5123        _plot_one(axes[0], corrected=True)
5124    else:
5125        _plot_one(axes[0], corrected=False)
5126
5127    if legend_outside:
5128        handles, labels = _collect_legend_handles(axes)
5129        axes[-1].legend(handles, labels, bbox_to_anchor=(1.03, 0.5), loc='center left', frameon=False)
5130
5131    return axes[0] if len(axes) == 1 else axes
5132
