5134# ============================================================================
5135# Multi-feature multinomial plotting
5136# ============================================================================
5137
5138def _plot_multinomial_multifeature(
5139    model,
5140    feature_indices: List[int],
5141    feature_names: List[str],
5142    gene_name: str,
5143    modality,
5144    x_true: np.ndarray,
5145    window: int,
5146    min_counts: int,
5147    show_correction: str,
5148    color_palette: Dict[str, str],
5149    xlabel: str,
5150    figsize: Optional[Tuple[int, int]] = None,
5151    subset_mask: Optional[np.ndarray] = None,
5152    ylabel: Optional[str] = None,
5153    **kwargs
5154) -> plt.Figure:
5155    """
5156    Plot multiple multinomial features (e.g., multiple donor sites for one gene).
5157
5158    Layout:
5159    - Single correction: n_features rows × K columns (dimensions as columns, features as rows)
5160    - Both corrections: (n_features × K) rows × 2 columns (dimensions in rows, corrections as columns)
5161
5162    Parameters
5163    ----------
5164    model : bayesDREAM
5165        Fitted model
5166    feature_indices : List[int]
5167        Integer indices of features to plot
5168    feature_names : List[str]
5169        Names of features to plot
5170    gene_name : str
5171        Gene name (for title)
5172    modality : Modality
5173        Multinomial modality
5174    x_true : np.ndarray
5175        Cis expression values
5176    window : int
5177        k-NN window size
5178    min_counts : int
5179        Minimum total counts filter
5180    show_correction : str
5181        'uncorrected', 'corrected', or 'both'
5182    color_palette : Dict[str, str]
5183        Technical group colors
5184    xlabel : str
5185        X-axis label
5186    figsize : tuple, optional
5187        Figure size
5188    **kwargs
5189        Additional arguments
5190
5191    Returns
5192    -------
5193    plt.Figure
5194        Matplotlib figure
5195    """
5196    n_features = len(feature_indices)
5197
5198    # Compute proper cell alignment once for all features.
5199    # modality may cover fewer cells than model.meta, and subset_mask (if any) is on model.meta.
5200    # We combine both into y_indices (into modality cell order) and pre-aligned x_true / meta.
5201    _model_cells_arr = (model.meta['cell'].values if 'cell' in model.meta.columns
5202                        else model.meta.index.values)
5203    _modality_cells = modality.cell_names
5204    if _modality_cells is None:
5205        raise ValueError(f"Modality '{modality.name}' does not have cell_names set.")
5206    _modality_mask = np.isin(_model_cells_arr, _modality_cells)
5207    _final_mask = _modality_mask & subset_mask if subset_mask is not None else _modality_mask
5208    _final_cells = _model_cells_arr[_final_mask]
5209    _mod_cell_to_idx = {c: i for i, c in enumerate(_modality_cells)}
5210    y_indices = np.array([_mod_cell_to_idx[c] for c in _final_cells])
5211    x_true_aligned = x_true[_final_mask]   # x_true is full model x_true
5212    meta_aligned = model.meta[_final_mask].reset_index(drop=True)
5213
5214    # Get number of categories (K) for each feature and identify non-zero categories
5215    # IMPORTANT: Must compute non-zero categories AFTER subsetting to get correct max_non_zero
5216    Ks = []
5217    non_zero_cats_per_feature = []
5218
5219    for feat_idx in feature_indices:
5220        if modality.counts.ndim == 3:
5221            counts_3d = modality.counts[feat_idx, y_indices, :]  # (N_final, K) - cell-aligned
5222
5223            K = counts_3d.shape[1]
5224            Ks.append(K)
5225
5226            # Get category labels if available for this feature
5227            category_labels = None
5228            if hasattr(modality, 'feature_meta') and modality.feature_meta is not None:
5229                if 'category_labels' in modality.feature_meta.columns:
5230                    category_labels = modality.feature_meta.loc[feat_idx, 'category_labels']
5231                    if category_labels is not None and len(category_labels) != K:
5232                        category_labels = None
5233
5234            # Identify non-zero categories AFTER subsetting (skip padded zeros and empty labels)
5235            non_zero_cats = []
5236            for k in range(K):
5237                has_counts = counts_3d[:, k].sum() > 0
5238                has_label = True if category_labels is None else (k < len(category_labels) and category_labels[k] != "")
5239                if has_counts and has_label:
5240                    non_zero_cats.append(k)
5241
5242            non_zero_cats_per_feature.append(non_zero_cats)
5243        else:
5244            raise ValueError(f"Expected 3D counts for multinomial, got {modality.counts.ndim}D")
5245
5246    # Check technical correction
5247    has_technical_fit = False
5248    if hasattr(modality, 'alpha_y_prefit_add') and modality.alpha_y_prefit_add is not None:
5249        has_technical_fit = True
5250    elif hasattr(modality, 'posterior_samples_ntc') and modality.posterior_samples_ntc is not None:
5251        if 'alpha_y_add' in modality.posterior_samples_ntc:
5252            has_technical_fit = True
5253            modality.alpha_y_prefit_add = modality.posterior_samples_ntc['alpha_y_add']
5254            print(f"[INFO] Set alpha_y_prefit_add from posterior_samples_ntc for modality '{modality.name}'")
5255
5256    if show_correction == 'corrected' and not has_technical_fit:
5257        warnings.warn(f"Technical fit not available for modality '{modality.name}' - showing uncorrected only")
5258        show_correction = 'uncorrected'
5259
5260    # Create figure layout using GridSpec to allocate rows based on actual categories per feature
5261    # This avoids blank space when features have different numbers of categories
5262    if show_correction == 'both':
5263        # Layout: each feature gets rows for its actual non-zero categories × 2 columns
5264        total_rows = sum(len(nz) for nz in non_zero_cats_per_feature)
5265        n_cols = 2
5266        if figsize is None:
5267            figsize = (12, 3 * total_rows)  # 3 inches per row
5268    else:
5269        # Layout: each feature gets 1 row × columns for its actual non-zero categories
5270        # Use GridSpec with variable column widths
5271        max_cats = max(len(nz) for nz in non_zero_cats_per_feature) if non_zero_cats_per_feature else 1
5272        total_rows = n_features
5273        n_cols = max_cats
5274        if figsize is None:
5275            figsize = (4 * max_cats, 3 * n_features)  # 4 inches per column, 3 inches per row
5276
5277    fig = plt.figure(figsize=figsize, constrained_layout=True)
5278    gs = fig.add_gridspec(total_rows, n_cols)
5279
5280    # Create axes dict to store subplot positions
5281    axes_dict = {}
5282
5283    # Get technical group labels
5284    if 'technical_group_code' in model.meta.columns:
5285        group_labels = get_technical_group_labels(model)
5286        group_codes = sorted(model.meta['technical_group_code'].unique())
5287    else:
5288        group_labels = ['All']
5289        group_codes = [0]
5290
5291    # Track current row position for GridSpec
5292    current_row = 0
5293
5294    # Plot each feature
5295    for feat_i, (feat_idx, feat_name) in enumerate(zip(feature_indices, feature_names)):
5296        K = Ks[feat_i]
5297        non_zero_cats = non_zero_cats_per_feature[feat_i]
5298
5299        if len(non_zero_cats) == 0:
5300            continue  # Skip features with no non-zero categories
5301
5302        # Get counts for this feature, already cell-aligned via y_indices
5303        counts_3d = modality.counts[feat_idx, y_indices, :]  # (N_final, K)
5304
5305        # Get category labels if available for this feature
5306        category_labels = None
5307        if hasattr(modality, 'feature_meta') and modality.feature_meta is not None:
5308            if 'category_labels' in modality.feature_meta.columns:
5309                category_labels = modality.feature_meta.loc[feat_idx, 'category_labels']
5310                if category_labels is not None and len(category_labels) != K:
5311                    warnings.warn(f"category_labels length ({len(category_labels)}) doesn't match K ({K}) for feature {feat_name} - ignoring labels")
5312                    category_labels = None
5313
5314        # Use pre-computed non_zero_cats (already computed from subsetted data)
5315        # non_zero_cats was set at line 1897
5316        if len(non_zero_cats) == 0:
5317            continue  # Skip if no non-zero categories after subsetting
5318
5319        # Filter by min_counts
5320        total_counts = counts_3d.sum(axis=1)
5321        valid_mask = total_counts >= min_counts
5322
5323        # Build dataframe using pre-aligned x_true and meta
5324        df_data = {
5325            'x_true': x_true_aligned[valid_mask],
5326            'target': meta_aligned['target'].values[valid_mask]
5327        }
5328        if 'technical_group_code' in meta_aligned.columns:
5329            df_data['technical_group_code'] = meta_aligned['technical_group_code'].values[valid_mask]
5330        df = pd.DataFrame(df_data)
5331
5332        # Keep raw counts for binning (don't compute proportions per-cell)
5333        counts_filtered = counts_3d[valid_mask, :]
5334        total_filtered = total_counts[valid_mask]
5335
5336        # Filter valid x_true
5337        valid = df['x_true'] > 0
5338        df = df[valid].copy()
5339        counts_filtered = counts_filtered[valid, :]
5340        total_filtered = total_filtered[valid]
5341
5342        if len(df) == 0:
5343            # Skip to next feature if no data after filtering
5344            # Note: we still need to advance current_row for 'both' mode
5345            if show_correction == 'both':
5346                current_row += len(non_zero_cats)
5347            continue
5348
5349        # Map technical_group_code → label for THIS feature (after all filters)
5350        code_to_label = _labels_by_code_for_df(model, df)
5351
5352        if 'technical_group_code' in df.columns:
5353            group_codes = np.sort(df['technical_group_code'].unique())
5354        else:
5355            group_codes = np.array([0])  # Single group
5356
5357        group_labels = [code_to_label[int(c)] for c in group_codes]
5358
5359        # Plot each non-zero category
5360        for cat_plot_idx, k in enumerate(non_zero_cats):
5361            # Get label for this category
5362            if category_labels is not None:
5363                cat_label = category_labels[k]
5364            else:
5365                cat_label = f"Cat{k}"
5366
5367            if show_correction == 'both':
5368                # Create axes for this category row
5369                row = current_row + cat_plot_idx
5370                for col_idx, corrected in enumerate([False, True]):
5371                    ax = fig.add_subplot(gs[row, col_idx])
5372
5373        
5374                    for idx, group_code in enumerate(group_codes):
5375                        group_code = int(group_code)
5376                        group_label = code_to_label[group_code]
5377                        color = _color_for_label(group_label, fallback_idx=idx, palette=color_palette)
5378
5379                        # Get data for this group
5380                        group_mask = df['technical_group_code'] == group_code
5381                        if group_mask.sum() == 0:
5382                            continue
5383
5384                        x_group = df.loc[group_mask, 'x_true'].values
5385                        counts_group = counts_filtered[group_mask, :]  # (n_cells_group, K)
5386                        totals_group = total_filtered[group_mask]      # (n_cells_group,)
5387
5388                        # Bin counts using k-NN
5389                        knn = _knn_k(len(x_group), window)
5390                        x_smooth, counts_binned, totals_binned = _smooth_knn_counts(
5391                            x_group, counts_group, totals_group, knn
5392                        )  # counts_binned: (n_bins, K), totals_binned: (n_bins,)
5393
5394                        # Compute proportions from binned counts
5395                        epsilon = 1e-10
5396                        with np.errstate(divide='ignore', invalid='ignore'):
5397                            props_binned = np.where(totals_binned[:, None] > epsilon,
5398                                                    counts_binned / totals_binned[:, None],
5399                                                    1.0 / K)
5400
5401                        if corrected and has_technical_fit:
5402                            # Compute zero-category mask
5403                            zero_cat_mask = (counts_filtered.sum(axis=0) == 0)  # (K,)
5404
5405                            # Apply correction to binned proportions
5406                            alpha_y_add = modality.alpha_y_prefit_add
5407                            props_corrected = _multinomial_correct_binned_probs(
5408                                props_binned=props_binned,
5409                                alpha_y_add=alpha_y_add,
5410                                group_code=group_code,
5411                                feature_idx=feat_idx,
5412                                zero_cat_mask=zero_cat_mask
5413                            )  # (n_bins, K)
5414                            y_smooth = props_corrected[:, k]
5415                        else:
5416                            y_smooth = props_binned[:, k]
5417
5418                        # Plot (no additional smoothing needed - already binned)
5419                        ax.plot(np.log2(x_smooth), y_smooth, color=color, linewidth=2,
5420                               label=group_label if cat_plot_idx == 0 and feat_i == 0 else None)
5421
5422                    ax.set_xlabel(xlabel)
5423                    ax.set_ylabel(ylabel if ylabel is not None else 'Proportion')
5424                    title_suffix = ' (corrected)' if corrected else ' (uncorrected)'
5425                    ax.set_title(f"{feat_name[:20]}... {cat_label}{title_suffix}", fontsize=9)
5426                    if cat_plot_idx == 0 and feat_i == 0:
5427                        ax.legend(frameon=False, loc='upper right', fontsize=8)
5428            else:
5429                # Create ax for this category column
5430                ax = fig.add_subplot(gs[current_row, cat_plot_idx])
5431                corrected = (show_correction == 'corrected')
5432        
5433                for idx, group_code in enumerate(group_codes):
5434                    group_code = int(group_code)
5435                    group_label = code_to_label[group_code]
5436                    color = _color_for_label(group_label, fallback_idx=idx, palette=color_palette)
5437
5438                    # Get data for this group
5439                    if 'technical_group_code' in df.columns:
5440                        group_mask = df['technical_group_code'] == group_code
5441                    else:
5442                        group_mask = pd.Series([True] * len(df), index=df.index)
5443
5444                    if group_mask.sum() == 0:
5445                        continue
5446
5447                    x_group = df.loc[group_mask, 'x_true'].values
5448                    counts_group = counts_filtered[group_mask, :]  # (n_cells_group, K)
5449                    totals_group = total_filtered[group_mask]      # (n_cells_group,)
5450
5451                    # Bin counts using k-NN
5452                    knn = _knn_k(len(x_group), window)
5453                    x_smooth, counts_binned, totals_binned = _smooth_knn_counts(
5454                        x_group, counts_group, totals_group, knn
5455                    )  # counts_binned: (n_bins, K), totals_binned: (n_bins,)
5456
5457                    # Compute proportions from binned counts
5458                    epsilon = 1e-10
5459                    with np.errstate(divide='ignore', invalid='ignore'):
5460                        props_binned = np.where(totals_binned[:, None] > epsilon,
5461                                                counts_binned / totals_binned[:, None],
5462                                                1.0 / K)
5463
5464                    if corrected and has_technical_fit:
5465                        # Compute zero-category mask
5466                        zero_cat_mask = (counts_filtered.sum(axis=0) == 0)  # (K,)
5467
5468                        # Apply correction to binned proportions
5469                        alpha_y_add = modality.alpha_y_prefit_add
5470                        props_corrected = _multinomial_correct_binned_probs(
5471                            props_binned=props_binned,
5472                            alpha_y_add=alpha_y_add,
5473                            group_code=group_code,
5474                            feature_idx=feat_idx,
5475                            zero_cat_mask=zero_cat_mask
5476                        )  # (n_bins, K)
5477                        y_smooth = props_corrected[:, k]
5478                    else:
5479                        y_smooth = props_binned[:, k]
5480
5481                    # Plot (no additional smoothing needed - already binned)
5482                    ax.plot(np.log2(x_smooth), y_smooth, color=color, linewidth=2,
5483                           label=group_label if cat_plot_idx == 0 and feat_i == 0 else None)
5484
5485                ax.set_xlabel(xlabel)
5486                ax.set_ylabel(ylabel if ylabel is not None else 'Proportion')
5487                title_suffix = ' (corrected)' if corrected else ' (uncorrected)'
5488                ax.set_title(f"{feat_name[:20]}... {cat_label}{title_suffix}", fontsize=9)
5489                if cat_plot_idx == 0 and feat_i == 0:
5490                    ax.legend(frameon=False, loc='upper right', fontsize=8)
5491
5492        # Update current_row for next feature (only for 'both' mode)
5493        if show_correction == 'both':
5494            current_row += len(non_zero_cats)
5495        else:
5496            current_row += 1
5497
5498    plt.suptitle(f"{model.cis_gene} → {gene_name} (gene, n={n_features} features, min_counts={min_counts})")
5499    return fig
5500
5501
5502# ============================================================================
5503# Unified plot_xy_data function
5504# ============================================================================
5505
5506def plot_xy_data(
5507    model,
5508    feature: str,
5509    modality_name: Optional[str] = None,
5510    window: int = 100,
5511    show_correction: str = 'both',
5512    min_counts: Optional[int] = None,
5513    color_palette: Optional[Dict[str, str]] = None,
5514    show_hill_function: bool = True,
5515    show_ntc_gradient: bool = False,
5516    sum_factor_col: str = 'sum_factor',
5517    xlabel: str = "log2(x_true)",
5518    ylabel: Optional[str] = None,
5519    figsize: Optional[Tuple[int, int]] = None,
5520    src_barcodes: Optional[np.ndarray] = None,
5521    subset_meta: Optional[Dict[str, Any]] = None,
5522    exclude_cells: Optional[List[str]] = None,
5523    only_dependent: bool = False,
5524    ci_level: float = 95.0,
5525    mark_params = False,
5526    legend_outside: bool = False,
5527    filename: Optional[str] = None,
5528    log2fc: bool = False,
5529    reference_df=None,
5530    fdr_df=None,
5531    fdr_threshold: float = 0.05,
5532    color_by: Union[str, List[str]] = 'technical_group',
5533    facet_by: Optional[Union[str, List[str]]] = None,
5534    expand_x_to_params: bool = False,
5535    expand_y_to_params: bool = False,
5536    **kwargs
5537) -> Union[plt.Figure, plt.Axes]:
5538    """
5539    Plot raw x-y data showing relationship between cis gene expression and modality values.
5540
5541    Requires x_true to be set (must run fit_cis() first).
5542
5543    Parameters
5544    ----------
5545    model : bayesDREAM
5546        Fitted bayesDREAM model with x_true set
5547    feature : str
5548        Feature name (junction, donor, etc.) OR gene name.
5549        - If a specific feature name (e.g., 'chr1:999788:999865'), plots that feature
5550        - If a gene name (e.g., 'HES4'), plots all features for that gene in subplots
5551        - Requires modality to have gene information ('gene', 'gene_name', or 'gene_id' columns)
5552    modality_name : str, optional
5553        Modality name (default: primary modality)
5554    window : int
5555        k-NN window size for smoothing (default: 100 cells)
5556    show_correction : str
5557        'uncorrected': no technical correction
5558        'corrected': apply alpha_y technical correction
5559        'both': show both side-by-side (default)
5560    min_counts : int, optional
5561        Minimum raw counts to include cells.
5562        Default depends on distribution: 0 for negbinom, 3 for binomial/multinomial.
5563        For negbinom: excludes cells with y_obs < min_counts
5564        For binomial: minimum denominator
5565        For multinomial: minimum total counts
5566    color_palette : dict, optional
5567        Custom colors for technical groups, keyed by the group label string
5568        Example: {'K562': 'crimson', 'TF1': 'dodgerblue'}
5569    show_hill_function : bool
5570        Overlay fitted trans function if trans model fitted (all distributions, default: True)
5571        Works with all function types: additive_hill, single_hill, polynomial
5572        Automatically detects function type from posterior_samples_trans
5573    show_ntc_gradient : bool
5574        Color lines by NTC proportion in k-NN window (default: False)
5575        Lighter colors = more NTC cells, Darker colors = fewer NTC cells
5576        Only applies to uncorrected plots
5577        Fully implemented for: negbinom, binomial, normal, studentt
5578        Not yet implemented for: multinomial (will issue warning)
5579    sum_factor_col : str
5580        Column name in model.meta for sum factors (default: 'sum_factor')
5581        Can be 'sum_factor', 'sum_factor_adj', or any other sum factor column
5582        Only used for negbinom distribution (gene expression)
5583    xlabel : str
5584        X-axis label (default: "log2(x_true)")
5585    ylabel : str, optional
5586        Override the y-axis label (default: None, uses a distribution-specific
5587        default -- ``"log2(counts)"`` for negbinom, ``"Percentage (%)"`` for
5588        binomial (0-100 scale), ``"Proportion"`` for multinomial (0-1 scale),
5589        ``"Value"`` for normal/studentt). The binomial default is deliberately
5590        generic since that distribution covers any bounded count/denominator
5591        ratio, not just splicing PSI -- pass e.g. ``ylabel='PSI (%)'`` for
5592        splicing modalities or ``ylabel='Spliced (%)'`` for a gene velocity
5593        modality.
5594    figsize : tuple, optional
5595        Figure size (auto-sized if None)
5596    src_barcodes : np.ndarray, optional
5597        Source barcode order if x_true not in model.meta order
5598    subset_meta : dict, optional
5599        Subset cells by metadata columns. Dictionary of {column: value} pairs.
5600        Example: {'target': 'ntc'} - plot only NTC cells
5601        Example: {'cell_line': 'K562'} - plot only K562 cells
5602        Example: {'lane': 'L1', 'cell_line': 'K562'} - plot L1 lane K562 cells
5603        Multiple conditions are combined with AND logic.
5604    exclude_cells : list of str, optional
5605        Cell names (matched against ``model.meta['cell']``) to drop before
5606        plotting, e.g. cells identified by ``check_systematic_shift``'s
5607        ``exclude_cells`` filtering logic. AND-combined with ``subset_meta``
5608        when both are given, without needing to call ``model.subset_cells()``
5609        first.
5610        Example: ``exclude_cells=['cell_1', 'cell_2']``
5611    only_dependent : bool
5612        If True and plotting multiple features (gene name), filter to only "dependent" features
5613        (default: False). When ``fdr_df`` is provided, uses its precomputed ``is_dependent``
5614        column (FDR-significant AND the Hill coefficient's credible interval excludes 0).
5615        Otherwise falls back to filtering on the n_a/n_b credible interval alone, which
5616        requires fit_trans() to have been run with function_type='additive_hill'.
5617        Ignored for single-feature plots.
5618    ci_level : float
5619        Credible interval level for dependency filtering and parameter marker
5620        classification (default: 95.0).
5621        Used by only_dependent=True and mark_params=True.
5622    mark_params : bool or str
5623        Overlay meaningful parameter markers on the Hill function (default: False).
5624        Requires show_hill_function=True and fit_trans() completed with
5625        function_type='single_hill' or 'additive_hill'.
5626        - True or 'both': markers for both the fitted curve and the reference curve
5627        - 'fit': markers for the fitted curve only
5628        - 'reference': markers for the reference curve only (requires reference_df)
5629        - False or None: no markers
5630        Markers drawn depend on the fitted regime:
5631        - **Single Hill / effectively single**: log2(A), log2(A+α·Vmax), log2(EC50)
5632        - **Same-sign additive** (both Hills in same direction):
5633          log2(A), log2(A+α·Vmax_a+β·Vmax_b), log2(EC50_lower), log2(EC50_upper)
5634        - **Non-monotonic** (opposite-sign Hills):
5635          log2(y: x→0), log2(y: x→∞), log2(EC50_lower), log2(EC50_upper);
5636          additionally log2(A+α·Vmax_a+β·Vmax_b) [peak] if activation EC50 < inhibition EC50
5637        For non-negbinom distributions, all y-axis markers are in linear space.
5638        Note: asymptotes include the α/β weight factors (e.g. A+α·Vmax, not A+Vmax).
5639    log2fc : bool
5640        If True, x-axis becomes log2(x_true) - log2(mean NTC x_true) (log2FC
5641        relative to NTC) instead of raw log2(x_true) (default: False).
5642        For **negbinom**, the y-axis also becomes log2FC relative to NTC
5643        (log2(counts) - log2(mean NTC counts, reference group)), and a grey
5644        dotted crosshair is drawn at (0, 0).
5645        For **binomial/normal/studentt/multinomial**, only the x-axis
5646        transforms -- the y-axis is left in its natural scale (PSI%, raw
5647        value, proportion), since there's no natural log2FC transform for a
5648        bounded/non-count quantity. Only a vertical grey dotted line is drawn
5649        at x=0 to mark the NTC reference.
5650    color_by : str or list of two str
5651        What to color smoothed lines by (default: ``'technical_group'``).
5652        - ``'technical_group'``: one line per cell-line / technical group (default)
5653        - ``'targeting'``: two lines — ``NTC`` vs ``Targeting``
5654        - **Any column name in ``model.meta``**: one line per unique value.
5655          A warning is issued if the column looks continuous (float dtype with many
5656          unique values) or has more than 30 unique values.
5657        - **List of two** (e.g. ``['technical_group', 'targeting']``): cross-product of
5658          two groupings — the first sets hue, the second sets shade. When the secondary
5659          is ``'targeting'``, NTC lines are drawn as a light tint of the group colour
5660          and targeting lines as the full colour (matching the classic "shades" style).
5661          Override any auto-generated colour via ``color_palette`` using the combined
5662          label ``"K562 / NTC"``, ``"K562 / Targeting"``, etc.
5663        Alpha-y technical correction is always applied per technical group regardless
5664        of this setting.
5665    facet_by : str or list of str, optional
5666        Column name(s) to facet by (default: ``None``).  Accepts either a
5667        single string or a list of **at most two** strings.  Each value may be
5668        a real column name in ``model.meta`` **or** one of the same special
5669        keywords supported by ``color_by``:
5670
5671        - ``'targeting'`` — two panels: ``NTC`` / ``Targeting``
5672          (derived from ``model.meta['target']``)
5673        - ``'technical_group'`` — one panel per technical group code
5674
5675        Analogous to ``facet_grid`` in ggplot2.
5676
5677        **1 column** (``facet_by='cell_line'``) — all unique values become
5678        side-by-side column groups::
5679
5680            rows = n_features,  cols = n_facets × n_corrections
5681
5682        Example: 3 cell lines + ``show_correction='both'`` →  1 × 6 grid
5683        ``[K562 uncorr | K562 corr | TF1 uncorr | TF1 corr | HL60 uncorr | HL60 corr]``
5684
5685        **2 columns** (``facet_by=['cell_line', 'perturbation']``) — first
5686        column maps to grid *rows*, second column maps to grid *columns*::
5687
5688            rows = n_facet1_values × n_features
5689            cols = n_facet2_values × n_corrections
5690
5691        Example: 3 cell lines × 2 perturbation types + ``show_correction='corrected'``
5692        → 3 × 2 grid (cell lines as rows, perturbation types as columns).
5693
5694        **Combining with other parameters:**
5695
5696        - ``subset_meta`` / ``exclude_cells``: each facet mask is AND-combined
5697          with the global ``subset_meta`` / ``exclude_cells`` filters, so you
5698          can first narrow to CRISPRi cells (or drop specific cells) and then
5699          facet by cell line within that subset.
5700        - ``color_by``: works independently within each panel — e.g.
5701          ``facet_by='cell_line'`` splits cell lines into columns while
5702          ``color_by='targeting'`` still draws NTC / Targeting lines *inside*
5703          each panel.
5704        - ``legend_outside=True``: recommended when faceting produces many
5705          panels, to keep the shared legend out of the plot area.
5706
5707        Facet labels appear as the first line of each panel title, e.g.
5708        ``cell_line=K562`` or ``cell_line=K562  perturbation=CRISPRi``.
5709        A warning is issued for columns with more than 20 unique values.
5710        Not yet supported for ``multinomial`` distributions (ignored with a
5711        warning in that case).
5712    expand_x_to_params : bool
5713        When True, extend the x-axis (and the Hill curve) beyond the data range
5714        so that all K/EC50 parameters are visible on the plot (default: False).
5715        Requires ``show_hill_function=True`` and a fitted trans model.
5716        The x-axis minimum and maximum are widened to include the mean K_a and
5717        K_b values from the posterior, so any EC50 that falls outside the data
5718        range will still appear on the curve.  Ignored for polynomial function
5719        types (which have no K parameters).
5720    expand_y_to_params : bool
5721        When True, extend the y-axis to show the full range of the fitted Hill
5722        curve over the entire displayed x range, including any x values added by
5723        ``expand_x_to_params`` (default: False).  Normally the Hill curve's y
5724        values are only used for y-axis scaling within the data x range; this
5725        flag removes that restriction so the y-axis accommodates the Hill
5726        curve's y values at K/EC50 positions and at the asymptotes.
5727    legend_outside : bool
5728        Place the legend outside the panel to the right, shared across all panels
5729        (default: False). Useful when many lines clutter the plot area.
5730    filename : str, optional
5731        If provided, save the figure to ``model.output_dir / filename``.
5732        A ``.png`` extension is added automatically if none is given.
5733        Use a full path to save elsewhere.
5734    figsize : tuple, optional
5735        Figure size as ``(width, height)`` in inches.  When None (default) the
5736        size is chosen automatically: 6 inches per column × 3 inches per row
5737        for multi-panel plots, or (8, 5) / (14, 5) for single-panel plots.
5738    reference_df : pd.DataFrame, optional
5739        A ``trans_summary`` DataFrame whose rows contain fitted Hill parameters
5740        (columns ending in ``_median``, e.g. ``A_median``, ``Vmax_a_median``, etc.).
5741        When provided, a reference Hill curve is overlaid in red dashed on each
5742        negbinom panel.  The feature name is matched via a ``gene_name`` or
5743        ``gene`` column.  Only applied to negbinom modalities.
5744    fdr_df : pd.DataFrame, optional
5745        A ``trans_summary`` DataFrame with ``fdr_alpha``, ``fdr_beta``, and
5746        ``is_dependent`` columns (e.g. the output of ``save_trans_summary``).
5747        Used for three purposes:
5748        (1) filtering to dependent features via the ``is_dependent`` column when
5749        ``only_dependent=True``,
5750        (2) greying out FDR-inactive parameter markers in ``mark_params`` mode,
5751        (3) classifying the Hill regime for ``_compute_hill_markers``.
5752        Feature names are matched via a ``gene_name`` or ``gene`` column.
5753    fdr_threshold : float
5754        FDR threshold for classifying components as active (default: 0.05).
5755        Components with ``fdr_alpha`` or ``fdr_beta`` >= this threshold are
5756        treated as inactive.  Only used when ``fdr_df`` is provided.
5757    **kwargs
5758        Additional plotting arguments
5759
5760    Returns
5761    -------
5762    plt.Figure or plt.Axes
5763        Matplotlib figure or axes object
5764
5765    Raises
5766    ------
5767    ValueError
5768        If x_true not set (must run fit_cis first)
5769        If feature not found in modality
5770        If show_correction='corrected' but fit_technical not run
5771
5772    Warnings
5773    --------
5774    If fit_technical not run for modality and show_correction='corrected',
5775    warns and plots uncorrected only.
5776
5777    Examples
5778    --------
5779    >>> # Plot single gene with Hill function
5780    >>> model.plot_xy_data('TET2', window=100, show_hill_function=True)
5781    >>>
5782    >>> # Plot specific splice junction with min_counts filter
5783    >>> model.plot_xy_data('chr1:12345:67890:+', modality_name='splicing_sj',
5784    ...                     min_counts=5)
5785    >>>
5786    >>> # Plot all splice junctions for a gene (creates multi-panel figure)
5787    >>> model.plot_xy_data('HES4', modality_name='splicing_sj')
5788    >>>
5789    >>> # Plot with custom colors
5790    >>> model.plot_xy_data('GFI1B', color_palette={'K562': 'red', 'TF1': 'blue'})
5791    >>>
5792    >>> # Show both corrected and uncorrected (default)
5793    >>> model.plot_xy_data('TET2', show_correction='both')
5794    >>>
5795    >>> # Plot with NTC gradient coloring
5796    >>> model.plot_xy_data('TET2', show_ntc_gradient=True, show_correction='uncorrected')
5797    >>>
5798    >>> # Plot only NTC cells
5799    >>> model.plot_xy_data('TET2', subset_meta={'target': 'ntc'})
5800    >>>
5801    >>> # Plot only cells from one group
5802    >>> model.plot_xy_data('GFI1B', subset_meta={'cell_line': 'K562'})
5803    >>>
5804    >>> # Drop a specific list of cells (e.g. flagged by check_systematic_shift)
5805    >>> model.plot_xy_data('GFI1B', exclude_cells=exclude_cells)
5806    >>>
5807    >>> # Plot all junctions for a gene, but only show dependent ones (n_a or n_b CI excludes 0)
5808    >>> model.plot_xy_data('HES4', modality_name='splicing_sj', only_dependent=True, ci_level=95.0)
5809    >>>
5810    >>> # ── color_by examples ─────────────────────────────────────────────────
5811    >>> # Color by NTC vs targeting instead of technical group
5812    >>> model.plot_xy_data('GFI1B', color_by='targeting')
5813    >>>
5814    >>> # Color by any column in model.meta (warns if continuous or >30 unique values)
5815    >>> model.plot_xy_data('GFI1B', color_by='cell_line')
5816    >>>
5817    >>> # Cross-product: hue = technical group, shade = NTC vs targeting
5818    >>> # NTC cells are drawn as a light tint of the group colour;
5819    >>> # targeting cells as the full colour.
5820    >>> model.plot_xy_data('GFI1B', color_by=['technical_group', 'targeting'])
5821    >>>
5822    >>> # Cross-product with a custom secondary grouping
5823    >>> model.plot_xy_data('GFI1B', color_by=['cell_line', 'perturbation_type'])
5824    >>>
5825    >>> # ── facet_by: 1-column (values → columns) ────────────────────────────
5826    >>> # One column-group of panels per cell line
5827    >>> # Grid: 1 row × (n_cell_lines × 2) cols  (default show_correction='both')
5828    >>> model.plot_xy_data('GFI1B', facet_by='cell_line')
5829    >>>
5830    >>> # Facet by cell line, show only corrected, log2FC mode
5831    >>> model.plot_xy_data('GFI1B',
5832    ...     facet_by='cell_line',
5833    ...     show_correction='corrected',
5834    ...     log2fc=True)
5835    >>>
5836    >>> # Facet by cell line AND color by NTC vs targeting within each facet panel
5837    >>> # Grid: 1 row × n_cell_lines cols; two lines per panel (NTC / Targeting)
5838    >>> model.plot_xy_data('GFI1B',
5839    ...     facet_by='cell_line',
5840    ...     color_by='targeting',
5841    ...     show_correction='corrected',
5842    ...     legend_outside=True)   # recommended when many panels
5843    >>>
5844    >>> # First restrict to CRISPRi guides, then facet by cell line within that subset
5845    >>> model.plot_xy_data('GFI1B',
5846    ...     subset_meta={'guide_type': 'CRISPRi'},
5847    ...     facet_by='cell_line')
5848    >>>
5849    >>> # ── facet_by: 2-column (proper row × col grid) ────────────────────────
5850    >>> # First column → row groups, second column → column groups
5851    >>> # Grid: n_cell_lines rows × n_perturbation_types cols (each corrected only)
5852    >>> model.plot_xy_data('GFI1B',
5853    ...     facet_by=['cell_line', 'perturbation_type'],
5854    ...     show_correction='corrected')
5855    >>>
5856    >>> # 2-D facet with color_by and log2FC; legend outside the grid
5857    >>> model.plot_xy_data('GFI1B',
5858    ...     facet_by=['cell_line', 'perturbation_type'],
5859    ...     color_by='targeting',
5860    ...     show_correction='corrected',
5861    ...     log2fc=True,
5862    ...     legend_outside=True)
5863    >>>
5864    >>> # Multi-feature + 1-D facet: rows = features, cols = facets × corrections
5865    >>> model.plot_xy_data('HES4', modality_name='splicing_sj',
5866    ...     facet_by='cell_line',
5867    ...     show_correction='corrected',
5868    ...     only_dependent=True)
5869    >>>
5870    >>> # Multi-feature + 2-D facet:
5871    >>> # rows = n_cell_lines × n_features,  cols = n_perturb_types × n_corrections
5872    >>> model.plot_xy_data('HES4', modality_name='splicing_sj',
5873    ...     facet_by=['cell_line', 'perturbation_type'],
5874    ...     show_correction='corrected',
5875    ...     only_dependent=True)
5876    """
5877    # Check x_true is set
5878    if not hasattr(model, 'x_true') or model.x_true is None:
5879        raise ValueError(
5880            "x_true not set. Must run fit_cis() before plotting x-y data.\n"
5881            "Example: model.fit_cis(sum_factor_col='sum_factor')"
5882        )
5883
5884    # Check technical_group_code is set (only required if showing correction)
5885    # Auto-fallback to uncorrected if technical groups not available
5886    has_technical_groups = 'technical_group_code' in model.meta.columns
5887
5888    if show_correction in ['corrected', 'both']:
5889        if not has_technical_groups:
5890            import warnings
5891            warnings.warn(
5892                f"technical_group_code not set, falling back to show_correction='uncorrected'. "
5893                f"To show correction, run model.set_technical_groups(['cell_line']) first.",
5894                UserWarning
5895            )
5896            show_correction = 'uncorrected'
5897
5898    # Get x_true
5899    x2d = _to_2d(model.x_true)
5900    x_true = x2d.mean(axis=0) if x2d.ndim == 2 else x2d.ravel()
5901
5902    # Reorder if needed
5903    if src_barcodes is not None:
5904        cell_barcodes = model.meta['cell'].values if 'cell' in model.meta.columns else model.meta.index.values
5905        x_true = reorder_xtrue_by_barcode(x_true, src_barcodes, cell_barcodes)
5906
5907    # Apply metadata subsetting
5908    subset_mask = None
5909    if subset_meta is not None:
5910        # Create mask based on subset_meta conditions (AND logic)
5911        subset_mask = np.ones(len(model.meta), dtype=bool)
5912        for col, value in subset_meta.items():
5913            if col not in model.meta.columns:
5914                raise ValueError(f"Column '{col}' not found in model.meta. Available columns: {list(model.meta.columns)}")
5915            subset_mask &= (model.meta[col] == value).values
5916
5917    if exclude_cells is not None:
5918        if subset_mask is None:
5919            subset_mask = np.ones(len(model.meta), dtype=bool)
5920        cell_col = model.meta['cell'].values if 'cell' in model.meta.columns else model.meta.index.values
5921        excl_mask = np.isin(cell_col, list(exclude_cells))
5922        subset_mask &= ~excl_mask
5923        print(f"[SUBSET] Excluding {excl_mask.sum()} cells via exclude_cells")
5924
5925    if subset_mask is not None:
5926        n_cells_before = len(model.meta)
5927        n_cells_after = subset_mask.sum()
5928        if n_cells_after == 0:
5929            raise ValueError(f"No cells remain after subset_meta={subset_meta} / exclude_cells filtering.")
5930
5931        if subset_meta is not None:
5932            print(f"[SUBSET] Filtering {n_cells_before} → {n_cells_after} cells based on {subset_meta}")
5933
5934        # NOTE: Don't subset x_true here - let _align_cells_to_modality() handle it
5935        # (subsetting here causes IndexError when mask is applied again in alignment)
5936
5937    # Resolve facet groups (if facet_by is set).
5938    # facet_by can be a single column name (str) or a list of 1-2 column names.
5939    #   1 column  → all unique values become column groups (existing behaviour)
5940    #   2 columns → first column → row groups, second column → column groups (2-D grid)
5941    # Each group is a (label, boolean_mask on model.meta rows) pair.
5942    facet_col_groups = None   # unique values of the *column* facet dimension
5943    facet_row_groups = None   # unique values of the *row* facet dimension (2-column only)
5944    _facet_by_list: List[str] = []  # normalised list, used for title-building later
5945
5946    if facet_by is not None:
5947        _facet_by_list = [facet_by] if isinstance(facet_by, str) else list(facet_by)
5948        if len(_facet_by_list) > 2:
5949            raise ValueError(
5950                f"facet_by supports at most 2 columns (got {len(_facet_by_list)}). "
5951                f"Pass a string for a 1-D column facet, or a list of two strings for a "
5952                f"2-D row × column facet grid."
5953            )
5954
5955        def _resolve_facet_col(col: str, role: str):
5956            """Return [(label, mask), ...] for one facet column; warn on edge cases.
5957
5958            Supports the same special keywords as color_by:
5959              'targeting'       → two groups: NTC / Targeting
5960              'technical_group' → one group per technical_group_code
5961            Any other value is looked up as a column in model.meta.
5962            """
5963            # ── Special keyword: 'targeting' ──────────────────────────────────
5964            if col == 'targeting':
5965                if 'target' not in model.meta.columns:
5966                    raise ValueError(
5967                        "facet_by='targeting' requires a 'target' column in model.meta."
5968                    )
5969                ntc_mask = (model.meta['target'].str.lower() == 'ntc').values
5970                return [('NTC', ntc_mask), ('Targeting', ~ntc_mask)]
5971
5972            # ── Special keyword: 'technical_group' ────────────────────────────
5973            if col == 'technical_group':
5974                if 'technical_group_code' not in model.meta.columns:
5975                    warnings.warn(
5976                        "facet_by='technical_group' requires technical_group_code in "
5977                        "model.meta. Using a single 'All' group.",
5978                        UserWarning
5979                    )
5980                    return [('All', np.ones(len(model.meta), dtype=bool))]
5981                grp_labels = get_technical_group_labels(model)
5982                codes = np.sort(model.meta['technical_group_code'].unique())
5983                return [
5984                    (grp_labels[int(c)] if int(c) < len(grp_labels) else str(int(c)),
5985                     (model.meta['technical_group_code'] == c).values)
5986                    for c in codes
5987                ]
5988
5989            # ── Regular model.meta column ─────────────────────────────────────
5990            if col not in model.meta.columns:
5991                raise ValueError(
5992                    f"facet_by column '{col}' not found in model.meta. "
5993                    f"Available columns: {list(model.meta.columns)}\n"
5994                    f"Special keywords also accepted: 'targeting', 'technical_group'."
5995                )
5996            fvals = sorted(model.meta[col].dropna().unique(), key=str)
5997            n_uniq = len(fvals)
5998            if n_uniq > 20:
5999                warnings.warn(
6000                    f"facet_by='{col}' ({role}) has {n_uniq} unique values — this will "
6001                    f"create {n_uniq} panel {role}s. Consider a coarser grouping.",
6002                    UserWarning
6003                )
6004            elif n_uniq <= 1:
6005                warnings.warn(
6006                    f"facet_by='{col}' has {n_uniq} unique value(s) — faceting has no effect.",
6007                    UserWarning
6008                )
6009            return [(str(v), (model.meta[col] == v).values) for v in fvals]
6010
6011        if len(_facet_by_list) == 1:
6012            facet_col_groups = _resolve_facet_col(_facet_by_list[0], 'column')
6013        else:
6014            # Two columns: first → row groups, second → column groups
6015            facet_row_groups = _resolve_facet_col(_facet_by_list[0], 'row')
6016            facet_col_groups = _resolve_facet_col(_facet_by_list[1], 'column')
6017
6018    # Get modality
6019    if modality_name is None:
6020        modality_name = model.primary_modality
6021    modality = model.get_modality(modality_name)
6022    distribution = modality.distribution
6023
6024    # Set distribution-specific default for min_counts
6025    if min_counts is None:
6026        if modality.distribution == 'negbinom':
6027            min_counts = 0  # Include all cells for gene expression
6028        else:
6029            min_counts = 3  # Require min counts for binomial/multinomial
6030
6031    # Get color palette
6032    if color_palette is None:
6033        group_labels = get_technical_group_labels(model)
6034        color_palette = get_default_color_palette(group_labels)
6035
6036    # Resolve feature(s) - could be single feature or gene name
6037    feature_indices, feature_names_resolved, is_gene = _resolve_features(feature, modality)
6038
6039    # Filter to only dependent features if requested (multifeature mode only)
6040    if only_dependent and is_gene and len(feature_indices) > 1:
6041        n_before = len(feature_indices)
6042
6043        if fdr_df is not None:
6044            # Use the precomputed is_dependent column (FDR-significant AND the
6045            # corresponding Hill exponent's CI excludes 0) rather than recomputing
6046            # a weaker FDR-only criterion here.
6047            if 'feature' not in fdr_df.columns or 'is_dependent' not in fdr_df.columns:
6048                warnings.warn(
6049                    "fdr_df must have 'feature' and 'is_dependent' columns "
6050                    "(as produced by save_trans_summary). Showing all features instead.",
6051                    UserWarning
6052                )
6053            elif not fdr_df['feature'].is_unique:
6054                _dupes = fdr_df['feature'][fdr_df['feature'].duplicated()].unique().tolist()
6055                raise ValueError(
6056                    f"fdr_df['feature'] is not unique ({len(_dupes)} duplicated value(s), "
6057                    f"e.g. {_dupes[:5]}) — a per-feature lookup would silently use only "
6058                    "the last matching row. This likely means fdr_df was saved by an "
6059                    "older/buggy version of save_trans_summary; regenerate it."
6060                )
6061            else:
6062                dep_lookup = dict(zip(fdr_df['feature'], fdr_df['is_dependent']))
6063
6064                kept_indices = []
6065                kept_names = []
6066                for idx, name in zip(feature_indices, feature_names_resolved):
6067                    dep_val = dep_lookup.get(name, np.nan)
6068                    if pd.notna(dep_val) and bool(dep_val):
6069                        kept_indices.append(idx)
6070                        kept_names.append(name)
6071
6072                if len(kept_indices) == 0:
6073                    warnings.warn(
6074                        f"No features have is_dependent=True for '{feature}'. "
6075                        f"Showing all {n_before} features instead.",
6076                        UserWarning
6077                    )
6078                else:
6079                    feature_indices = kept_indices
6080                    feature_names_resolved = kept_names
6081                    print(f"[DEPENDENCY FILTER] {feature}: {n_before} → {len(feature_indices)} features "
6082                          f"(is_dependent=True)")
6083
6084        else:
6085            # Fallback: CI-based filtering on n_a / n_b from posterior samples.
6086            # Requires fit_trans() with function_type='additive_hill'.
6087            if modality_name == model.primary_modality:
6088                posterior = getattr(model, 'posterior_samples_trans', None)
6089            else:
6090                posterior = getattr(modality, 'posterior_samples_trans', None)
6091
6092            if posterior is None:
6093                warnings.warn(
6094                    "only_dependent=True requires fit_trans() to have been run "
6095                    f"(modality='{modality_name}'). Showing all features instead.",
6096                    UserWarning
6097                )
6098            elif 'n_a' not in posterior or 'n_b' not in posterior:
6099                warnings.warn(
6100                    "only_dependent=True without fdr_df requires fit_trans() with "
6101                    "function_type='additive_hill' (needs n_a/n_b). "
6102                    "Showing all features instead.",
6103                    UserWarning
6104                )
6105            else:
6106                n_a_samps = posterior['n_a'].detach().cpu().numpy()
6107                n_b_samps = posterior['n_b'].detach().cpu().numpy()
6108                if n_a_samps.ndim == 3:
6109                    n_a_samps = n_a_samps.squeeze(1)
6110                    n_b_samps = n_b_samps.squeeze(1)
6111
6112                dep_mask_a = dependency_mask_from_n(n_a_samps, ci=ci_level)
6113                dep_mask_b = dependency_mask_from_n(n_b_samps, ci=ci_level)
6114                dep_mask = dep_mask_a | dep_mask_b
6115
6116                filtered_indices = [idx for idx in feature_indices if dep_mask[idx]]
6117                filtered_names = [name for idx, name in zip(feature_indices, feature_names_resolved)
6118                                  if dep_mask[idx]]
6119
6120                if len(filtered_indices) == 0:
6121                    warnings.warn(
6122                        f"No dependent features found for '{feature}' (all n CIs include 0). "
6123                        f"Showing all {n_before} features instead.",
6124                        UserWarning
6125                    )
6126                else:
6127                    feature_indices = filtered_indices
6128                    feature_names_resolved = filtered_names
6129                    print(f"[DEPENDENCY FILTER] {feature}: {n_before} → {len(feature_indices)} features "
6130                          f"(CI={ci_level}%, {dep_mask_a.sum()} positive, {dep_mask_b.sum()} negative)")
6131
6132    # ── Grid path: multi-feature (gene input) OR single feature with facet_by ──
6133    # Multinomial is handled separately (has its own K-category subplot layout).
6134    use_grid = (is_gene and len(feature_indices) > 1) or (facet_by is not None)
6135
6136    if use_grid:
6137        # Special handling for multinomial - needs K subplots per feature
6138        if distribution == 'multinomial':
6139            if facet_by is not None:
6140                warnings.warn(
6141                    "facet_by is not yet supported for multinomial distribution. "
6142                    "Ignoring facet_by and plotting without faceting.",
6143                    UserWarning
6144                )
6145            return _plot_multinomial_multifeature(
6146                model=model,
6147                feature_indices=feature_indices,
6148                feature_names=feature_names_resolved,
6149                gene_name=feature,
6150                modality=modality,
6151                x_true=x_true,  # full model x_true; alignment to modality cells done inside
6152                window=window,
6153                min_counts=min_counts,
6154                show_correction=show_correction,
6155                color_palette=color_palette,
6156                xlabel=xlabel,
6157                ylabel=ylabel,
6158                figsize=figsize,
6159                subset_mask=subset_mask,
6160                **kwargs
6161            )
6162
6163        # Standard grid for 2D distributions.
6164        # Layout:
6165        #   rows = n_facet_rows × n_features   (facet-row groups nest features)
6166        #   cols = n_facet_cols × n_corrections (facet-col groups nest correction mode)
6167        # When facet_by is a single column, facet_row_groups is None (n_facet_rows=1),
6168        # so the layout reduces to rows=features, cols=n_facets×n_corrections as before.
6169        n_features = len(feature_indices)
6170        corrections_list = ['uncorrected', 'corrected'] if show_correction == 'both' else [show_correction]
6171        n_corrections = len(corrections_list)
6172        n_facet_rows = len(facet_row_groups) if facet_row_groups else 1
6173        n_facet_cols = len(facet_col_groups) if facet_col_groups else 1
6174        n_rows = n_facet_rows * n_features
6175        n_cols = n_facet_cols * n_corrections
6176
6177        if figsize is None:
6178            figsize = (6 * n_cols, 3 * n_rows)
6179
6180        fig, axes = plt.subplots(n_rows, n_cols, figsize=figsize, squeeze=False,
6181                                 constrained_layout=True)
6182
6183        def _plot_one_grid(feat_name, ax, correction, mask,
6184                           ntc_x_offset=None, ntc_y_offset=None):
6185            """Plot one panel: one feature × one correction × one (optional) facet."""
6186            if distribution == 'negbinom':
6187                plot_negbinom_xy(
6188                    model=model, feature=feat_name, modality=modality,
6189                    x_true=x_true, window=window, show_correction=correction,
6190                    color_palette=color_palette, show_hill_function=show_hill_function,
6191                    show_ntc_gradient=show_ntc_gradient, sum_factor_col=sum_factor_col,
6192                    min_counts=min_counts, xlabel=xlabel, ax=ax,
6193                    subset_mask=mask, mark_params=mark_params, ci_level=ci_level,
6194                    log2fc=log2fc, reference_df=reference_df,
6195                    fdr_df=fdr_df, fdr_threshold=fdr_threshold,
6196                    color_by=color_by,
6197                    ntc_x_offset=ntc_x_offset, ntc_y_offset=ntc_y_offset,
6198                    expand_x_to_params=expand_x_to_params,
6199                    expand_y_to_params=expand_y_to_params,
6200                    ylabel=ylabel,
6201                    **kwargs
6202                )
6203            elif distribution == 'binomial':
6204                plot_binomial_xy(
6205                    model=model, feature=feat_name, modality=modality,
6206                    x_true=x_true, window=window, show_correction=correction,
6207                    min_counts=min_counts, color_palette=color_palette,
6208                    show_trans_function=show_hill_function,
6209                    show_ntc_gradient=show_ntc_gradient, xlabel=xlabel, ax=ax,
6210                    subset_mask=mask, mark_params=mark_params, ci_level=ci_level,
6211                    log2fc=log2fc, ntc_x_offset=ntc_x_offset,
6212                    ylabel=ylabel,
6213                    **kwargs
6214                )
6215            elif distribution in ('normal', 'studentt'):
6216                plot_normal_xy(
6217                    model=model, feature=feat_name, modality=modality,
6218                    x_true=x_true, window=window, show_correction=correction,
6219                    color_palette=color_palette, show_trans_function=show_hill_function,
6220                    show_ntc_gradient=show_ntc_gradient, xlabel=xlabel, ax=ax,
6221                    subset_mask=mask, mark_params=mark_params, ci_level=ci_level,
6222                    log2fc=log2fc, ntc_x_offset=ntc_x_offset,
6223                    ylabel=ylabel,
6224                    **kwargs
6225                )
6226            else:
6227                ax.text(0.5, 0.5, f"Grid not supported for {distribution}",
6228                        ha='center', va='center', transform=ax.transAxes)
6229
6230        # Iterate: features (outer) → row-facets → col-facets → corrections.
6231        # Features are outer so we can compute the global NTC log2FC offsets once per
6232        # feature (using the global subset_mask, not any facet mask) and reuse them
6233        # across all facet panels — ensuring the NTC reference is consistent even when
6234        # a facet panel contains no NTC cells (e.g. a "Targeting" column facet).
6235        facet_col_iter = facet_col_groups if facet_col_groups else [(None, None)]
6236        facet_row_iter = facet_row_groups if facet_row_groups else [(None, None)]
6237
6238        _axes_by_feat = {feat_i: [] for feat_i in range(n_features)}
6239
6240        for feat_i, feat_name in enumerate(feature_names_resolved):
6241            # Pre-compute global NTC log2FC offsets for this feature. x_offset is
6242            # distribution-agnostic (log2 of mean NTC x_true); y_offset is only
6243            # meaningful/used for negbinom (other distributions keep their y-axis
6244            # as-is -- only the x-axis becomes log2FC when log2fc=True).
6245            if log2fc:
6246                _ntc_x_off, _ntc_y_off = _compute_global_log2fc_offsets(
6247                    model, modality, feat_name, x_true, subset_mask, sum_factor_col
6248                )
6249            else:
6250                _ntc_x_off = _ntc_y_off = None
6251
6252            for frow_i, (frow_label, frow_mask) in enumerate(facet_row_iter):
6253                grid_row = frow_i * n_features + feat_i
6254                for fcol_i, (fcol_label, fcol_mask) in enumerate(facet_col_iter):
6255                    # Combine all masks (global subset_mask AND row-facet AND col-facet)
6256                    combined_mask = subset_mask
6257                    for m in [frow_mask, fcol_mask]:
6258                        if m is not None:
6259                            combined_mask = (combined_mask & m
6260                                             if combined_mask is not None else m)
6261
6262                    for corr_i, correction in enumerate(corrections_list):
6263                        grid_col = fcol_i * n_corrections + corr_i
6264                        ax = axes[grid_row, grid_col]
6265                        _plot_one_grid(feat_name, ax, correction, combined_mask,
6266                                       ntc_x_offset=_ntc_x_off, ntc_y_offset=_ntc_y_off)
6267                        _axes_by_feat[feat_i].append(ax)
6268                        # Strip the per-panel legend — one shared legend is drawn below
6269                        if ax.get_legend() is not None:
6270                            ax.get_legend().remove()
6271                        # Build title prefix from active facet labels
6272                        title_parts = []
6273                        if frow_label is not None:
6274                            title_parts.append(f"{_facet_by_list[0]}={frow_label}")
6275                        if fcol_label is not None:
6276                            col_key = (_facet_by_list[1] if len(_facet_by_list) > 1
6277                                       else _facet_by_list[0])
6278                            title_parts.append(f"{col_key}={fcol_label}")
6279                        if title_parts:
6280                            current_title = ax.get_title()
6281                            ax.set_title("  ".join(title_parts) + "\n" + current_title)
6282
6283        # ── Uniform axis limits across panels ────────────────────────────────
6284        # Each panel has already set its own limits via set_xlim / set_ylim.
6285        # The x-axis (cis gene expression) is shared across all panels so
6286        # dose-response curves line up. The y-axis is only shared *within*
6287        # a feature (across its facet-row/col/correction panels), not across
6288        # different features — different features (e.g. different SJs) can
6289        # have very different effect magnitudes, and forcing a common y-axis
6290        # hides subtle effects in the smaller-magnitude ones.
6291        _all_xlims = []
6292        for _ax in axes.ravel():
6293            # Skip axes that have no plotted lines (empty panels)
6294            if not _ax.lines and not _ax.collections:
6295                continue
6296            _all_xlims.append(_ax.get_xlim())
6297        if _all_xlims:
6298            _shared_x = (min(lo for lo, hi in _all_xlims),
6299                         max(hi for lo, hi in _all_xlims))
6300            for _ax in axes.ravel():
6301                _ax.set_xlim(_shared_x)
6302
6303        for _feat_axes in _axes_by_feat.values():
6304            _feat_ylims = [_ax.get_ylim() for _ax in _feat_axes
6305                           if _ax.lines or _ax.collections]
6306            if not _feat_ylims:
6307                continue
6308            _feat_shared_y = (min(lo for lo, hi in _feat_ylims),
6309                               max(hi for lo, hi in _feat_ylims))
6310            for _ax in _feat_axes:
6311                _ax.set_ylim(_feat_shared_y)
6312
6313        # Overall suptitle for multi-feature plots
6314        if is_gene and len(feature_indices) > 1:
6315            plt.suptitle(
6316                f"{model.cis_gene} → {feature} (gene, n={len(feature_indices)} features)"
6317            )
6318
6319        # One shared legend for the whole grid (no duplicates across panels).
6320        handles, labels = _collect_legend_handles(axes.ravel())
6321        if handles:
6322            if legend_outside:
6323                # Anchor to the right edge of the figure (transFigure coords)
6324                fig.legend(handles, labels, bbox_to_anchor=(1.01, 0.5),
6325                           loc='center left', frameon=False)
6326            else:
6327                axes[-1, -1].legend(handles, labels, frameon=False)
6328
6329        _save_figure(fig, model, filename)
6330        return fig
6331
6332    # ── Single-feature path (no faceting) ─────────────────────────────────────
6333    feature = feature_names_resolved[0]  # Use resolved feature name
6334
6335    # Pre-compute global NTC log2FC offsets (same approach as grid path). x_offset
6336    # is distribution-agnostic (log2 of mean NTC x_true) and used by every
6337    # distribution when log2fc=True; y_offset is only meaningful for negbinom
6338    # (other distributions leave their y-axis as-is -- only x becomes log2FC).
6339    # This ensures the NTC reference is computed from ALL NTC cells (ignoring
6340    # min_counts and color_by grouping), making it independent of which colour
6341    # or subset is shown.
6342    _sf_ntc_x_off = _sf_ntc_y_off = None
6343    if log2fc:
6344        _sf_ntc_x_off, _sf_ntc_y_off = _compute_global_log2fc_offsets(
6345            model, modality, feature, x_true, subset_mask, sum_factor_col
6346        )
6347
6348    if distribution == 'negbinom':
6349        result = plot_negbinom_xy(
6350            model=model,
6351            feature=feature,
6352            modality=modality,
6353            x_true=x_true,
6354            window=window,
6355            show_correction=show_correction,
6356            color_palette=color_palette,
6357            show_hill_function=show_hill_function,
6358            show_ntc_gradient=show_ntc_gradient,
6359            sum_factor_col=sum_factor_col,
6360            min_counts=min_counts,
6361            xlabel=xlabel,
6362            subset_mask=subset_mask,
6363            mark_params=mark_params,
6364            ci_level=ci_level,
6365            legend_outside=legend_outside,
6366            figsize=figsize,
6367            log2fc=log2fc,
6368            reference_df=reference_df,
6369            fdr_df=fdr_df,
6370            fdr_threshold=fdr_threshold,
6371            color_by=color_by,
6372            ntc_x_offset=_sf_ntc_x_off,
6373            ntc_y_offset=_sf_ntc_y_off,
6374            expand_x_to_params=expand_x_to_params,
6375            expand_y_to_params=expand_y_to_params,
6376            ylabel=ylabel,
6377            **kwargs
6378        )
6379
6380    elif distribution == 'binomial':
6381        result = plot_binomial_xy(
6382            model=model,
6383            feature=feature,
6384            modality=modality,
6385            x_true=x_true,
6386            window=window,
6387            show_correction=show_correction,
6388            min_counts=min_counts,
6389            color_palette=color_palette,
6390            show_trans_function=show_hill_function,
6391            show_ntc_gradient=show_ntc_gradient,
6392            xlabel=xlabel,
6393            subset_mask=subset_mask,
6394            mark_params=mark_params,
6395            ci_level=ci_level,
6396            legend_outside=legend_outside,
6397            figsize=figsize,
6398            log2fc=log2fc,
6399            ntc_x_offset=_sf_ntc_x_off,
6400            ylabel=ylabel,
6401            **kwargs
6402        )
6403
6404    elif distribution == 'multinomial':
6405        result = plot_multinomial_xy(
6406            model=model,
6407            feature=feature,
6408            modality=modality,
6409            x_true=x_true,
6410            window=window,
6411            min_counts=min_counts,
6412            show_correction=show_correction,
6413            color_palette=color_palette,
6414            show_trans_function=show_hill_function,
6415            show_ntc_gradient=show_ntc_gradient,
6416            xlabel=xlabel,
6417            figsize=figsize,
6418            subset_mask=subset_mask,
6419            log2fc=log2fc,
6420            ntc_x_offset=_sf_ntc_x_off,
6421            ylabel=ylabel,
6422            **kwargs
6423        )
6424
6425    elif distribution in ('normal', 'studentt'):
6426        result = plot_normal_xy(
6427            model=model,
6428            feature=feature,
6429            modality=modality,
6430            x_true=x_true,
6431            window=window,
6432            show_correction=show_correction,
6433            color_palette=color_palette,
6434            show_trans_function=show_hill_function,
6435            show_ntc_gradient=show_ntc_gradient,
6436            xlabel=xlabel,
6437            subset_mask=subset_mask,
6438            mark_params=mark_params,
6439            ci_level=ci_level,
6440            legend_outside=legend_outside,
6441            figsize=figsize,
6442            log2fc=log2fc,
6443            ntc_x_offset=_sf_ntc_x_off,
6444            ylabel=ylabel,
6445            **kwargs
6446        )
6447
6448    else:
6449        raise ValueError(f"Plotting not implemented for distribution '{distribution}'")
6450
6451    # Save single-feature figure
6452    if filename is not None:
6453        ax_result = result if isinstance(result, plt.Axes) else result[0]
6454        _save_figure(ax_result.get_figure(), model, filename)
6455    return result
6456
6457
6458def restyle_targeting_lines(
6459    result,
6460    color_palette=None,
6461    ntc_alpha=0.35,
6462    ntc_linestyle="dashed",
6463    targeting_alpha=1.0,
6464    targeting_linestyle="solid",
6465    ntc_label_fragment="NTC",
6466    targeting_label_fragment="Targeting",
6467    rebuild_legend=True,
6468    legend_outside=False,
6469    legend_kwargs=None,
6470):
6471    """
6472    Restyle a ``plot_xy_data()`` result to use alpha + linestyle for NTC vs
6473    targeting, ggplot ``scale_alpha_manual``/``scale_linetype_manual`` style,
6474    instead of plot_xy_data's built-in color-tint shading.
6475
6476    Meant for plotting everything on one shared axes with a single flat hue
6477    per primary group (e.g. cell_line) rather than faceting: call
6478    ``plot_xy_data`` with ``facet_by=None`` and
6479    ``color_by=['<primary>', 'targeting']`` (which labels lines
6480    ``"<primary> / NTC"`` / ``"<primary> / Targeting"`` and tints NTC as a
6481    lighter shade of the primary color), then pass the result here to flatten
6482    each line back to its primary group's solid color and encode NTC vs
6483    targeting as alpha/linestyle instead::
6484
6485        palette = {'CRISPRi': 'steelblue', 'CRISPRa': 'tomato'}
6486        result = model.plot_xy_data(
6487            'GFI1B',
6488            facet_by=None,
6489            color_by=['cell_line', 'targeting'],
6490            color_palette=palette,
6491            legend_outside=True,
6492        )
6493        restyle_targeting_lines(result, color_palette=palette, legend_outside=True)
6494
6495    Also works with plain ``color_by='targeting'`` (labels are bare
6496    ``"NTC"``/``"Targeting"``, no primary-color reset needed --
6497    ``color_palette=None`` in that case).
6498
6499    Parameters
6500    ----------
6501    result : matplotlib Figure, Axes, or array of Axes
6502        Return value of ``model.plot_xy_data(...)``.
6503    color_palette : dict, optional
6504        ``{primary_label: color}`` -- the same dict passed to
6505        ``plot_xy_data(color_palette=...)``. Used to reset each line to its
6506        primary group's flat color, undoing plot_xy_data's NTC tint. If
6507        None, colors are left as plot_xy_data drew them (tinted).
6508    ntc_alpha, targeting_alpha : float
6509        Alpha for lines whose label contains ``ntc_label_fragment`` /
6510        ``targeting_label_fragment`` respectively.
6511    ntc_linestyle, targeting_linestyle : str
6512        Matplotlib linestyle for the same two groups (e.g. ``'dashed'``,
6513        ``'solid'``).
6514    ntc_label_fragment, targeting_label_fragment : str
6515        Substrings identifying NTC vs targeting lines in their legend label.
6516        Lines whose label matches neither are left untouched.
6517    rebuild_legend : bool, default True
6518        Regenerate each axes' legend from the restyled lines. Matplotlib
6519        legends snapshot line style at creation time, so the original
6520        legend won't reflect the restyle otherwise.
6521    legend_outside : bool, default False
6522        Match whatever you passed to ``plot_xy_data(legend_outside=...)``,
6523        so the rebuilt legend is placed the same way.
6524    legend_kwargs : dict, optional
6525        Extra kwargs forwarded to the rebuilt ``legend()`` call, overriding
6526        the defaults (``frameon=False``, plus ``bbox_to_anchor=(1.02, 0.5),
6527        loc='center left'`` when ``legend_outside=True``).
6528
6529    Returns
6530    -------
6531    The same ``result`` object, restyled in place.
6532
6533    Notes
6534    -----
6535    Only ``Line2D`` artists (the smoothed trend lines) are restyled --
6536    linestyle has no meaning for scatter points, and plot_xy_data's raw
6537    per-cell scatter points are unlabeled and left untouched.
6538
6539    This function does not raise: if ``result`` isn't a ``plt.Axes``,
6540    ``plt.Figure``, or an array/list containing ``plt.Axes`` instances, it
6541    resolves to zero axes and silently does nothing. Likewise, any axes
6542    found with no lines matching ``ntc_label_fragment``/
6543    ``targeting_label_fragment`` are left untouched.
6544    """
6545    if isinstance(result, plt.Axes):
6546        axes = [result]
6547    elif isinstance(result, plt.Figure):
6548        axes = result.axes
6549    else:
6550        axes = [a for a in np.ravel(result) if isinstance(a, plt.Axes)]
6551
6552    legend_kwargs = dict(legend_kwargs or {})
6553
6554    for ax in axes:
6555        handles, labels = [], []
6556        for line in ax.get_lines():
6557            label = line.get_label()
6558            if not label or label.startswith("_"):
6559                continue
6560
6561            if ntc_label_fragment in label:
6562                alpha, linestyle = ntc_alpha, ntc_linestyle
6563            elif targeting_label_fragment in label:
6564                alpha, linestyle = targeting_alpha, targeting_linestyle
6565            else:
6566                handles.append(line)
6567                labels.append(label)
6568                continue
6569
6570            if color_palette is not None:
6571                primary = label.split(" / ")[0].strip()
6572                if primary in color_palette:
6573                    line.set_color(color_palette[primary])
6574
6575            line.set_alpha(alpha)
6576            line.set_linestyle(linestyle)
6577            handles.append(line)
6578            labels.append(label)
6579
6580        if rebuild_legend and handles:
6581            existing = ax.get_legend()
6582            if existing is not None:
6583                existing.remove()
6584            if legend_outside:
6585                kw = dict(bbox_to_anchor=(1.02, 0.5), loc="center left", frameon=False)
6586            else:
6587                kw = dict(frameon=False)
6588            kw.update(legend_kwargs)
6589            ax.legend(handles, labels, **kw)
6590
6591    return result
def reorder_xtrue_by_barcode( x_true: Union[numpy.ndarray, torch.Tensor], src_barcodes: numpy.ndarray, dst_barcodes: numpy.ndarray) -> Union[numpy.ndarray, torch.Tensor]: 
315def reorder_xtrue_by_barcode(
316    x_true: Union[np.ndarray, torch.Tensor],
317    src_barcodes: np.ndarray,
318    dst_barcodes: np.ndarray
319) -> Union[np.ndarray, torch.Tensor]:
320    """
321    Reorder x_true from source barcode order to destination barcode order.
322
323    Parameters
324    ----------
325    x_true : array or tensor
326        Values to reorder
327    src_barcodes : np.ndarray
328        Source barcode order
329    dst_barcodes : np.ndarray
330        Destination barcode order
331
332    Returns
333    -------
334    array or tensor
335        Reordered x_true
336    """
337    is_torch = False
338    try:
339        import torch
340        if isinstance(x_true, torch.Tensor):
341            is_torch = True
342            x_np = x_true.detach().cpu().numpy()
343            torch_dtype, torch_device = x_true.dtype, x_true.device
344        else:
345            x_np = np.asarray(x_true)
346    except Exception:
347        x_np = np.asarray(x_true)
348
349    src = np.asarray(src_barcodes).astype(str)
350    dst = np.asarray(dst_barcodes).astype(str)
351
352    pos = {b: i for i, b in enumerate(src)}
353    perm = np.fromiter((pos[b] for b in dst), dtype=int, count=len(dst))
354
355    x_np = x_np if x_np.ndim == 1 else x_np[:, :]
356    x_np = x_np[perm] if x_np.ndim == 1 else x_np[:, perm]
357
358    if is_torch:
359        import torch
360        return torch.as_tensor(x_np, dtype=torch_dtype, device=torch_device)
361    return x_np

  • dst_barcodes (np.ndarray): Destination barcode order
Returns

def get_technical_group_labels(model) -> List[str]: 
603def get_technical_group_labels(model) -> List[str]:
604    """
605    Get informative labels for technical groups.
606
607    Returns human-readable labels like ``"K562"`` or ``"K562:lane1"`` built
608    from the covariates passed to ``set_technical_groups()``.
609
610    Parameters
611    ----------
612    model : bayesDREAM
613        Fitted bayesDREAM model.
614
615    Returns
616    -------
617    List[str]
618        One label per unique ``technical_group_code`` value (sorted).
619    """
620    if 'technical_group_code' not in model.meta.columns:
621        return ['All']
622
623    group_codes = sorted(model.meta['technical_group_code'].unique())
624
625    # Use stored covariates if available (set by set_technical_groups)
626    covariates = getattr(model, '_technical_group_covariates', None)
627    if not covariates:
628        return [f'Group_{i}' for i in group_codes]
629
630    labels = []
631    for code in group_codes:
632        mask = model.meta['technical_group_code'] == code
633        row = model.meta.loc[mask, covariates].iloc[0]
634        parts = [str(row[c]) for c in covariates]
635        labels.append(':'.join(parts))
636    return labels

690def plot_colored_line(
691    x: np.ndarray,

694    cmap,
695    ax: plt.Axes,
696    linewidth: float = 2
697):
698    """
699    Plot a line with color gradient based on values.
700
701    Parameters
