def Hill_based_positive(x, Vmax, A, K, n, epsilon=1e-06): 
735def Hill_based_positive(x, Vmax, A, K, n, epsilon=1e-6):
736    """
737    Positive Hill function.
738
739    Parameters
740    ----------
741    x : array
742        Input values
743    Vmax, A, K, n : float or array
744        Hill parameters
745    epsilon : float
746        Small constant for numerical stability
747
748    Returns
749    -------
750    array
751        Hill function values
752    """
753    x_safe = x + epsilon
754    K_safe = K + epsilon
755    x_log = np.log(x_safe)
756    K_log = np.log(K_safe)
757    x_n = np.exp(n * x_log)
758    K_n = np.exp(n * K_log)
759    denominator = K_n + x_n
760    return Vmax * (x_n / denominator) + A

Positive Hill function.

Parameters
  • x (array): Input values
  • Vmax, A, K, n (float or array): Hill parameters
  • epsilon (float): Small constant for numerical stability
Returns
  • array: Hill function values
def Hill_first_derivative(x, Vmax, K, n, epsilon=1e-06): 
763def Hill_first_derivative(x, Vmax, K, n, epsilon=1e-6):
764    """
765    First derivative of Hill function: d/dx [V * x^n / (K^n + x^n)]
766
767    Formula: (K^n * V * n * x^(n-1)) / (K^n + x^n)^2
768
769    Parameters
770    ----------
771    x : array
772        Input values
773    Vmax : float or array
774        Maximum effect
775    K : float or array
776        Half-maximal concentration
777    n : float or array
778        Hill coefficient
779    epsilon : float
780        Small constant for numerical stability
781
782    Returns
783    -------
784    array
785        First derivative values
786    """
787    x_safe = np.maximum(x, epsilon)
788    K_safe = np.maximum(K, epsilon)
789
790    x_n = np.power(x_safe, n)
791    K_n = np.power(K_safe, n)
792    x_nm1 = np.power(x_safe, n - 1)
793
794    denom = np.power(K_n + x_n, 2)
795
796    return (K_n * Vmax * n * x_nm1) / denom

First derivative of Hill function: d/dx [V * x^n / (K^n + x^n)]

Formula: (K^n * V * n * x^(n-1)) / (K^n + x^n)^2

Parameters
  • x (array): Input values
  • Vmax (float or array): Maximum effect
  • K (float or array): Half-maximal concentration
  • n (float or array): Hill coefficient
  • epsilon (float): Small constant for numerical stability
Returns
  • array: First derivative values
def Hill_second_derivative(x, Vmax, K, n, epsilon=1e-06): 
799def Hill_second_derivative(x, Vmax, K, n, epsilon=1e-6):
800    """
801    Second derivative of Hill function: d²/dx² [V * x^n / (K^n + x^n)]
802
803    Formula: -(K^n * V * n * x^(n-2) * ((n+1)*x^n - K^n*(n-1))) / (K^n + x^n)^3
804
805    Parameters
806    ----------
807    x : array
808        Input values
809    Vmax : float or array
810        Maximum effect
811    K : float or array
812        Half-maximal concentration
813    n : float or array
814        Hill coefficient
815    epsilon : float
816        Small constant for numerical stability
817
818    Returns
819    -------
820    array
821        Second derivative values
822    """
823    x_safe = np.maximum(x, epsilon)
824    K_safe = np.maximum(K, epsilon)
825
826    x_n = np.power(x_safe, n)
827    K_n = np.power(K_safe, n)
828    x_nm2 = np.power(x_safe, n - 2)
829
830    denom = np.power(K_n + x_n, 3)
831
832    # Numerator: -K^n * V * n * x^(n-2) * ((n+1)*x^n - K^n*(n-1))
833    inner_term = (n + 1) * x_n - K_n * (n - 1)
834    numer = -K_n * Vmax * n * x_nm2 * inner_term
835
836    return numer / denom

Second derivative of Hill function: d²/dx² [V * x^n / (K^n + x^n)]

Formula: -(K^n * V * n * x^(n-2) * ((n+1)x^n - K^n(n-1))) / (K^n + x^n)^3

Parameters
  • x (array): Input values
  • Vmax (float or array): Maximum effect
  • K (float or array): Half-maximal concentration
  • n (float or array): Hill coefficient
  • epsilon (float): Small constant for numerical stability
Returns
  • array: Second derivative values
def log2fc_first_derivative(x, S, dS_dx, epsilon=1e-10): 
839def log2fc_first_derivative(x, S, dS_dx, epsilon=1e-10):
840    """
841    First derivative in log2FC space: dg/du where g(u) = log2(S(x(u))) - y_ntc.
842
843    With u = log2(x) - x_ntc, we have x = x_ntc * 2^u, so dx/du = x * ln(2).
844
845    Formula: dg/du = x * S'(x) / S(x)
846
847    Parameters
848    ----------
849    x : array
850        Input x values (not log-transformed)
851    S : array
852        Function values S(x)
853    dS_dx : array
854        First derivative S'(x)
855    epsilon : float
856        Small constant for numerical stability
857
858    Returns
859    -------
860    array
861        First derivative in log2FC space
862    """
863    S_safe = np.maximum(np.abs(S), epsilon)
864    return x * dS_dx / S_safe

First derivative in log2FC space: dg/du where g(u) = log2(S(x(u))) - y_ntc.

With u = log2(x) - x_ntc, we have x = x_ntc * 2^u, so dx/du = x * ln(2).

Formula: dg/du = x * S'(x) / S(x)

Parameters
  • x (array): Input x values (not log-transformed)
  • S (array): Function values S(x)
  • dS_dx (array): First derivative S'(x)
  • epsilon (float): Small constant for numerical stability
Returns
  • array: First derivative in log2FC space
def log2fc_second_derivative(x, S, dS_dx, d2S_dx2, epsilon=1e-10): 
867def log2fc_second_derivative(x, S, dS_dx, d2S_dx2, epsilon=1e-10):
868    """
869    Second derivative in log2FC space: d²g/du².
870
871    Formula: d²g/du² = ln(2) * (x * S'/S + x² * S''/S - x² * (S'/S)²)
872
873    Parameters
874    ----------
875    x : array
876        Input x values (not log-transformed)
877    S : array
878        Function values S(x)
879    dS_dx : array
880        First derivative S'(x)
881    d2S_dx2 : array
882        Second derivative S''(x)
883    epsilon : float
884        Small constant for numerical stability
885
886    Returns
887    -------
888    array
889        Second derivative in log2FC space
890    """
891    S_safe = np.maximum(np.abs(S), epsilon)
892    ln2 = np.log(2)
893
894    term1 = x * dS_dx / S_safe
895    term2 = x**2 * d2S_dx2 / S_safe
896    term3 = x**2 * (dS_dx / S_safe)**2
897
898    return ln2 * (term1 + term2 - term3)

Second derivative in log2FC space: d²g/du².

Formula: d²g/du² = ln(2) * (x * S'/S + x² * S''/S - x² * (S'/S)²)

Parameters
  • x (array): Input x values (not log-transformed)
  • S (array): Function values S(x)
  • dS_dx (array): First derivative S'(x)
  • d2S_dx2 (array): Second derivative S''(x)
  • epsilon (float): Small constant for numerical stability
Returns
  • array: Second derivative in log2FC space
def Hill_third_derivative(x, Vmax, K, n, epsilon=1e-06): 
901def Hill_third_derivative(x, Vmax, K, n, epsilon=1e-6):
902    """
903    Third derivative of Hill function: d³/dx³ [V * x^n / (K^n + x^n)]
904
905    Formula: (K^n * V * n * x^(n-3) * ((n²+3n+2)*x^(2n) + (4K^n - 4K^n*n²)*x^n
906             + K^(2n)*n² - 3K^(2n)*n + 2K^(2n))) / (K^n + x^n)^4
907
908    Parameters
909    ----------
910    x : array
911        Input values
912    Vmax : float or array
913        Maximum effect
914    K : float or array
915        Half-maximal concentration
916    n : float or array
917        Hill coefficient
918    epsilon : float
919        Small constant for numerical stability
920
921    Returns
922    -------
923    array
924        Third derivative values
925    """
926    x_safe = np.maximum(x, epsilon)
927    K_safe = np.maximum(K, epsilon)
928
929    x_n = np.power(x_safe, n)
930    x_2n = np.power(x_safe, 2 * n)
931    K_n = np.power(K_safe, n)
932    K_2n = np.power(K_safe, 2 * n)
933    x_nm3 = np.power(x_safe, n - 3)
934
935    denom = np.power(K_n + x_n, 4)
936
937    # Numerator terms
938    # (n² + 3n + 2) * x^(2n)
939    term1 = (n**2 + 3*n + 2) * x_2n
940    # (4K^n - 4K^n*n²) * x^n = 4K^n * (1 - n²) * x^n
941    term2 = 4 * K_n * (1 - n**2) * x_n
942    # K^(2n) * n² - 3K^(2n) * n + 2K^(2n) = K^(2n) * (n² - 3n + 2)
943    term3 = K_2n * (n**2 - 3*n + 2)
944
945    numer = K_n * Vmax * n * x_nm3 * (term1 + term2 + term3)
946
947    return numer / denom

Third derivative of Hill function: d³/dx³ [V * x^n / (K^n + x^n)]

Formula: (K^n * V * n * x^(n-3) * ((n²+3n+2)x^(2n) + (4K^n - 4K^nn²)*x^n + K^(2n)*n² - 3K^(2n)*n + 2K^(2n))) / (K^n + x^n)^4

Parameters
  • x (array): Input values
  • Vmax (float or array): Maximum effect
  • K (float or array): Half-maximal concentration
  • n (float or array): Hill coefficient
  • epsilon (float): Small constant for numerical stability
Returns
  • array: Third derivative values
def log2fc_third_derivative(x, S, dS_dx, d2S_dx2, d3S_dx3, epsilon=1e-10): 
 950def log2fc_third_derivative(x, S, dS_dx, d2S_dx2, d3S_dx3, epsilon=1e-10):
 951    """
 952    Third derivative in log2FC space: d³g/du³.
 953
 954    Derived by differentiating d²g/du² with respect to u:
 955    d³g/du³ = (ln(2))² * [x*S'/S + 3x²*S''/S - 3x²*(S'/S)²
 956                         + x³*S'''/S - 3x³*(S'/S)*(S''/S) + 2x³*(S'/S)³]
 957
 958    Parameters
 959    ----------
 960    x : array
 961        Input x values (not log-transformed)
 962    S : array
 963        Function values S(x)
 964    dS_dx : array
 965        First derivative S'(x)
 966    d2S_dx2 : array
 967        Second derivative S''(x)
 968    d3S_dx3 : array
 969        Third derivative S'''(x)
 970    epsilon : float
 971        Small constant for numerical stability
 972
 973    Returns
 974    -------
 975    array
 976        Third derivative in log2FC space
 977    """
 978    S_safe = np.maximum(np.abs(S), epsilon)
 979    ln2 = np.log(2)
 980    ln2_sq = ln2 ** 2
 981
 982    S_ratio = dS_dx / S_safe      # S'/S
 983    S2_ratio = d2S_dx2 / S_safe   # S''/S
 984    S3_ratio = d3S_dx3 / S_safe   # S'''/S
 985
 986    x2 = x ** 2
 987    x3 = x ** 3
 988
 989    # x*S'/S
 990    term1 = x * S_ratio
 991    # 3x²*S''/S
 992    term2 = 3 * x2 * S2_ratio
 993    # -3x²*(S'/S)²
 994    term3 = -3 * x2 * S_ratio**2
 995    # x³*S'''/S
 996    term4 = x3 * S3_ratio
 997    # -3x³*(S'/S)*(S''/S)
 998    term5 = -3 * x3 * S_ratio * S2_ratio
 999    # 2x³*(S'/S)³
1000    term6 = 2 * x3 * S_ratio**3
1001
1002    return ln2_sq * (term1 + term2 + term3 + term4 + term5 + term6)

Third derivative in log2FC space: d³g/du³.

Derived by differentiating d²g/du² with respect to u: d³g/du³ = (ln(2))² * [xS'/S + 3x²S''/S - 3x²*(S'/S)² + x³S'''/S - 3x³(S'/S)(S''/S) + 2x³(S'/S)³]

Parameters
  • x (array): Input x values (not log-transformed)
  • S (array): Function values S(x)
  • dS_dx (array): First derivative S'(x)
  • d2S_dx2 (array): Second derivative S''(x)
  • d3S_dx3 (array): Third derivative S'''(x)
  • epsilon (float): Small constant for numerical stability
Returns
  • array: Third derivative in log2FC space
def predict_trans_derivatives( model, feature: str, x_range: numpy.ndarray, modality_name: Optional[str] = None, fdr_threshold: float = 0.05, fdr_df: Optional[pandas.core.frame.DataFrame] = None) -> Tuple[Optional[numpy.ndarray], Optional[numpy.ndarray], Optional[numpy.ndarray]]: 
1005def predict_trans_derivatives(
1006    model,
1007    feature: str,
1008    x_range: np.ndarray,
1009    modality_name: Optional[str] = None,
1010    fdr_threshold: float = 0.05,
1011    fdr_df: Optional["pd.DataFrame"] = None,
1012) -> Tuple[Optional[np.ndarray], Optional[np.ndarray], Optional[np.ndarray]]:
1013    """
1014    Compute first, second, and third derivatives of trans effect function.
1015
1016    Only supports single_hill and additive_hill function types.
1017
1018    Parameters
1019    ----------
1020    model : bayesDREAM
1021        Model with fit_trans() completed
1022    feature : str
1023        Feature name to predict
1024    x_range : np.ndarray
1025        X values to compute derivatives at
1026    modality_name : str, optional
1027        Modality name (default: primary modality)
1028    fdr_threshold : float, default 0.05
1029        For additive_hill: FDR-inactive components (q-value >= fdr_threshold) are
1030        gated to zero, matching predict_trans_function so the derivative is of the
1031        *same* curve that gets plotted.
1032    fdr_df : pd.DataFrame, optional
1033        Precomputed trans_summary DataFrame to source activity calls from.
1034
1035    Returns
1036    -------
1037    Tuple[np.ndarray or None, np.ndarray or None, np.ndarray or None]
1038        (first_derivative, second_derivative, third_derivative) at x_range values,
1039        or (None, None, None) if trans model not fitted or unsupported function type
1040
1041    Raises
1042    ------
1043    ValueError
1044        If function type is not single_hill or additive_hill
1045    """
1046    # Determine which modality to use
1047    if modality_name is None:
1048        modality_name = model.primary_modality
1049
1050    # Check if trans model fitted for this modality
1051    if modality_name == model.primary_modality:
1052        if not hasattr(model, 'posterior_samples_trans') or model.posterior_samples_trans is None:
1053            return None, None, None
1054        posterior = model.posterior_samples_trans
1055    else:
1056        modality = model.get_modality(modality_name)
1057        if not hasattr(modality, 'posterior_samples_trans') or modality.posterior_samples_trans is None:
1058            return None, None, None
1059        posterior = modality.posterior_samples_trans
1060
1061    # Get baseline A (present in all function types)
1062    if 'A' not in posterior:
1063        return None, None, None
1064
1065    A_samples = posterior['A']
1066
1067    # Get feature list — always from the modality, never from model.trans_genes.
1068    # modality.feature_names is the single source of truth (resolved + deduped
1069    # in Modality.__init__), no need to re-derive it here.
1070    modality = model.get_modality(modality_name)
1071    feature_list = modality.feature_names
1072    if feature_list is None:
1073        return None, None, None
1074
1075    # Get dimensions
1076    if hasattr(A_samples, 'mean'):
1077        A_mean = A_samples.mean(dim=0)
1078        if A_mean.ndim > 1:
1079            A_mean = A_mean.squeeze(0)
1080        n_genes_posterior = A_mean.shape[0]
1081    else:
1082        A_mean = A_samples.mean(axis=0)
1083        if A_mean.ndim > 1:
1084            A_mean = A_mean.squeeze(0)
1085        n_genes_posterior = A_mean.shape[0]
1086
1087    if n_genes_posterior != len(feature_list):
1088        return None, None, None
1089
1090    if feature not in feature_list:
1091        return None, None, None
1092
1093    feature_idx = feature_list.index(feature)
1094
1095    # Check function type and compute derivatives
1096    if 'Vmax_a' in posterior and 'Vmax_b' in posterior:
1097        # ===== ADDITIVE HILL =====
1098        try:
1099            alpha = _extract_param_mean(posterior['alpha'], feature_idx)
1100            beta = _extract_param_mean(posterior['beta'], feature_idx)
1101            Vmax_a = _extract_param_mean(posterior['Vmax_a'], feature_idx)
1102            Vmax_b = _extract_param_mean(posterior['Vmax_b'], feature_idx)
1103            K_a = _extract_param_mean(posterior['K_a'], feature_idx)
1104            K_b = _extract_param_mean(posterior['K_b'], feature_idx)
1105            n_a = _extract_param_mean(posterior['n_a'], feature_idx)
1106            n_b = _extract_param_mean(posterior['n_b'], feature_idx)
1107
1108            a_null, b_null = _resolve_hill_null_flags(
1109                feature, feature_idx, posterior, fdr_df=fdr_df, fdr_threshold=fdr_threshold
1110            )
1111            if a_null:
1112                alpha = 0.0
1113            if b_null:
1114                beta = 0.0
1115
1116            # First derivatives
1117            dHill_a = Hill_first_derivative(x_range, Vmax=Vmax_a, K=K_a, n=n_a)
1118            dHill_b = Hill_first_derivative(x_range, Vmax=Vmax_b, K=K_b, n=n_b)
1119            first_deriv = alpha * dHill_a + beta * dHill_b
1120
1121            # Second derivatives
1122            d2Hill_a = Hill_second_derivative(x_range, Vmax=Vmax_a, K=K_a, n=n_a)
1123            d2Hill_b = Hill_second_derivative(x_range, Vmax=Vmax_b, K=K_b, n=n_b)
1124            second_deriv = alpha * d2Hill_a + beta * d2Hill_b
1125
1126            # Third derivatives
1127            d3Hill_a = Hill_third_derivative(x_range, Vmax=Vmax_a, K=K_a, n=n_a)
1128            d3Hill_b = Hill_third_derivative(x_range, Vmax=Vmax_b, K=K_b, n=n_b)
1129            third_deriv = alpha * d3Hill_a + beta * d3Hill_b
1130
1131            return first_deriv, second_deriv, third_deriv
1132
1133        except (KeyError, IndexError, AttributeError):
1134            return None, None, None
1135
1136    elif 'upper_limit' in posterior and 'Vmax_a' in posterior and 'Vmax_b' in posterior:
1137        # ===== ADDITIVE HILL (binomial/multinomial) =====
1138        try:
1139            alpha = _extract_param_mean(posterior['alpha'], feature_idx)
1140            beta = _extract_param_mean(posterior['beta'], feature_idx)
1141            Vmax_a = _extract_param_mean(posterior['Vmax_a'], feature_idx)
1142            Vmax_b = _extract_param_mean(posterior['Vmax_b'], feature_idx)
1143            K_a = _extract_param_mean(posterior['K_a'], feature_idx)
1144            K_b = _extract_param_mean(posterior['K_b'], feature_idx)
1145            n_a = _extract_param_mean(posterior['n_a'], feature_idx)
1146            n_b = _extract_param_mean(posterior['n_b'], feature_idx)
1147
1148            a_null, b_null = _resolve_hill_null_flags(
1149                feature, feature_idx, posterior, fdr_df=fdr_df, fdr_threshold=fdr_threshold
1150            )
1151            if a_null:
1152                alpha = 0.0
1153            if b_null:
1154                beta = 0.0
1155
1156            # First derivatives
1157            dHill_a = Hill_first_derivative(x_range, Vmax=Vmax_a, K=K_a, n=n_a)
1158            dHill_b = Hill_first_derivative(x_range, Vmax=Vmax_b, K=K_b, n=n_b)
1159            first_deriv = alpha * dHill_a + beta * dHill_b
1160
1161            # Second derivatives
1162            d2Hill_a = Hill_second_derivative(x_range, Vmax=Vmax_a, K=K_a, n=n_a)
1163            d2Hill_b = Hill_second_derivative(x_range, Vmax=Vmax_b, K=K_b, n=n_b)
1164            second_deriv = alpha * d2Hill_a + beta * d2Hill_b
1165
1166            # Third derivatives
1167            d3Hill_a = Hill_third_derivative(x_range, Vmax=Vmax_a, K=K_a, n=n_a)
1168            d3Hill_b = Hill_third_derivative(x_range, Vmax=Vmax_b, K=K_b, n=n_b)
1169            third_deriv = alpha * d3Hill_a + beta * d3Hill_b
1170
1171            return first_deriv, second_deriv, third_deriv
1172
1173        except (KeyError, IndexError, AttributeError):
1174            return None, None, None
1175
1176    elif 'Vmax_a' in posterior:
1177        # ===== SINGLE HILL =====
1178        try:
1179            alpha = _extract_param_mean(posterior['alpha'], feature_idx)
1180            Vmax_a = _extract_param_mean(posterior['Vmax_a'], feature_idx)
1181            K_a = _extract_param_mean(posterior['K_a'], feature_idx)
1182            n_a = _extract_param_mean(posterior['n_a'], feature_idx)
1183
1184            # First derivative
1185            first_deriv = alpha * Hill_first_derivative(x_range, Vmax=Vmax_a, K=K_a, n=n_a)
1186
1187            # Second derivative
1188            second_deriv = alpha * Hill_second_derivative(x_range, Vmax=Vmax_a, K=K_a, n=n_a)
1189
1190            # Third derivative
1191            third_deriv = alpha * Hill_third_derivative(x_range, Vmax=Vmax_a, K=K_a, n=n_a)
1192
1193            return first_deriv, second_deriv, third_deriv
1194
1195        except (KeyError, IndexError, AttributeError):
1196            return None, None, None
1197
1198    elif 'theta' in posterior:
1199        # ===== POLYNOMIAL - NOT SUPPORTED =====
1200        raise ValueError(
1201            "Derivative plotting not supported for polynomial function type. "
1202            "Only single_hill and additive_hill are supported."
1203        )
1204
1205    else:
1206        # Unknown function type
1207        return None, None, None

Compute first, second, and third derivatives of trans effect function.

Only supports single_hill and additive_hill function types.

Parameters
  • model (bayesDREAM): Model with fit_trans() completed
  • feature (str): Feature name to predict
  • x_range (np.ndarray): X values to compute derivatives at
  • modality_name (str, optional): Modality name (default: primary modality)
  • fdr_threshold (float, default 0.05): For additive_hill: FDR-inactive components (q-value >= fdr_threshold) are gated to zero, matching predict_trans_function so the derivative is of the same curve that gets plotted.
  • fdr_df (pd.DataFrame, optional): Precomputed trans_summary DataFrame to source activity calls from.
Returns
  • Tuple[np.ndarray or None, np.ndarray or None, np.ndarray or None]: (first_derivative, second_derivative, third_derivative) at x_range values, or (None, None, None) if trans model not fitted or unsupported function type
Raises
  • ValueError: If function type is not single_hill or additive_hill
def predict_trans_log2fc( model, feature: str, x_range: numpy.ndarray, modality_name: Optional[str] = None, return_derivatives: bool = True, fdr_threshold: float = 0.05, fdr_df: Optional[pandas.core.frame.DataFrame] = None) -> Tuple[Optional[numpy.ndarray], Optional[numpy.ndarray], Optional[numpy.ndarray], Optional[numpy.ndarray], Optional[numpy.ndarray]]: 
1210def predict_trans_log2fc(
1211    model,
1212    feature: str,
1213    x_range: np.ndarray,
1214    modality_name: Optional[str] = None,
1215    return_derivatives: bool = True,
1216    fdr_threshold: float = 0.05,
1217    fdr_df: Optional["pd.DataFrame"] = None,
1218) -> Tuple[Optional[np.ndarray], Optional[np.ndarray], Optional[np.ndarray], Optional[np.ndarray], Optional[np.ndarray]]:
1219    """
1220    Compute trans effect function and derivatives in log2FC space.
1221
1222    Transforms:
1223    - x-axis: u = log2(x) - log2(x_ntc)  (cis gene log2FC)
1224    - y-axis: g(u) = log2(S(x(u))) - log2(y_ntc)  (trans gene log2FC)
1225
1226    Where x_ntc is the NTC mean for the cis gene, and y_ntc is the NTC mean for the trans gene.
1227
1228    Derivative formulas:
1229    - dg/du = x * S'(x) / S(x)
1230    - d²g/du² = ln(2) * (x * S'/S + x² * S''/S - x² * (S'/S)²)
1231    - d³g/du³ = ln(2) * (x²*S'''/S - 3x²*S'*S''/S² + 3x*S''/S + 2x²*S'³/S³ - 3x*S'²/S² + S'/S)
1232
1233    Parameters
1234    ----------
1235    model : bayesDREAM
1236        Model with fit_trans() completed and posterior_samples_ntc available
1237    feature : str
1238        Feature name (trans gene) to predict
1239    x_range : np.ndarray
1240        X values (cis expression, NOT log-transformed)
1241    modality_name : str, optional
1242        Modality name (default: primary modality)
1243    return_derivatives : bool
1244        Whether to compute and return derivatives (default: True)
1245
1246    Returns
1247    -------
1248    Tuple of (y_log2fc, u_range, first_deriv_log2fc, second_deriv_log2fc, third_deriv_log2fc)
1249        - y_log2fc: log2FC of trans gene relative to NTC
1250        - u_range: log2FC of cis gene relative to NTC
1251        - first_deriv_log2fc: dg/du (None if return_derivatives=False)
1252        - second_deriv_log2fc: d²g/du² (None if return_derivatives=False)
1253        - third_deriv_log2fc: d³g/du³ (None if return_derivatives=False)
1254        All are None if computation fails
1255    """
1256    # Get S(x) - the function values
1257    y_pred = predict_trans_function(model, feature, x_range, modality_name=modality_name,
1258                                     fdr_threshold=fdr_threshold, fdr_df=fdr_df)
1259    if y_pred is None:
1260        return None, None, None, None, None
1261
1262    # Get NTC means
1263    # Cis NTC (for x-axis transformation)
1264    cis_mod = model.get_modality('cis')
1265    if cis_mod is None or not hasattr(cis_mod, 'posterior_samples_ntc'):
1266        return None, None, None, None, None
1267
1268    cis_mu_ntc = cis_mod.posterior_samples_ntc.get('mu_ntc', None)
1269    if cis_mu_ntc is None:
1270        return None, None, None, None, None
1271
1272    if hasattr(cis_mu_ntc, 'mean'):
1273        x_ntc = cis_mu_ntc.mean(dim=0).squeeze().cpu().numpy()
1274    else:
1275        x_ntc = np.mean(cis_mu_ntc, axis=0).squeeze()
1276
1277    # Handle case where x_ntc is a scalar or 1-element array
1278    if np.ndim(x_ntc) == 0:
1279        x_ntc = float(x_ntc)
1280    elif len(x_ntc) == 1:
1281        x_ntc = float(x_ntc[0])
1282    else:
1283        x_ntc = float(x_ntc[0])  # Take first if multiple (shouldn't happen for cis)
1284
1285    # Trans NTC (for y-axis transformation)
1286    if modality_name is None:
1287        modality_name = model.primary_modality
1288    trans_mod = model.get_modality(modality_name)
1289
1290    if not hasattr(trans_mod, 'posterior_samples_ntc'):
1291        return None, None, None, None, None
1292
1293    trans_mu_ntc = trans_mod.posterior_samples_ntc.get('mu_ntc', None)
1294    if trans_mu_ntc is None:
1295        return None, None, None, None, None
1296
1297    if hasattr(trans_mu_ntc, 'mean'):
1298        y_ntc_all = trans_mu_ntc.mean(dim=0).squeeze().cpu().numpy()
1299    else:
1300        y_ntc_all = np.mean(trans_mu_ntc, axis=0).squeeze()
1301
1302    # Find the feature index to get the right NTC
1303    # trans_mod.feature_names is the single source of truth (resolved +
1304    # deduped in Modality.__init__), no need to re-derive it here.
1305    feature_list = trans_mod.feature_names
1306
1307    if feature_list is None or feature not in feature_list:
1308        return None, None, None, None, None
1309
1310    feature_idx = feature_list.index(feature)
1311    y_ntc = float(y_ntc_all[feature_idx]) if np.ndim(y_ntc_all) > 0 else float(y_ntc_all)
1312
1313    # Compute log2FC transformations
1314    epsilon = 1e-10
1315    u_range = np.log2(np.maximum(x_range, epsilon)) - np.log2(max(x_ntc, epsilon))
1316    y_log2fc = np.log2(np.maximum(y_pred, epsilon)) - np.log2(max(y_ntc, epsilon))
1317
1318    if not return_derivatives:
1319        return y_log2fc, u_range, None, None, None
1320
1321    # Get S'(x), S''(x), and S'''(x)
1322    first_deriv, second_deriv, third_deriv = predict_trans_derivatives(
1323        model, feature, x_range, modality_name=modality_name,
1324        fdr_threshold=fdr_threshold, fdr_df=fdr_df
1325    )
1326    if first_deriv is None:
1327        return y_log2fc, u_range, None, None, None
1328
1329    # Compute log2FC derivatives
1330    first_deriv_log2fc = log2fc_first_derivative(x_range, y_pred, first_deriv, epsilon)
1331    second_deriv_log2fc = log2fc_second_derivative(x_range, y_pred, first_deriv, second_deriv, epsilon)
1332    third_deriv_log2fc = log2fc_third_derivative(x_range, y_pred, first_deriv, second_deriv, third_deriv, epsilon)
1333
1334    return y_log2fc, u_range, first_deriv_log2fc, second_deriv_log2fc, third_deriv_log2fc

Compute trans effect function and derivatives in log2FC space.

Transforms:

  • x-axis: u = log2(x) - log2(x_ntc) (cis gene log2FC)
  • y-axis: g(u) = log2(S(x(u))) - log2(y_ntc) (trans gene log2FC)

Where x_ntc is the NTC mean for the cis gene, and y_ntc is the NTC mean for the trans gene.

Derivative formulas:

  • dg/du = x * S'(x) / S(x)
  • d²g/du² = ln(2) * (x * S'/S + x² * S''/S - x² * (S'/S)²)
  • d³g/du³ = ln(2) * (x²S'''/S - 3x²S'S''/S² + 3xS''/S + 2x²S'³/S³ - 3xS'²/S² + S'/S)
Parameters
  • model (bayesDREAM): Model with fit_trans() completed and posterior_samples_ntc available
  • feature (str): Feature name (trans gene) to predict
  • x_range (np.ndarray): X values (cis expression, NOT log-transformed)
  • modality_name (str, optional): Modality name (default: primary modality)
  • return_derivatives (bool): Whether to compute and return derivatives (default: True)
Returns
  • Tuple of (y_log2fc, u_range, first_deriv_log2fc, second_deriv_log2fc, third_deriv_log2fc): - y_log2fc: log2FC of trans gene relative to NTC
    • u_range: log2FC of cis gene relative to NTC
    • first_deriv_log2fc: dg/du (None if return_derivatives=False)
    • second_deriv_log2fc: d²g/du² (None if return_derivatives=False)
    • third_deriv_log2fc: d³g/du³ (None if return_derivatives=False) All are None if computation fails
def predict_trans_log2fc_samples( model, feature: str, x_range: numpy.ndarray, modality_name: Optional[str] = None, max_samples: Optional[int] = None, fdr_threshold: float = 0.05, fdr_df: Optional[pandas.core.frame.DataFrame] = None) -> Tuple[Optional[numpy.ndarray], Optional[numpy.ndarray]]: 
1337def predict_trans_log2fc_samples(
1338    model,
1339    feature: str,
1340    x_range: np.ndarray,
1341    modality_name: Optional[str] = None,
1342    max_samples: Optional[int] = None,

1345) -> Tuple[Optional[np.ndarray], Optional[np.ndarray]]:
1346    """
1347    Compute trans effect function in log2FC space for all posterior samples.
1348
1349    Parameters
1350    ----------
1351    model : bayesDREAM
1352        Model with fit_trans() completed
1353    feature : str
1354        Feature name (trans gene) to predict
1355    x_range : np.ndarray
1356        X values (cis expression, NOT log-transformed)
1357    modality_name : str, optional
1358        Modality name (default: primary modality)
1359    max_samples : int, optional

1361    fdr_threshold : float, default 0.05
1362        FDR-inactive components are gated to zero; see predict_trans_function.
1363    fdr_df : pd.DataFrame, optional
1364        Precomputed trans_summary DataFrame to source activity calls from.
1365
1366    Returns
1367    -------
1368    Tuple of (y_log2fc_samples, u_range)
1369        - y_log2fc_samples: [n_samples, n_points] log2FC predictions for each posterior sample
1370        - u_range: [n_points] log2FC of cis gene relative to NTC
1371        Both are None if computation fails
1372    """
1373    # Get all posterior samples for S(x)
1374    y_samples = predict_trans_function_samples(
1375        model, feature, x_range, modality_name=modality_name, max_samples=max_samples,
1376        fdr_threshold=fdr_threshold, fdr_df=fdr_df
1377    )
1378    if y_samples is None:
1379        return None, None
1380
1381    # Get NTC means (same logic as predict_trans_log2fc)
1382    cis_mod = model.get_modality('cis')
1383    if cis_mod is None or not hasattr(cis_mod, 'posterior_samples_ntc'):
1384        return None, None
1385
1386    cis_mu_ntc = cis_mod.posterior_samples_ntc.get('mu_ntc', None)
1387    if cis_mu_ntc is None:
1388        return None, None
1389
1390    if hasattr(cis_mu_ntc, 'mean'):
1391        x_ntc = cis_mu_ntc.mean(dim=0).squeeze().cpu().numpy()
1392    else:
1393        x_ntc = np.mean(cis_mu_ntc, axis=0).squeeze()
1394
1395    if np.ndim(x_ntc) == 0:
1396        x_ntc = float(x_ntc)
1397    elif len(x_ntc) == 1:
1398        x_ntc = float(x_ntc[0])
1399    else:
1400        x_ntc = float(x_ntc[0])
1401
1402    # Trans NTC
1403    if modality_name is None:
1404        modality_name = model.primary_modality
1405    trans_mod = model.get_modality(modality_name)
1406
1407    if not hasattr(trans_mod, 'posterior_samples_ntc'):
1408        return None, None
1409
1410    trans_mu_ntc = trans_mod.posterior_samples_ntc.get('mu_ntc', None)
1411    if trans_mu_ntc is None:
1412        return None, None
1413
1414    if hasattr(trans_mu_ntc, 'mean'):
1415        y_ntc_all = trans_mu_ntc.mean(dim=0).squeeze().cpu().numpy()
1416    else:
1417        y_ntc_all = np.mean(trans_mu_ntc, axis=0).squeeze()
1418
1419    # Find feature index
1420    # trans_mod.feature_names is the single source of truth (resolved +
1421    # deduped in Modality.__init__), no need to re-derive it here.
1422    feature_list = trans_mod.feature_names
1423
1424    if feature_list is None or feature not in feature_list:
1425        return None, None
1426
1427    feature_idx = feature_list.index(feature)
1428    y_ntc = float(y_ntc_all[feature_idx]) if np.ndim(y_ntc_all) > 0 else float(y_ntc_all)
1429
1430    # Compute log2FC transformations for all samples
1431    epsilon = 1e-10
1432    u_range = np.log2(np.maximum(x_range, epsilon)) - np.log2(max(x_ntc, epsilon))
1433
1434    # Transform each sample: log2(y_sample) - log2(y_ntc)
1435    y_log2fc_samples = np.log2(np.maximum(y_samples, epsilon)) - np.log2(max(y_ntc, epsilon))
1436
1437    return y_log2fc_samples, u_range

Compute trans effect function in log2FC space for all posterior samples.

Parameters
  • model (bayesDREAM): Model with fit_trans() completed
  • feature (str): Feature name (trans gene) to predict
  • x_range (np.ndarray): X values (cis expression, NOT log-transformed)
  • modality_name (str, optional): Modality name (default: primary modality)
  • max_samples (int, optional): Maximum number of samples to return
  • fdr_threshold (float, default 0.05): FDR-inactive components are gated to zero; see predict_trans_function.
  • fdr_df (pd.DataFrame, optional): Precomputed trans_summary DataFrame to source activity calls from.
Returns
  • Tuple of (y_log2fc_samples, u_range): - y_log2fc_samples: [n_samples, n_points] log2FC predictions for each posterior sample
    • u_range: [n_points] log2FC of cis gene relative to NTC Both are None if computation fails
def predict_trans_delta_p( model, feature: str, x_range: numpy.ndarray, modality_name: Optional[str] = None, return_derivatives: bool = True, fdr_threshold: float = 0.05, fdr_df: Optional[pandas.core.frame.DataFrame] = None) -> Tuple[Optional[numpy.ndarray], Optional[numpy.ndarray], Optional[numpy.ndarray], Optional[numpy.ndarray], Optional[numpy.ndarray]]: 
1440def predict_trans_delta_p(
1441    model,
1442    feature: str,
1443    x_range: np.ndarray,
1444    modality_name: Optional[str] = None,
1445    return_derivatives: bool = True,
1446    fdr_threshold: float = 0.05,
1447    fdr_df: Optional["pd.DataFrame"] = None,
1448) -> Tuple[Optional[np.ndarray], Optional[np.ndarray], Optional[np.ndarray], Optional[np.ndarray], Optional[np.ndarray]]:
1449    """
1450    Compute trans effect function in delta_p (probability difference) space for binomial modalities.
1451
1452    Transforms:
1453    - x-axis: u = log2(x) - log2(x_ntc)  (cis gene log2FC)
1454    - y-axis: delta_p(u) = p(x(u)) - p_ntc  (probability difference from NTC)
1455
1456    Where x_ntc is the NTC mean for the cis gene, and p_ntc is the NTC probability for the trans feature.
1457
1458    Parameters
1459    ----------
1460    model : bayesDREAM
1461        Model with fit_trans() completed and posterior_samples_ntc available
1462    feature : str
1463        Feature name (trans gene/SJ) to predict
1464    x_range : np.ndarray
1465        X values (cis expression, NOT log-transformed)
1466    modality_name : str, optional
1467        Modality name (default: primary modality)
1468    return_derivatives : bool
1469        Whether to compute and return derivatives (default: True)
1470        Note: derivatives are dp/du, d²p/du², d³p/du³ (probability space)
1471
1472    Returns
1473    -------
1474    Tuple of (delta_p, u_range, first_deriv, second_deriv, third_deriv)
1475        - delta_p: probability difference from NTC (p - p_ntc)
1476        - u_range: log2FC of cis gene relative to NTC
1477        - first_deriv: dp/du (None if return_derivatives=False)
1478        - second_deriv: d²p/du² (None if return_derivatives=False)
1479        - third_deriv: d³p/du³ (None if return_derivatives=False)
1480        All are None if computation fails
1481    """
1482    # Get p(x) - the probability values from fitted function
1483    y_pred = predict_trans_function(model, feature, x_range, modality_name=modality_name,
1484                                     fdr_threshold=fdr_threshold, fdr_df=fdr_df)
1485    if y_pred is None:
1486        return None, None, None, None, None
1487
1488    # Get NTC means
1489    # Cis NTC (for x-axis transformation)
1490    cis_mod = model.get_modality('cis')
1491    if cis_mod is None or not hasattr(cis_mod, 'posterior_samples_ntc'):
1492        return None, None, None, None, None
1493
1494    cis_mu_ntc = cis_mod.posterior_samples_ntc.get('mu_ntc', None)
1495    if cis_mu_ntc is None:
1496        return None, None, None, None, None
1497
1498    if hasattr(cis_mu_ntc, 'mean'):
1499        x_ntc = cis_mu_ntc.mean(dim=0).squeeze().cpu().numpy()
1500    else:
1501        x_ntc = np.mean(cis_mu_ntc, axis=0).squeeze()
1502
1503    # Handle case where x_ntc is a scalar or 1-element array
1504    if np.ndim(x_ntc) == 0:
1505        x_ntc = float(x_ntc)
1506    elif len(x_ntc) == 1:
1507        x_ntc = float(x_ntc[0])
1508    else:
1509        x_ntc = float(x_ntc[0])  # Take first if multiple
1510
1511    # Trans NTC (for y-axis transformation)
1512    if modality_name is None:
1513        modality_name = model.primary_modality
1514    trans_mod = model.get_modality(modality_name)
1515
1516    if not hasattr(trans_mod, 'posterior_samples_ntc'):
1517        return None, None, None, None, None
1518
1519    trans_mu_ntc = trans_mod.posterior_samples_ntc.get('mu_ntc', None)
1520    if trans_mu_ntc is None:
1521        return None, None, None, None, None
1522
1523    if hasattr(trans_mu_ntc, 'mean'):
1524        y_ntc_all = trans_mu_ntc.mean(dim=0).squeeze().cpu().numpy()
1525    else:
1526        y_ntc_all = np.mean(trans_mu_ntc, axis=0).squeeze()
1527
1528    # Find the feature index to get the right NTC
1529    # trans_mod.feature_names is the single source of truth (resolved +
1530    # deduped in Modality.__init__), no need to re-derive it here.
1531    feature_list = trans_mod.feature_names
1532
1533    if feature_list is None or feature not in feature_list:
1534        return None, None, None, None, None
1535
1536    feature_idx = feature_list.index(feature)
1537    p_ntc = float(y_ntc_all[feature_idx]) if np.ndim(y_ntc_all) > 0 else float(y_ntc_all)
1538
1539    # Compute delta_p transformation
1540    epsilon = 1e-10
1541    u_range = np.log2(np.maximum(x_range, epsilon)) - np.log2(max(x_ntc, epsilon))
1542    delta_p = y_pred - p_ntc  # Simple difference for probability space
1543
1544    if not return_derivatives:
1545        return delta_p, u_range, None, None, None
1546
1547    # Get dp/dx derivatives
1548    first_deriv_dx, second_deriv_dx, third_deriv_dx = predict_trans_derivatives(
1549        model, feature, x_range, modality_name=modality_name,
1550        fdr_threshold=fdr_threshold, fdr_df=fdr_df
1551    )
1552    if first_deriv_dx is None:
1553        return delta_p, u_range, None, None, None
1554
1555    # Convert dp/dx to dp/du using chain rule:
1556    # u = log2(x) - log2(x_ntc)
1557    # du/dx = 1/(x * ln(2))
1558    # dx/du = x * ln(2)
1559    # dp/du = dp/dx * dx/du = dp/dx * x * ln(2)
1560    ln2 = np.log(2.0)
1561    x_safe = np.maximum(x_range, epsilon)
1562
1563    # First derivative: dp/du = ln(2) * x * dp/dx
1564    first_deriv = ln2 * x_safe * first_deriv_dx
1565
1566    # Second derivative: d²p/du² = (ln2)² * x * (dp/dx + x * d²p/dx²)
1567    second_deriv = ln2**2 * x_safe * (first_deriv_dx + x_safe * second_deriv_dx)
1568
1569    # Third derivative: d³p/du³ = (ln2)³ * x * (dp/dx + 3x * d²p/dx² + x² * d³p/dx³)
1570    third_deriv = ln2**3 * x_safe * (first_deriv_dx + 3 * x_safe * second_deriv_dx
1571                                      + x_safe**2 * third_deriv_dx)
1572
1573    return delta_p, u_range, first_deriv, second_deriv, third_deriv

Compute trans effect function in delta_p (probability difference) space for binomial modalities.

Transforms:

  • x-axis: u = log2(x) - log2(x_ntc) (cis gene log2FC)
  • y-axis: delta_p(u) = p(x(u)) - p_ntc (probability difference from NTC)

Where x_ntc is the NTC mean for the cis gene, and p_ntc is the NTC probability for the trans feature.

Parameters
  • model (bayesDREAM): Model with fit_trans() completed and posterior_samples_ntc available
  • feature (str): Feature name (trans gene/SJ) to predict
  • x_range (np.ndarray): X values (cis expression, NOT log-transformed)
  • modality_name (str, optional): Modality name (default: primary modality)
  • return_derivatives (bool): Whether to compute and return derivatives (default: True) Note: derivatives are dp/du, d²p/du², d³p/du³ (probability space)
Returns
  • Tuple of (delta_p, u_range, first_deriv, second_deriv, third_deriv): - delta_p: probability difference from NTC (p - p_ntc)
    • u_range: log2FC of cis gene relative to NTC
    • first_deriv: dp/du (None if return_derivatives=False)
    • second_deriv: d²p/du² (None if return_derivatives=False)
    • third_deriv: d³p/du³ (None if return_derivatives=False) All are None if computation fails
def predict_trans_delta_p_samples( model, feature: str, x_range: numpy.ndarray, modality_name: Optional[str] = None, max_samples: Optional[int] = None, fdr_threshold: float = 0.05, fdr_df: Optional[pandas.core.frame.DataFrame] = None) -> Tuple[Optional[numpy.ndarray], Optional[numpy.ndarray]]:

1609        - u_range: [n_points] log2FC of cis gene relative to NTC
1610        Both are None if computation fails

1612    # Get all posterior samples for p(x)
1613    y_samples = predict_trans_function_samples(
1614        model, feature, x_range, modality_name=modality_name, max_samples=max_samples,
1615        fdr_threshold=fdr_threshold, fdr_df=fdr_df
1616    )
1617    if y_samples is None:
1618        return None, None
1619
1620    # Get NTC means (same logic as predict_trans_delta_p)
1621    cis_mod = model.get_modality('cis')
1622    if cis_mod is None or not hasattr(cis_mod, 'posterior_samples_ntc'):
1623        return None, None
1624
1625    cis_mu_ntc = cis_mod.posterior_samples_ntc.get('mu_ntc', None)
1626    if cis_mu_ntc is None:
1627        return None, None
1628
1629    if hasattr(cis_mu_ntc, 'mean'):
1630        x_ntc = cis_mu_ntc.mean(dim=0).squeeze().cpu().numpy()
1631    else:
1632        x_ntc = np.mean(cis_mu_ntc, axis=0).squeeze()
1633
1634    if np.ndim(x_ntc) == 0:
1635        x_ntc = float(x_ntc)
1636    elif len(x_ntc) == 1:
1637        x_ntc = float(x_ntc[0])
1638    else:
1639        x_ntc = float(x_ntc[0])
1640
1641    # Trans NTC
1642    if modality_name is None:
1643        modality_name = model.primary_modality
1644    trans_mod = model.get_modality(modality_name)
1645
1646    if not hasattr(trans_mod, 'posterior_samples_ntc'):
1647        return None, None
1648
1649    trans_mu_ntc = trans_mod.posterior_samples_ntc.get('mu_ntc', None)
1650    if trans_mu_ntc is None:
1651        return None, None
1652
1653    if hasattr(trans_mu_ntc, 'mean'):
1654        y_ntc_all = trans_mu_ntc.mean(dim=0).squeeze().cpu().numpy()
1655    else:
1656        y_ntc_all = np.mean(trans_mu_ntc, axis=0).squeeze()
1657
1658    # Find feature index
1659    # trans_mod.feature_names is the single source of truth (resolved +
1660    # deduped in Modality.__init__), no need to re-derive it here.
1661    feature_list = trans_mod.feature_names
1662
1663    if feature_list is None or feature not in feature_list:
1664        return None, None
1665
1666    feature_idx = feature_list.index(feature)
1667    p_ntc = float(y_ntc_all[feature_idx]) if np.ndim(y_ntc_all) > 0 else float(y_ntc_all)
1668
1669    # Compute delta_p transformations for all samples
1670    epsilon = 1e-10
1671    u_range = np.log2(np.maximum(x_range, epsilon)) - np.log2(max(x_ntc, epsilon))
1672
1673    # Transform each sample: p_sample - p_ntc
1674    delta_p_samples = y_samples - p_ntc
1675
1676    return delta_p_samples, u_range

def plot_trans_functions( model, features: Union[str, List[str]], modality_name: Optional[str] = None, show_function: bool = True, show_first_derivative: bool = False, show_second_derivative: bool = False, show_third_derivative: bool = False, x_range: Optional[numpy.ndarray] = None, n_points: int = 2000, use_log2_x: bool = True, use_log2fc: bool = False, use_delta_p: bool = False, show_posterior_samples: bool = False, show_ci: bool = False, posterior_alpha: float = 0.1, ci_alpha: float = 0.3, max_posterior_samples: int = 1000, colors: Union[str, List[str], Dict[str, str], NoneType] = None, alpha: float = 0.8, linewidth: float = 1.5, figsize: Optional[Tuple[float, float]] = None, title: Optional[str] = None, legend: bool = True, ax: Optional[matplotlib.axes._axes.Axes] = None, overlay_roots=None, overlay_roots_lw: float = 1.0, overlay_roots_alpha: float = 0.8, overlay_roots_also_on_function: bool = True, fdr_threshold: float = 0.05, fdr_df: Optional[pandas.core.frame.DataFrame] = None) -> matplotlib.figure.Figure:

1711    """
1712    Plot fitted trans functions and/or their derivatives.
1713
1714    Simple plot showing just the fitted Hill functions (no smoothed data).
1715    Useful for comparing multiple genes or viewing function shape with derivatives.
1716
1717    Parameters
1718    ----------
1719    model : bayesDREAM
1720        Model with fit_trans() completed
1721    features : str or list of str
1722        Single feature name or list of feature names to plot
1723    modality_name : str, optional
1724        Modality name (default: primary modality)
1725    show_function : bool
1726        Show the fitted function y(x) (default: True)
1727    show_first_derivative : bool
1728        Show first derivative dy/dx (default: False)
1729    show_second_derivative : bool
1730        Show second derivative d²y/dx² (default: False)
1731    show_third_derivative : bool
1732        Show second derivative d3y/dx3 (default: False)
1733    x_range : np.ndarray, optional
1734        X values to plot at. If None, generates evenly spaced points in log2 space
1735        from model's x_true range.
1736    n_points : int
1737        Number of points for x_range if auto-generated (default: 2000).
1738        Points are evenly spaced in log2 space for smooth curves on log-log plots.
1739    use_log2_x : bool
1740        Use log2(x) for x-axis (default: True). Ignored if use_log2fc=True.
1741    use_log2fc : bool
1742        If True, plot in log2 fold-change space relative to NTC (default: False).
1743        - x-axis: log2FC = log2(x) - log2(x_ntc) where x_ntc is cis gene NTC mean
1744        - y-axis: log2FC = log2(y) - log2(y_ntc) where y_ntc is trans gene NTC mean
1745        - Derivatives: dg/du and d²g/du² (chain rule transformed)
1746        Requires posterior_samples_ntc to be available for both cis and trans modalities.
1747        Not recommended for binomial modalities (use use_delta_p instead).
1748    use_delta_p : bool
1749        If True, plot in probability difference space relative to NTC (default: False).
1750        Designed for binomial modalities (e.g., splicing_sj).
1751        - x-axis: log2FC = log2(x) - log2(x_ntc) where x_ntc is cis gene NTC mean
1752        - y-axis: Δp = p - p_ntc where p is probability and p_ntc is NTC probability
1753        - Derivatives: dp/du and d²p/du² (chain rule transformed)
1754        Requires posterior_samples_ntc to be available for both cis and trans modalities.
1755        Mutually exclusive with use_log2fc.
1756    show_posterior_samples : bool
1757        If True, plot individual posterior fits behind the mean line (default: False).
1758        Each posterior sample is plotted with transparency set by `posterior_alpha`.
1759    show_ci : bool
1760        If True, show 95% credible interval band around the mean line (default: False).
1761        The CI is computed at each x point and shown as a shaded region.
1762    posterior_alpha : float
1763        Transparency for individual posterior sample lines (default: 0.1).
1764        Only used when show_posterior_samples=True.
1765    ci_alpha : float
1766        Transparency for the 95% CI shaded region (default: 0.3).
1767        Only used when show_ci=True.
1768    max_posterior_samples : int
1769        Maximum number of posterior samples to plot (default: 1000).
1770        Only used when show_posterior_samples=True.
1771    colors : str, list, or dict, optional
1772        Colors for each feature. Can be:
1773        - Single color string (all features same color)
1774        - List of colors (one per feature)
1775        - Dict mapping feature names to colors
1776        If None, uses default color cycle.
1777    alpha : float
1778        Line transparency (default: 0.8)
1779    linewidth : float
1780        Line width (default: 1.5)
1781    figsize : tuple, optional
1782        Figure size (width, height). Auto-sized if None.
1783    title : str, optional
1784        Plot title. If None, auto-generated.
1785    legend : bool
1786        Show legend (default: True)
1787    ax : plt.Axes, optional
1788        Existing axes to plot on. If None, creates new figure.
1789    overlay_roots : pd.DataFrame, pd.Series, dict, or None
1790        If provided, draws dashed vertical lines at derivative roots on each
1791        subplot.  Accepted forms:
1792
1793        - **pd.DataFrame** (full summary from ``save_trans_summary``): for each
1794          feature being plotted, the matching row is looked up by the ``feature``
1795          column.
1796        - **pd.Series / dict** (a single row): used as-is for every feature.
1797        - **None** (default): no overlay.
1798
1799        Root columns are selected automatically to match the plot's x-axis space:
1800        ``*_log2fc_mean`` when ``use_log2fc=True``, ``*_delta_p_mean`` when
1801        ``use_delta_p=True``, and ``*_mean`` (x-space, converted to log2 if
1802        ``use_log2_x=True``) otherwise.
1803    overlay_roots_lw : float
1804        Line width for root vlines (default 1.0).
1805    overlay_roots_alpha : float
1806        Transparency for root vlines (default 0.8).
1807    overlay_roots_also_on_function : bool
1808        If True (default), draw all root sets also on the function subplot.
1809    fdr_threshold : float, default 0.05
1810        For additive_hill: FDR-inactive components (q-value >= fdr_threshold) are
1811        gated to zero in the plotted curve/derivatives, consistent with
1812        _compute_hill_markers, predict_hill_from_summary_row, and
1813        save_trans_summary's point estimates.
1814    fdr_df : pd.DataFrame, optional
1815        Precomputed trans_summary DataFrame to source activity calls from, instead
1816        of recomputing Bayesian FDR live from the posterior for each feature.
1817
1818    Returns
1819    -------
1820    plt.Figure
1821        Matplotlib figure

1823    Raises
1824    ------

1826        If function type is polynomial (derivatives not supported)
1827        If no features could be plotted
1828        If use_log2fc=True but NTC means not available
1829        If use_delta_p=True but NTC means not available
1830        If both use_log2fc and use_delta_p are True (mutually exclusive)
1831
1832    Examples
1833    --------
1834    >>> # Plot function and derivatives for one gene
1835    >>> model.plot_trans_functions('TET2', show_first_derivative=True,
1836    ...                            show_second_derivative=True)
1837
1838    >>> # Plot with derivative roots overlaid from summary df
1839    >>> df = model.save_trans_summary(compute_derivative_roots=True)
1840    >>> model.plot_trans_functions('TET2', use_log2fc=True,
1841    ...                            show_function=True,
1842    ...                            show_first_derivative=True,
1843    ...                            show_second_derivative=True,
1844    ...                            show_third_derivative=True,
1845    ...                            overlay_roots=df)
1846
1847    >>> # Plot first derivative of multiple genes
1848    >>> model.plot_trans_functions(['TET2', 'MYB', 'GFI1B'],
1849    ...                            show_function=False,
1850    ...                            show_first_derivative=True)
1851
1852    >>> # Plot all non-monotonic genes (genes where derivative changes sign)
1853    >>> feature_names = model.get_modality(model.primary_modality).feature_names
1854    >>> non_monotonic = [g for g in feature_names if is_non_monotonic(model, g)]
1855    >>> model.plot_trans_functions(non_monotonic, show_first_derivative=True)
1856    """
1857    import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
1858
1859    # Ensure at least one thing to plot
1860    if not (show_function or show_first_derivative or show_second_derivative or show_third_derivative):
1861        raise ValueError("At least one of show_function, show_first_derivative, "
1862                        "show_second_derivative, or show_third_derivative must be True")
1863
1864    # Validate mutually exclusive options
1865    if use_log2fc and use_delta_p:
1866        raise ValueError("use_log2fc and use_delta_p are mutually exclusive. "
1867                        "Use use_log2fc for negbinom modalities, use_delta_p for binomial modalities.")
1868
1869    # Convert single feature to list
1870    if isinstance(features, str):
1871        features = [features]
1872
1873    # Determine modality
1874    if modality_name is None:
1875        modality_name = model.primary_modality
1876
1877    # Get x_range from model if not provided
1878    if x_range is None:
1879        if hasattr(model, 'x_true') and model.x_true is not None:
1880            x_true_np = model.x_true.cpu().numpy() if hasattr(model.x_true, 'cpu') else np.array(model.x_true)
1881            if x_true_np.ndim > 1:
1882                x_true_np = x_true_np.mean(axis=0)  # Average over posterior samples
1883            x_min = max(x_true_np.min(), 1e-6)  # Avoid log(0)
1884            x_max = x_true_np.max()
1885            # Evenly spaced points in log2 space for smooth curve on log-log plot
1886            log2_min = np.log2(x_min)
1887            log2_max = np.log2(x_max)
1888            x_range = 2 ** np.linspace(log2_min, log2_max, n_points)
1889        else:
1890            raise ValueError("x_range must be provided if model.x_true is not set")
1891
1892    # Check if NTC data is available for log2FC/delta_p; fall back to log2 if not
1893    if use_log2fc or use_delta_p:
1894        cis_mod = model.get_modality('cis')
1895        ntc_available = (
1896            cis_mod is not None
1897            and hasattr(cis_mod, 'posterior_samples_ntc')
1898            and cis_mod.posterior_samples_ntc is not None
1899            and 'mu_ntc' in cis_mod.posterior_samples_ntc
1900        )
1901        if not ntc_available:
1902            import warnings
1903            flag = 'use_log2fc' if use_log2fc else 'use_delta_p'
1904            warnings.warn(
1905                f"{flag}=True requested but NTC technical fit (posterior_samples_ntc) "
1906                f"is not available. Falling back to log2(x) x-axis.",
1907                UserWarning
1908            )
1909            use_log2fc = False
1910            use_delta_p = False
1911            use_log2_x = True
1912
1913    # Setup colors
1914    if colors is None:
1915        color_cycle = plt.rcParams['axes.prop_cycle'].by_key()['color']
1916        colors_list = [color_cycle[i % len(color_cycle)] for i in range(len(features))]
1917    elif isinstance(colors, str):
1918        colors_list = [colors] * len(features)
1919    elif isinstance(colors, dict):
1920        colors_list = [colors.get(f, 'gray') for f in features]
1921    else:
1922        colors_list = list(colors)
1923
1924    # Count how many subplots we need
1925    n_plots = sum([show_function, show_first_derivative, show_second_derivative, show_third_derivative])
1926
1927    # Create figure if no axes provided
1928    if ax is None:
1929        if figsize is None:
1930            figsize = (5 * n_plots, 4)
1931        fig, axes = plt.subplots(1, n_plots, figsize=figsize, squeeze=False)
1932        axes = axes[0]  # Flatten to 1D
1933    else:
1934        if n_plots > 1:
1935            raise ValueError("Cannot use single ax with multiple subplots. "
1936                           "Pass ax=None to create new figure.")
1937        fig = ax.figure
1938        axes = [ax]
1939
1940    # Track which plot index we're on
1941    plot_idx = 0
1942    plot_types = []
1943
1944    # Set up plot types with appropriate labels
1945    if use_log2fc:
1946        if show_function:
1947            plot_types.append(('function', 'log₂FC (y)'))
1948        if show_first_derivative:
1949            plot_types.append(('first_deriv', "dg/du"))
1950        if show_second_derivative:
1951            plot_types.append(('second_deriv', "d²g/du²"))
1952        if show_third_derivative:
1953            plot_types.append(('third_deriv', "d³g/du³"))
1954    elif use_delta_p:

2041                # then transform using chain rule: dp/du = x * ln(2) * dp/dx

2043                    S_samples, dS_samples, d2S_samples, d3S_samples = predict_trans_derivatives_samples(
2044                        model, feature, x_range,
2045                        modality_name=modality_name,
2046                        max_samples=max_posterior_samples,
2047                        fdr_threshold=fdr_threshold, fdr_df=fdr_df

2049                    if S_samples is not None and dS_samples is not None:
2050                        # Transform derivatives to delta_p u-space using chain rule
2051                        # dp/du = x * ln(2) * dp/dx
2052                        # d²p/du² = ln(2) * (x * dp/dx + x² * ln(2) * d²p/dx²)
2053                        epsilon = 1e-10
2054                        ln2 = np.log(2)
2055
2056                        # First derivative: dp/du = ln(2) * x * dp/dx
2057                        first_deriv_samples = ln2 * x_range[np.newaxis, :] * dS_samples
2058
2059                        # Second derivative: d²p/du² = (ln2)² * x * (dp/dx + x * d²p/dx²)
2060                        if d2S_samples is not None:
2061                            x_arr = x_range[np.newaxis, :]
2062                            second_deriv_samples = (ln2**2) * x_arr * (dS_samples + x_arr * d2S_samples)
2063
2064                        # Third derivative: d³p/du³ = (ln2)³ * x * (dp/dx + 3x*d²p/dx² + x²*d³p/dx³)
2065                        if d3S_samples is not None and d2S_samples is not None:
2066                            x_arr = x_range[np.newaxis, :]
2067                            third_deriv_samples = (ln2**3) * x_arr * (dS_samples + 3 * x_arr * d2S_samples
2068                                                                       + x_arr**2 * d3S_samples)
2069

2074                        model, feature, x_range,

2096                        ln2 = np.log(2)
2097
2098                        # First derivative: dg/du = x * S'(x) / S(x)
2099                        first_deriv_samples = x_range[np.newaxis, :] * dS_samples / S_safe
2100
2101                        # Second derivative: d²g/du² = ln(2) * (x*S'/S + x²*S''/S - x²*(S'/S)²)
2102                        if d2S_samples is not None:
2103                            term1 = x_range[np.newaxis, :] * dS_samples / S_safe
2104                            term2 = (x_range[np.newaxis, :] ** 2) * d2S_samples / S_safe

2110                        if d3S_samples is not None and d2S_samples is not None:

2112                            term2 = 3 * (x_range[np.newaxis, :] ** 2) * d2S_samples / S_safe
2113                            term3 = -3 * (x_range[np.newaxis, :] ** 2) * (dS_samples / S_safe) ** 2
2114                            term4 = (x_range[np.newaxis, :] ** 3) * (d3S_samples / S_safe)
2115                            term5 = -3 * (x_range[np.newaxis, :] ** 3) * (dS_samples / S_safe) * d2S_samples / S_safe
2116                            term6 = 2 * (x_range[np.newaxis, :] ** 3) * (dS_samples / S_safe) ** 3
2117                            third_deriv_samples = (ln2**2) * (term1 + term2 + term3 + term4 + term5 + term6)

2209

2229                elif use_delta_p:

2243                    ('first_deriv',  _r1, 'roots: 1st deriv'),

2246                ]
2247
